tei:div.tei:p: spang bar bya ba yin/ /lung dang bla ma'i man ngag dang*// mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan gsum sbyar nas/ /dur khrod thod pa bzang ngan gyi

|| spang blang shes par bya ba'i phyir//sde snod 'dzin pa sa skya pas*//thod pa'i man ngag mdor bsdus bstan/ /bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ aṣta aṅga nā ma hri da ya/ bod skad du/ yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla baiḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dod chags la sogs ma lus pa yi nad/ /rgyun du 'brel bas lus kun ma lus khyab/ /'dod dang khro ba ma lus sel ba yi/ /sman pa sngon med de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas tshe ring bar 'dod pa'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /rgyun shes kyi bu la sogs pa drang srong chen po rnams kyis 'di ltar bshad de/ tshe ni ring bar 'dod pa yis/ /chos dang nor dang bde ba bsgrub/ /tshe yi rig byed lung bshad pa/ /rab tu gus pas mnyan par bya/ /tshangs pas tshe yi rig byed dran/ /skye rgu'i bdag la bshad pa yin/ /de yis tha skar des brgya byin/ /des rgyun shes sogs drang srong la'o/ /de yis me bzhin 'jug la sogs/ /de rnams kyis rgyud so sor byas/ /shin tu 'thor ba de rnams las/ /rab gces phal cher btus pa ni/ /shin tu bsdus min rgyas min pa'i/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po byas/ /lus dang byis pa gdon lus stod/ /mtshon dang mche ba rgas ro tsa/ /gso spyad gang la gnas pa yi/ /yan lag brgyad du de bshad do/ /rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan yang*/ /nyes pa rnam gsum mdor bsdus yin/ khyab dang myur du byed phyir dang*/ /stobs ldan gzhan dang 'khrugs byed cing*/ /rang rgyud rtsub dang nad mang phyir/ /kun las rlung ni stobs ldan yin/ /de ni rnam gyur ma gyur gyis/ /lus ni 'joms dang gnas pa yin/ /de khyab gyur kyang snying kha dang*/

/lte ba'i 'og bar steng na gnas | | na tshod nyin zhag zas zos nas/ /de ni mtha' dbus spogaXs rtogaXs rim/ /des ni 'ju ba mi snyoms rno/ /chung dang mnyam pas mnyam par 'gyur/ /de ni lto ba sra snyi ran/ /mnyam pas kyang ni bar mar 'gyur// skye ba'i dang po khu khrag gnas/ /dug can srin bu'i dug dang mtshungs/ / de ni rang bzhin rnam gsum ste/ /chung 'bring chen po so sor lta/ /ma lus pa la khams mnyam pa/ /mchog yin nyes pa gnyis 'byung smad/ /de la rlung ni rtsub cing yang*/ /grang zhing sra la phra zhing g.yo/ /mkhris pa snum bcas rno zhing dro/ /yang zhing dri mnam 'khru zhing gsher/ /bad kan snum bsil lci ba dang*/ /rtul zhing 'jam brtan 'byar bag can/ /de gnyis gsum zad 'khrugs pa las/ /ldan pa dang ni 'dus pa yin/ / lus zungs dwangs ma khrag dang sha /tshil dang rus rkang khu chu ste/ /gnod bya bdun yin dri ma gcin/ /bshang ba rngul la sogs pa'ang yin/ / thams cad mnyam pas 'phel 'gyur zhing*/ /de las ldog pas gnod par 'gyur | | kun gyi rnam kun 'phel ba ni/ /rdzas dang yon tan bya bas mtshungs | | ldog pa yis ni dngos po rnams/ /de las gzhan du gyur pa yin | | ro ni mngar skyur lan tshwa dang*/ /tsha dang kha dang bska ba ste/ /rdzas drug la gnas de rnams kyang*/ /go rim bzhin du stobs chen yin/ /de las dang po gsum po ni/ /rlung 'joms tsha sogs bad kan sel/ /bska dang kha dang mngar ba ni/ /mkhris sel gzhan dag skyed pa yin/ /de ltar rdzas ni rnam pa gsum/ /zhi 'khrugs tha mal gnas la phan/ /de yi nus pa bshad pa ni/ /tsha bsil phul byung bdag nyid pas/ /nus pa rnam pa gnyis su bshad/ /rdzas kyi zhu ba rnam gsum ste/ /mngar skyur kha ba'i bdag nyid can/ /yon tan lci rtul bsil dang snum/ /'jam zhing ska ba mnyen dang brtan/ /phra ba dang bcas skam bag can/ /de ldog pa dang nyi shu yin/ /dus gdon las kyis sbyor ba rnams/ /dman dang log dang lhag pa rnams/

/yang dag sbyor bas nad dang ni/ /nad med rgyu gcig yin zhes bshad/ /de yi dbye ba bstan pa ni/ /de la nad ni rang bzhin gnas | |glo bur cha yis gnyis su bshad/ /de rnams lus sems dbye ba yis/ /gnas kyang rnam pa gnyis yin no/ /'dod chags gti mug kyang yid kyi/ /nyes pa gnyis su bstan pa yin/ /nad pa lta dang reg pa dang | | dri ba yis ni yongs su brtag /nad kyi gzhi ni dang po'i tshul/ / mtshan nyid re re bsten thob pa/ /sa dang lus kyi bye brag gis/ /'di la yul pas rnam gnyis bshad/ / skam sa phal cher rlung 'phel zhing*/ /rlan can bad kan 'phel ba yin/ /cha mnyam nyes pa mnyam pa ste/ /sa yi phyogs ni gsum du bshad/ /skad cig la sogs nad kyi skabs/ /dus su sman ni sbyor bar byed/ /snga dro'i dus su skyug sman btang*/ /nyi ma'i gung la bkru sman btang*/ /nyi ma gung las cung zad yol/ /smad nas sman ni mkhas pas gtang*/ /mdor na sman ni rnam gnyis te/ /sbyang ba dang ni zhi ba'o/ / lus las byung ba'i nad rnams kyi/ /rim gyis sman gyi dam pa ni/ /mas btang 'khru sman bzlog sman dang*/ /de bzhin til mar sbrang rtsi dang*/ /blo dang brtan bdag sogs shes pa/ / sems kyi nyes pa'i sman mchog yin/ / gso ba dag tu bstan pa yang*/ /sman pa sman dang nad g.yog bcas/ / nad pa'i yan lag rnam bzhi ste/ /re re'ang rnam pa bzhi bzhi yin/ /sbyor zhing rab sbyor shes pas na/ /'di ni sman pa gtso bo yin/ /sman pa mkhas stegs gzhung don shes/ /las rnams mthong zhing gtsang ba yin/ /sman ni cho ga mang po dang*/ /yon tan mang ldan phun tshogs 'phrod/ /nad g.yog rjes rtse gtsang sbra can/ /sgrim zhig blo dang ldan pa yin/ /nad pa phyug cing bsgo ba nyan/ /sman kun bzod par nus pa'i lus/ /skyes bu gzhon zhing bdag nyid thul/ /gnad du ma song rgyu sngar tshul/ /mtshan nyid chung dang gnod pa med/ /gnod bya yul dus rang bzhin rnams/

/mtshungs min yan lag phun sum tshogs/ /bza' ni rjes su mthun pa la/ /nyes pa lam gcig gsar gso sla/ /nad ni mtshon sogs kyis btab cing*/ / gso bar dka' zhing de las 'dres/ /gso ba tsam du bshad pa ni/ /tshe yi lhag ma lus phyir 'tsho/ /go zlog pa la goms pa nyid/ /spang bar bya ba'i nad pa ni/ /bcos pa'i thabs med nyid du 'gyur/ /shin tu phyin ci log par gnas/ /'dod dang rmongs dang khro bar byed/ /'chi ltas snang zhing dbang po nyams/ /sman pa rgyal po la sdang dang*/ /de dang mi mdza' sdang ba dang | | yo byad mi 'byor brel ba dang*/ /nyan du mi btub tshe zad dang*/ / gtum zhing mya ngan la gnas 'jigs//byas pa mi gzo sman brnyas spang*/ / de nas gzhan yang rgyud 'di yi/ /le'u bsdus pa bshad bya te/ /tshe ring nyin re dus spyod dang*/ /nad med bya dang btung ba dang*/ /zas shes bya dang zas bsdam dang*/ /zas tshod sman dang ro la gnas/ /nad shes bya dang de'i dbye ba/ /de gso ba dang gso thabs gnyis/ /sbyang sogs snum bcos khrus brta bya/ /sman dud kha dor mig bkru dang*/ /gso dang dbyung thabs zug rngu mtshon/ /gtar dpyad zug rngu dbyung ba'i dpyad/ /mtshon dang thal sman me btsa'i las/ /mdo gnas le'u sum cu ni/ /'di yi lus kyi brjod bya ste/ /mngal du 'jug dang de yi nad/ /yan lag gnad kyi bye brag dang*/ /rnam 'gyur bang chen las byung drug /nad kun 'byung ba'i nad gzhi dang*/ /rims khrag dbugs mi bde gcong sogs/ /chang dang gzhang 'brum tshad pa'i nad/ /chu 'gags gcin ni snyi ba dang*/ khong skran dmu rdzing dag dang ni/ /skya rbab mdze dang rlung gis gzir/ /dreg nad dag dang bcu drug yin/ /rims nad gso dang khrag dang ni/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde dang gcong*/ /slon dang chang nad gzhang 'brum dang*/ /tshad nad pho ba gcin nad gnyis/ khong 'bras skran dang dmu rdzing dang*/ /skya rbab 'or nad me dbal dang*/ /mdze dang sha bkra rlung nad dang*/

/dreg nad gso ba'i dpyad rnams so/ /le'u nyi shu gnyis 'di yin/ ༈ /de las gzhan pa cho ga grub/ /skyug sman bkru sman cho ga dang*/ /des grub mas gtong cho ga dang | | mas gtong nyes grub drug yin no/ /sman yin de nas phyi ma ni/ / byis pa nyer spyod de yi nad/ /de'i gdon 'byung por gtogs pa nyid/ /smyo dang rjed byed sogs gnyis gnyis/ /mig chu rdzi ma'i gra mtshams dang*/ / mig 'bras rab rib mthong nyams gsum/ /gnyis gnyis kun la'ang 'gro ba yin/ /rna nad sna dang kha nad mgo'i/ /rma dang chag grugs mtshan bar rdol/ /'bras sogs phra mo'i nad rnams dang*/ /gsang ba sbrul dang srin bu dug /byi ba dang ni bcud kyis len/ /bud med sa bon gso ba ste// le'u bzhi bcu nyid yin no/ /de ltar le'u brgya nyi shu/ /gnas ni drug tu bstan pa yin/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ /tshe ring bar bya ba'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas nyin re zhing spyad pa'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /bder gnas tshe ni bsrung ba'i phyir/ /yud tsam tshang phyir gnas de longs/ /lus kyi bya ba rdzogs byas nas/ /de nas gtsang sbra'i cho ga bya/ / ska dang tsha dang kha ba dang | | rtse 'jam nangs par zas spyad nas/ /so dang rnyil la mi gnod par | | so yi dag byed bca' bar bya/ /rtag tu mig sman skyer khaṇḍa/ /mig la phan pas de phyir bsten/ /de ni me yi rang bzhin te/ /lhag par bad kan la 'jigs pas/ /mchi ma 'dzag phyir skyer khaṇḍa/ /zhag bdun zhing ni blugs par bya/ /rtag tu bsku byug spyod byed pa/ /de ni rgas ngal rlung 'joms shing*/ /mig gsal lus rgyas tshe 'phel te/ /gnyid 'ong lpags 'jam rtas byed yin/ /des ni mgo dang rna ba dang*/ /rkang par khyad par rtag tu bsten/ /bad kan skyes dang ma zhu dang*/ /bkru sman sogs btang bsku byug spang*/ /yang zhing drod skyed mkhregs pa nyid/ /rtsol ba las ni 'byung bar 'gyur/

/rlung mkhris nad can byis pa dang*/ /rgas shing 'khogs pas de yang spang*/ /stobs ldan snum bag za ba dang*/ /grang ba'i dus dang dpyid dus dang*/ /nus ldan dag gis de bsten bya/ /de las gzhan tshe dal ba nyid/ khrus ni drod skyed ro tsa zhing*/ /tshe dang mdangs dang stobs rab skyed/ /lto sbos cham pa ma zhu dang*/ /zos ma thag pa rnams la smad | | sems can thams cad bde 'dod phyir/ /rtsom pa kun pa 'jug par 'dod/ /bde ba chos med par ma yin/ /de bas chos la brtson par bya | | mos pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten/ /cig shos ring du spang bar bya/ /'tshe dang rku dang 'dod log spyod/ /phra ma ngag rtsub rdzun tshig dang | | ma 'brel smra dang gnod sems dang*/ /brnab sems lta ba phyin ci log /'di ltar sdig pa'i las lam bcu/ /lus ngag yid kyis mi spyod do/ /phongs dag nad pa mya ngan gzir/ /ci nus par ni phan gdags bya || 'bu srin grog sbur dag la yang*/ /rang dang 'dra bar rtag tu blta/ / lha dang dge sbyong bram ze dang*/ /sman pa rgan rgyal mgron 'ongs mchod// slong la rgyab kyis phyogs mi bya/ /brnyas par mi bya tshar mi gcad/ /gnod par byed pa'i 'gro gzhan la/ /phan gdags par ni gtsau cher bya/ /dus su phan par smra ba dang*/ /bslu ba med cing des par bya/ /su yang bdag gi dgra yin dang*/ /bdag ni su yang dgrar gyur kyang*/ /brnyas dang bdag la gtso bo ni/ /mi byams zhes ni smra mi bya/ /'gro ba'i bsam pa shes nas ni || gang zhig ji ltar yongs mgu ba/ /de la de bzhin rjes 'jug cing*/ / gzhan dag dga' byed mdzangs pa yin//dbang po gzir bar mi bya zhing*// spyod pa bzang zhig snying rje 'jam/ /chos rnams kun gyi lam la ni/ /dbu ma'i lam gyi rjes 'jug bya/ /chu bor brgal te 'gro mi bya/ /me chen phung por gnas mi bya/ /the tshom byas pa'i gru shing dang*/ /bzhon pa mi bsrun la mi 'dzeg /rnam kun nyi ma la mi blta/

/mgo bos khur ni bskur mi bya// chang sogs chags dang bud med la/ /yid rton dbang du gyur pa spang*/ / blo ldan spyaud pa thams cad la/ /'jig rten nyid ni slob dpon yin/ /de bas 'jig rten pa yi don/ /rtog par byed pas de nyid bya/ /snying rjes brlan zhing gtong dang ldan/ /lus dang ngag yid dul ba dang*/ /gzhan gyi don la rang don sems/ /de dag dam pa'i spyod mthar thug /de ltar bdag ni nyin mtshan du/ /ji lta bur ni gnas 'gro zhes/ /rtag tu dran pa nyer 'jog pa/ /sdug bsngal snod du mi 'gyur zhing*/ /tshe dang dbang phyug nad med dang*/ /'jig rten grags pa thob par 'gyur/ /mdo'i gnas las le'u gnyis pa'o// //de nas dus su spyad pa'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ /dgun ni mngar zhing skyur ba dang*/ /lan tshwa'i ro ni bsten par bya/ /rlung gzhom til mar gyis byug cing*/ /spyi bo rkang pa ran par mnye/ /rang bzhin dro zhing yang ba yi | | gos bgo mal stan bsten par bya/ /nyi ma'i 'od la ran par 'de || dugs bya lh+wam ni rtag tu bgo /chung ma gzhon zhing yid 'ong rgyags || gur gum gyis byugs spos kyis bdug /nu ma brla dang ro smad rgyas | | lus kyi drod kyis grang sel ba'o/ /sos ka nyi ma rab tsha bas// stobs 'phrog zas ni mngar zhing yang*/ /snum bsil sla ba bsten bya zhing | | rab bsil chu yis lus kun bkru/ /chang mi btung zhig 'thung na yang*/ /nyung ba'am chu mang sres la btung*/ /gzhan du de ni kha skam lhod | | tsha dang rmongs par byed pa yin/ /dbyar gyi spyod pa smras pa ni// mkha' la sprin 'dus chu yi brlan/ /zas ni rab skyur lan tshwa snum/ khu ba sbrang rtsi bsngags pa yin/ /char 'bab tshe na bsags pa yi/ /mkhris pa ston ni ldang bar 'gyur/ /de bsal phyir ni kha mngar bska/ /bkru sman btang dang gtar ka bya/ /mdo'i gnas las le'i gsum pa'o// //༈de nas nad mi 'byung ba'i le'u bshad par bya ste/

/phyen dbugs bshang lci sbrid pa dang*/ /bkres skom gnyid dang lus ngal dang*// g.yal dang mchi ma skyugs pa dang*/ khu ba'i shugs ni dgag mi bya/ /shugs kyis bkag dang btsir ba yis/ /nad gzhi rnams ni ldang bar byed/ /dri ma rnams ni sbyang ba'i phyir/ /ji bzhin dus su nan tan bya/ /phan pa'i zas kyis lus brtas shing*/ /yid 'ong drod skyed sman sbyar ba/ /bsku zhing dril phyis khrus byas dang*/ /drag po 'jam rtsi mas gtong bya/ /des ni drod skye stobs ldan zhing*/ /blo mdog dbang po dri ma med/ /de bzhin tshe ring ro tsa dang | | dpal dang gzi mdangs thob par 'gyur/ /shes pas nyes pa spang ba dang*//dbang po nyer zhi dran pa dang*/ /yul dus bdag nyid shes pa dang || dam pa'i spyod pa'i rjes 'jug pa/ /'byung po dug dang rlung dang me// mtshon dang chag grugs sogs 'byung dang*/ /'dod chags zhe sdang 'jigs sogs gang*/ /de ni glo bur nad ces bya/ /lhan cig skyes dang glo bur nad | | mdor na ma skyes mi skyed dang*/ /skyes pa zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ /cho ga 'di nyid bstan pa yin/ /grang ba las byung nyes tshogs dpyid kyi tshe/ / gnam gsal so ga las byung dbyar dus na/ /dbyar bsags sprin bral dus su legs sbyang na/ /dus byung nad ni nam yang 'byung mi 'gyur/ /rtag tu phan pa'i zas dang spyod lam bsten/ /brtags te byed cing yul rnams la mi chags/ /gtong ldan sems snyoms bden dang bzod cing brtson/ / nyams ldan bsten par byed na gnod med 'gyur/ /mdo'i gnas las le'u bzhi pa'o// //de nas chu sna tshogs kyi le'u bshad par bya ste/ chu ni srog chags rnams kyi srog /lus kyang de yi rang bzhin yin/ /mkha' las babs pa gaṅgā'i chu/ /'tsho byed ngoms byed yi gar 'ong*/ /tshim zhing sems ni gsal byed pa/ /bsil zhing yang ba bdud rtsir mtshungs/ /gzhan du mtsho chu ston zla ni/ /'bring po min par btung mi bya/
/char pa'i chu ni snod bzang bzhag /'gyur ba med par rtag tu btung*/ /de med na ni thang la gnas

|| bar snang ba dang rjes mthun yin/ /sa phyogs dkar nag gtsang zhing yangs/ /nyi 'od rlung gis phog pa bsngags/ /nub phyogs nas ni rgya mtshor 'bab/ /gang yang myur 'bab rdul med chu/ /de ni bzang zhing dge ba yin/ /de las bzlog pa bzang ma yin/ /chu bsil chang nad brgyal ba dang | | skyug dang ngal dang mgo 'khor dang*/ / sko ma dang lus tsha mkhris pa dang | khrag rgyas dug ni sel byed yin/ /chu tshan drod skyed zas 'ju zhing*// mgul bde lus yang gcin nad sel/ /skyigs bu lto sbos rlung bad kan// rims gsar 'phral du zlog byed cing*/ /lud pa cham gsar dbugs mi bde || rtsibs logs zug la bsngags pa yin/ /chu ni bskol nas grang ba dag | bad kan mi skye lus yang zhing*/ /mkhris pa can la'ang phan pa yin// de ni zhag lon nyes gsum skyed/ /dbyar gyi char chu chu bo'i chu/ /mchog tu bzang dang ngan par bshad/ /'o ma phal cher ro zhu mngar/ /snum zhing mdangs skyed lus zungs 'phel/ /rlung dang mkhris sel ro tsa byed/ /bad kan skyed lci bsil ba yin/ /ba yi 'o ma 'tsho byed cing*/ /bcud kyis len yin glo rdol dang*/ / glo ga cong la phan yid gzhungs byed/ /stobs skyed nu zho bskyed dang 'khru/ /ngal dang mgo 'khor myos dpal nyams/ khrag dang mkhris pa sel ba yin/ /bud med nu zho rlung mkhris khrag /tshim byed mig dang snar blugs phan/ /rm-ig pa gcig pa'i 'o ma tsha/ /'o rlon bad kan skyed cing lci/ /rigs pa bskol bas de las gzhan/ /shin tu bskol na 'ju dka' lci/ /bzhos ma thag dro bdud rtsir mtshungs/ /zho ni ro dang zhu rjes skyur/ /rtug skem lci dang rlung nad sel/ /yi ga 'byed cing kha zas len/ /rims nad cham pa 'khru nad sel/ /zho dron dpyid dang sos ka dang*/ /ston dus mtshan mo btung mi bya/ /dar gsar yang la ska zhing skyur/ /mar ma zhu dang bad mkhris sel/ /chur ba la sogs stobs skyed cing*/ /rtug skams byed lci nyes pa la/

/ba mar 'o ma mchog yin te// lug las byung ba tsha zhing smad/ /'phral gyi mar gsar ro tsa zhing*/ /bsil zhing mdog stobs drod skyed byed/ /zhun mar blo rno dran gsal zhing*/ /yid gzhungs drod skyed stobs tshe 'phel/ /snum gyi nang na snum mchog te/ / sbyor ba las ni stong byed 'gyur/ /mar snying smyo dang brjed byed brgyal/ / klad nad sna mig mngal nad dang*/ /rma rnams sbyong zhing 'tsho byed pas/ / nad las rgyal byed dam pa yin/ /chang ni drod 'bar yi ga 'byed/ / rno zhing drod skyed khong brtas dga'/ /mngar bcas kha zhing tsha ba dang*/ / zhu rjes skyur cing cung zad 'khru/ / sku bcas gdangs snyan nad med dang*/ / spobs skyed mdog 'gyur khong yangs shing*/ /gnyid med pa dang gnyid che la | | phan zhing khrag dang mkhris pa skyed/ /rigs 'thung skem dang sbom phan zhing*/ /rtsub rno lus sgo khyab cing sbyong*/ /rlung dang bad kan sel ba yin | | gzhan du bsten na dug dang mtshungs/ /tsha ba'i spyod par ldan mi btung | | mdo'i gnas las le'u lnga pa'o// //de nas kha zas kyi tshul brtag cing shes par bya ba'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ gang gzhan 'bras ni ro mngar la/ /bsil zhing gcin mang yang ba yin/ /nas ni rtsub bsil lci la mngar/ /sran ma shin tu rlung skyed cing | | til 'bru dro zhing pags pa 'jam/ /bsil zhing skra dang stobs skyed 'bri/ /thug ska drod skyed zas 'ju zhing*/ /bkres skom dri ma 'gags pa sel/ /thug sla 'khru bcad yi gar 'ong*/ / sko ma sel bkru sman rjes la phan | | rgo ba la sogs ri dwags bsil/ /rtsal mthus sha rlon za ba'i yang | | ra sha shin tu bsil min zhing*/ /lug sha de las bzlog pas na// lus brtas yin par shes par bya/ /ba glang sha ni lud skam dang*/ /tsho dang rims dang cham pa sel/ /sha ni 'phral bsad pa dag dang*/ /dar la bab pa bsten par bya/ /rang shi rid dang shin tu tsho/ /nad chu dug gis shi ba spang

| | lan tshwa kun kyang bad kan bskyed/ /'khru zhing bshang lci 'byin la 'jam | | rlung 'joms 'ju byed stobs 'phrog la/ /yi ga 'byed cig bad mkhris skyed/ /a ru ra bska zhu rjes mngar/ /blo dang dbang gsal stobs rab skyed/ /skyu ru ra yang de 'dra bsil/ /ro skyur bad kan mkhris pa sel/ /yon tan cung dman ba ru ra/ /zhu rjes tsha mngar skra mig phan// 'bras bu gsum po 'di dag ni/ /bcud kyi len mchog mig nad sel/ / pi pi ling rno bad bskyed mngar/ /shing kun rlung dang bad kan sel/ /tsi tra ka stobs me dang mnyam/ /mdo'i gnas las le'u drug pa'o// //de nas kha zas bsrung ba'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ rgyal po'i pho brang nye 'khor du/ /srog 'tsho'i slob dpon bzhag par bya/ /de ltar byas pas thams cad du/ /thams cad las ni bsrung bar 'gyur/ khyad par du ni sa bdag gi /zas skom dug las bsrung bar bya/ /chos la sogs dang gang 'brel ba'i/ /'byor bde de la rag las so/ /dug ster kha ni sngo bskams la/ /gnong bag gis ni phyogs su blta/ /btung ba sha dang zho la sogs | | mdog 'gyur rma bya'i mgrin pa 'dra/ /mi 'phrod spangs dang 'phrod pa goms/ /de ltar ma bsten nyes pa 'byung*/ /zas dang mal stan 'dod la spyod/ /ran zhing rigs par sbyar ba yis/ khang khyim 'chos pa lta bur ni/ /rab tu lus ni gzung bar bya/ /dus min ha cang thal ches dang*// gnyid ni 'gegs par byed pa dag /bde dang tshe ni nyams byed de/ /dus mtshan gnyis pa lta bu yin/ /de bas mtshan mo dus bzhin du/ /gnyid ni ci bder log par bya/ /bud med dag la legs bsdams na/ /dran dang yid gzhungs nad med tshe/ /dbang po brtas shing grags stobs rnams/ / lhag par 'phel zhing rgas srar 'gyur/ /mdo'i gnas las le'u bdun pa'o || || de nas zas tshod ran par bza' ba'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ dus kun tu ni tshod zin bza'/ /de ni me drod skyed byed yin/

/lci ba las ni phyed 'grangs bza'/ /yang ba las ni rab 'grangs min/ /bde blag 'ju ba de tsam la/ /tshod zin zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /phan dang mi phan bsres pa dag /zos pa mnyam za yin par 'dod/ /dus min che'am chung zos pa/ /mi mnyam par ni za ba yin/ /tshod ma zas ngan mang ba dang*// tsha ches lan tshwa mang ba spang*/ /mig dang stobs phyir mtshan mo ni/ /'bras gsum sbrang rtsi mar gsar bza'/ /lto yi cha gnyis zas kyis te/ /cha gcig skom gyis dgang bar bya/ /cha bzhi pa ni stong par bzhag /zos rjes skom ni bsil ba'i chu/ /skyems po rgyas phyir chang btung ste/ /sbom pos sbrang rtsi'i chu btung ngo*/ /gcong chen nad la sha khu btung*/ / skem dang byis pa rgan po la/ /'o ma bdud rtsi lta bur phan/ /mdo'i gnas las le'u brgyad pa'o// //de nas sman la sogs pa'i bye brag shes par bya ba'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ pho ba'i me dang 'phrad pa las/ /gang zhig ro gzhan 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /ro rnams kyi ni mthar zhu ba/ /de ni zhu ba zhes bshad do/ / mngar dang lan tshwa'i zhu rjes mngar/ /skyur ba'i zhu rjes skyur ba yin/ kha dang tsha dang ska ba rnams/ /zhu rjes phal cher kha ba yin/ /mdo'i gnas las le'u dgu pa'o// //de nas ro tha dad par shes par bya ba'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ de la ro ni mngar ba dag /gang zhig myangs pa'i tshe na ni/ /lus dang dbang po rab brtas shing*/ /grogs mo la sogs dga' bar byed/ /skyur bas kha nas chu 'dzag cing*/ /so rtse spu ni ldang ba dang*/ /mig dang rdzi ma 'dzum par byed/ /lan tshwas kha ru mchil ma 'du/ /mkhur ba gre ba tsha bar byed | kha bas kha yi dri ma sbyong*/ /lce ni 'joms par byed pa yin/ /tsha bas lce rtse skyod 'gyur zhing/ /tsag tsag byed par 'gyur ba yin/ /bska bas lce ni bem por byed/ /gre ba rtsa sbubs 'gag pa'o/ /las ni mngar ba dag gis ni/ /mdog skyed rlung mkhris dug rnams sel/ /skyur ba drod skyed snum zhing bsil/

/lan tshwa drod skye 'gags pa 'byin/ /bsten drags skra dang stobs 'bri byed/ kha ba rang bzhin zhim min zhing*/ /tsha dang mkhris pa bad kan 'joms/ /tsha bas lkog nad ma zhu na/ /drod bskyed 'ju byed yi ge 'byed/ /bsten drags skom skyed stobs mdzad pa'o/ /bska bas khrag mkhris bad kan sel/ /bsten drags rtsa sgo 'gags pa'o/ /mngar ba phal cher bad kan skyed/ /skyur bas phal cher mkhris pa skyed/ /lan tshwa phal cher mig la gnod/ kha dang tsha ba phal cher ni/ /ro tsa 'bri zhig rlung skyed byed/ /bska las a ru ra ma gtogs/ /phar cher bsil zhing sri bar byed | | ro tsha skyur dang lan tshwa rnams/ /go rim bzhin du dro nus ldan/ kha dang bska dang mngar ba rnams/ /de bzhin du ni bsil ba yin/ /mdo'i gnas las le'u bcu pa'o// //de nas nad la sogs pa'i tshul shes par bya ba'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ nad dang lus zungs dri ma rnams/ /rtag tu lus kyi rtsa ba yin// lus ni dri mas brten pa na/ /'phel dang zad pa gnod pa yin/ /phal cher 'phel dang zad pa dag /mi mkhas pa yin mi shes so/ /gang zhig mnyam pas lus ni 'phel bar byed/ /nyes pa de nyid mi mnyam gsod par byed/ /de bas zad pa'am 'phel ba lta bur ni/ /phan pa'i spyod pa nyid kyis bsrung bar bya/ /mdo'i gnas las le'u bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas nad kyi dbye ba shes pa'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ zhu ba'i gnas ni rked pa dpyi/ /rna ba rus pa reg dbang po/ /rlung gnas yin te de las kyang*/ /zhu ba'i gnas su khyad par gnas/ /mkhris gnas lte ba pho ba rngul/ /chu ser dwangs ma khrag dang ni/ /mig dang pags pa dag yin te | | de las lte ba khyad par gnas/ /bad kan brang dang mgul pa mgo/ glo ba rus tshigs ma zhu'i gnas/ /dwangs ma tshil dang rna lce ste/ /brang ni khyad par dag gi gnas/ /rang gnas gnas pas mnyam nyid dang*/ / 'phel dang 'grib pas nad du 'gyur/ /nad ni 'di ltar rnam gsum ste/

/ la la tshe 'di'i nyes las 'byung*/ /la la sngon gyi las las 'byung*/ / gzhan dag de gnyis 'dres las 'byung*/ /dang po mi mthun bza' ba yin | | las skyes las ni zad pa ste/ /gnyi ka las byung nyes dang las/ / zad pas zad par 'gyur ba yin/ /de las gzhan yang nad rnams kyi/ / 'phel zad dbye ba bshad pa ste/ /tha dad pa las gsum zhes bya/ /ldan gsum de yang de dgu yin/ /mnyam par 'phel las gsum nyid do/ / gcig rab lhag pas drug tu 'gyur/ /ma lus pa las bcu gsum yin/ / gnyis gcig lhag pa las drug ste/ /mtshungs las gcig yin rab dang ni | | rab mchog brtags pa las drug yin/ /de ltar nyi shu rtsa lnga ni/ / 'phel ba'o zad pa'ang de snyed yin/ /de dag re re 'phel mnyam zad/ / drug ste slar yang de dag ni/ /gcig zad gnyis gnyis 'phel ba ni/ / go bzlog bcas las drug tu 'gyur/ /dbye ba drug cu gnyis su bstan/ / drug cu gsum pa bder gnas rgyu/ /mdo'i gnas las le'u bcu gnyis pa'o || || de nas nad gso thabs kyi le'u bshad par bya ste/ rlung nad gso ba snum dang ni/ /dugs dang 'jam rtsi sha tshon sogs/ /mkhris pa mar gsar bkru sman dang*/ kha mngar dri zhim yid 'ong bsil/ /bad kan gso ba skyug sman dang*/ /zas ni rtsub chung rno zhing dro/ /tsha dang kha dang ska ba bza' | | nad rnams so sor gso ba dag /nad las dpag stai bshad pa yin | | ldan pa dang ni 'dus pa dag /de ni so so'i tshul bzhin brtag /rlung ni zung du 'jug pas na/ /rlung mkhris phal cher sos kyi bya/ /bad kan rlung la dpyid kyi bya/ /bad kan mkhris la ston gyi bya/ khong pa'i drod stobs chung nyid kyis/ /lus zungs dang po mi 'ju ba/ /nad ni pho bar zhugs pa dag /dwangs ma ma zhu yin par bshad/ /nam tshong yan chad sna sman gyis/ /zhu ba'i gnas yod mas gtong bsal/ /yi ga 'chus la sna tshogs zas/ /sman dang zas bcas sbyar bar bya/ /mdo'i gnas las le'u bcu gsum pa'o//

//de nas gso thabs rnam pa gnyis bstan pa'i le'u bshad par bya ste | gso bya rnam pa gnyis yin phyir/ /gso thabs rnam pa gnyis su 'dod | | de gcig brta bar bya ba yin/ /gnyis pa nyams ni smad pa'o/ / brta ba dag ni rlung dang ni/ /rlung bcas mkhris pa zhi byed pa'o/ /sbyang dang zhi bar bya ba'i nad/ /rnam pa gnyis pa smyung ba yin/ /brta bas stobs ni 'phel ba dang*/ /de yis bsgrub bya'i nad zad 'gyur/ /sbom zhing lci la smyung ba mchog /gso ba gnyis las yod ma yin/ /mdo'i gnas las le'u bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas sbyang ba la sogs pa sman gyi sde tshan 'dus pa'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ po son cha dang shing mngar dang*/ /pi pi ling dang rgyam tshwa dang*// shu dag sug smel nyungs dkar sogs/ /'di dag skyug pa'i sman gyi sde/ / danda dur byid khron bu dang*/ /'bras gsum dong khra 'o ma 'khru/ /dug nyungs ru rta shu dag dang*/ /shing mngar sbrang rtsi rgyam tshwa sogs/ /'di dag mas btang khrus sman te/ /go snyod la sogs mgo nad sbyong*/ /mdo'i gnas las le'u bco lnga pa'o// //de nas snum gyi cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ rlung can lus yang mkhrang 'dod pa'i/ /lus can rnams la til mar phan/ /mngal dang rna ba klad nad la/ /tshil yang mchog tu phan pa yin/ /snum gyi las ni lto snyi 'khru | | nyam chung ba la bsngags pa yin/ khar chags pa ni bsal ba'i phyir | | snum dag 'thung rjes chu tshan btung*/ /'bras gsum gu gul pi pi ling | | a ru ra la sogs bskol ba/ /de dag snum la ji bzhin du/ / gnod pa med par sbyar bar bya/ /skyes bu snum la brten par byed pa rnams | | nang gi drod 'bar khong pa dag pa dang*/ /lus zungs 'phel brta stobs dang mdog bzang ldan/ /dbang brtan rgas sra lo brgya thub par bshad/ /mdo'i gnas las le'u bcu drug pa'o// //de nas dugs kyi cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ dugs bsro bcing dang tha mal pa/

/chu dugs dbye bas rnam pa bzhi/ /bsro ba gos dang snod dang ni/ /lag mthol yogs pa mer bsros bsro/ /bcing ba 'bru dang sbang ma dang*/ /cher btsos shug pa la sogs glan/ /spu 'jam pags rul min pas dkri/ /mtshan mo dkris pa nyin par dkrol/ /nyin dkris mtshan mo dgrol bar bya/ /tha mal pa ni 'bru rnams dang*/ /gso ma'i lo ma lci ba sogs/ /bsros la yul dus dpags te sbyar/ /chu dugs bsil sman gyis btab la/ /sbu gu bkang nas ci bder blugs/ / dugs kyis drangs dang zug gzer 'bral/ /yan lag mnyen par gyur pa dang | | drags na khrag mkhris skyed par byed/ /nyam chung sbrum ma sogs la spang | | mdo'i gnas las le'u bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas skyug sman dang bkru sman gtong ba'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ bad kan rgyas la skyug sman btang*/ /de bzhin mkhris pa bkru sman bya/ / mtshan mo gnyid log zas legs zhu/ / snga dro'i dang por bkra shis bya/ / sman la sngags ni mngon bzlas bya/ /lkog mar phyin pa'i bar du blud/ / tshangs pa skye rgu'i bdag dang tha skar bu/ /drag po dbang po nyi zla sa me rlung

| | drang srong sman gyi tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ /'byung po'i tshogs kyis khyod ni bsrung bar shog /drang srong rnams kyis bcud kyis len pa dang || lha rnams kyi ni bdud rtsi lta bu dang*/ /klu mchog rnams kyi bdud rtsi lta bur ni | khyod la sman 'di nye bar gnas gyur cig /na mo bha ga ba te/ bhai ṣa dzye gu ru baiḍūrya pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te/ samyaka saṃ buddhā ya | tadyathā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dzye/ bhai ṣa dzye/ mahā bhai ṣa dzye/ rā dza sa muṅga te swā hā/ shar du kha bstan 'thung du gzhug /'thung nas de la sems dmigs te/ / yud tsam bsdad la dang gar 'khyil/ /mchil mang de nas slon du gzhug/ skyug mi bro bar mi drang ngo*/ /skyug sman ma zhu bar nad 'byin/ /bkru sman zhu nas 'byin pa yin/ /bad kan dus 'das lto shes nas/ /legs par bkru sman gtong bar bya/ /zas la rim gyis spyad nas ni/ /de 'og nar ma'i kha zas bsten/ /skyug sman bkru sman la sogs pa/ /slar yang bar skabs bar skabs su/ /snum dang dugs kyi cho ga bya/ /gos kyi dri ma 'khrud dang mtshungs/ /snum dugs ma byas las byed pa/ /shing skam 'gugs par byed pa 'dra/ /sbyang ba legs pa nye bar bsten pas ni/ /blo gros gsal zhing dbang po stobs dang ldan/ /lus zungs brtan zhing khong pa'i me drod 'bar/ /na tshod dag kyang ring du 'jog par byed/ /mdo'i gnas las le'u bco brgyad pa'o// //de nas mas gtong ba'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ rlung la mas gtang bsngags pa de/ khu ba rlung dang dri ma 'gags/ /rlig rlugs rde'u nad zla mtshan 'dzag /sbu gu shing rus gser sogs la/ /ba glang mjug 'dra bug rdol med/ /'jam zhing drang la kha zlum pa/ /rtsa ba'i bu ga sor gsum tshad/ /mthar ni bug pa 'gegs par bya/ /rtse mo'i 'khor lor rkyal bu gdags/ /bkru sman drag tshad ji lta ba/ /de yi bzhi cha 'jam rtsi'i tshad/ /yang na sman gyi reng bu dang*/

/mas btang cho ga gzhan yang bya/ /bud med ro smad mngal nad la/ /gnyis gsum la sogs drag par bkru/ /gos ni bkrus pas tshos len ltar/ /mas gtong stobs bskyed nad rnams 'byin/ /gso ba'i phyed ces la la 'dod/ /mdo'i gnas las le'u bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas sna sman gtong ba'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ nam tshong yan chad nad rnams la/ /lhag par sna nas btang ba phan/ /sna ni klad pa'i sgo yin te/ /des na de nas nad de 'joms/ /shing mngar rgyam tshwa chang rny-ing dang*/ /'u su la sogs ci rigs pa/ /chur bcas blugs pa'am lde gu'am/ /phye ma sbu gus bud par bya/ /sna sman gyis ni pags mdog gsal/ /dbang brtan skra dkar med par 'gyur/ /mdo'i gnas las le'u nyi shu pa'o// //de nas dud pa gtong ba'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ nam tshong yan chad bad rlung las/ /byung ba'i nad rnams bsal ba'i phyir/ /mkhas pas rtag tu dud pa rngub/ /ches na khrag dang mkhris la gnod/ /gu gul gla sgang rdo dreg dang*/ /spang spos la sogs dri rnams la/ /rgya spos ru rta ma gtogs pa'i/ /nas til tshil dang rkang mar zhag kham phor bu ga'i dud pa ni/ /sna khug re re'am kha nas rngub/ /dud pa rngub la lud pa dbugs mi bde/ / skad 'gags dri mi tshor dang gdong pa skya/ /skra skyon rna ba mig nad rmongs bag dang*/ /snyom dang skyigs bu cham pa'i nad mi 'byung*/ / mdo'i gnas las le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //de nas sman khus mkhur ba dgang ba'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ mkhur bkang rnam pa bzhi yin te/ /snum dang zhi byed rma 'tsho sbyong*/ /snum ni tsha dang bskol ba yin/ /zhi byed kha ska mngar sman bskol/ /sbyong ba kha dang tsha ba skyur/ /rma 'tsho byed pa kha dang ska/ /de la rlung la dron po'o/ / mkhris pa la ni grang mo'o/ /bad kan la ni rab du tsha/ kha dang rma sbyong 'tsho byed yin/ /mdo'i gnas las le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas mig sman bsku ba'i le'u bshad par bya ste/

mig sman thigs pa blugs bya ba/ /rlung la dro dang khrag mkhris bsil/ /mig ni me yi rang bzhin te/ /bsil bas gnod med brtan par 'gyur/ /sna sman mig sman brta ba la sogs pa/ /mig mthu bskyed phyir kun tu 'bad par bya | | mthong ba nyams na 'gro ba sna tshogs pa'ang*/ /mun pa'i rang bzhin tshul gcig nyid du 'gyur/ /mdo'i gnas las le'u nyi shu gsum pa dang bzhi pa'o// //de nas cha spyad kyi le'u bshad par bya ste/ gang phyir cha spyad cho ga bzhin | | sna tshogs tshul du brdung bya ba/ /bzung ste zug rngu 'byin pa blo yi spyad | | cha spyad kun gyi mchog ni kang ka'i mchu/ /mgar ba mkhas pas cho ga bzhin/ /brdungs pa'i gtar spyad nyi shu drug /spu ni chod par nus pa dang | | phal cher sor ni drug par bya/ /gzugs legs so ni legs pa dang | | bzung ba bde ba nyid du bya/ /ya yo med cing 'thar legs pa// shin tu rno ba'i lcags las bya/ /rtse mo shin tu legs brdungs pa// utpal sngon po'i mdog 'dra bas/ /rang ming rjes mthun gzugs can ni// rtag tu nye bar bzhag par bya/ /sor bzhi yi ni srad bu 'am/ /ras kyis dam du bcings nas ni/ /chu ba tshigs rus gnad rnams dang*/ /zab dang nye dang 'phred mi gdab/ /rtsa mdud srin bus khrag dbyung zhing*/ /gting na yod pa pad pas dbyung*/ khrag nad 'dus pa zhal zhal bya/ /lus khyab khrag la gtar ka nyid/ /bems par gyur la rngabs ru gdab/ khrag phyung til dang zhun mar bsku/ /mdo'i gnas las le'u nyi shu lnga pa dang drug pa'o || || de nas gtar dpyad kyi le'u bshad par bya ste/ khrag 'khrugs gyur pa de la ni/ /gtar ka gdab pas dbyung bar bya/ /de yang bcu drug ma lon dang*/ /bdun cu 'das la khrag mi dbyung*/ /ma bsdams gtar ka mi gdab cing*/ /yon po'am mi snang la mi gdab/ /tshabs che'i nad ni ma gtogs pa/ /grang dang char dang rlung dus min/ /ji skad bshad pa ma mngon na/ /gnad ma gtogs pa gang nyer gdab/

/legs par btab nas khrag gzags te/ /chings ma bkrol nas gzags mi bya// nad khrag yod na phyi 'phred dam/ /phyi de nyin par slar yang dbyung*/ /rlung khrag gnag cing dmar la rtsub/ /shugs drag gsal zhing lbu ba can/ /mkhris khrag ser la rtsa khrag mnam/ /spyin bag dro zhing gzha' tshon yin/ /bad kan khrag ni 'jam la skya/ /rgyun can 'byar zhing ska ba ste/ /'dres pa'i mtshan ma 'dres ma yin/ khrag gi rgyun ni ma chod na/ /zar ma snag tsha shing khun tshogs/ btags pa'i phye ma rma khar gdab/ /chu grang la sogs sbyor ba bya/ /yang na rtsa de'i gong du gtar/ /rma kha bsreg pa la sogs bya | | mdog dang dbang po gsal zhing dbang po yul/ /'dod cing zas 'ju shugs kyang bde bar 'gyur/ /bde dang ldan zhing stobs rgyas phun sum tshogs/ /mi de khrag nad dag pa yin par bshad/ /mdo'i gnas las le'u nyi shu bdun pa'o// //de nas zug rngu dbyung ba'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ yang dang yang du khrag 'dzag la/ /rma yi nye skor mtho zhing glo/ /chu bur lta bu'i thor bu 'byung | khong na zug rngu yod ces bya/ /pags gnas mdog nyams skrangs shig sra/ /shar gnas btsir na mi bzod la/ /rma yi sgo ni 'drub mi shes// rus tshigs brkyang bskums las shes bya/ /mtshon lus thur mas bskyod de dbyung*/ /stobs che'i g.yog gis bzung ba'am/ /rta srab kyi ni kha lcags sam/ /shing gi yal ga bkug pas brtags/ /gre ba'i nang zhugs zung rngu la/ /skud pa gre bar gzhug par bya/ /zug rngu'i gnas dang cha spyad kyis/ /tshul ni mang pos legs brtags te/ /blo ldan thabs ni de dang de/ /shes par byas la zug rngu dbyung*/ /mdo'i gnas las le'u nyi shu brgyad pa'o// //de nas yang gtar rab cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ gang zhig ma smin brtol ba dang*/ /gang zhig smin kyang btang snyoms 'jog khyad par mi shes de dag ni/ /rme sha can dang 'drar shes bya/ /gang dang gang du 'gro 'gyur ba'am/

/gang du mtho ba shes byas las/ /de dang der ni rma btod de/ /legs phyed khrag ni med par bya/ /chu dang zheng du ci nas kyang*// nad ni gnas par mi 'gyur bya/ /sman pa dpa' brtan las la mkhas/ / mtshon rno mi rtul mi 'dar la/ /kun tu rmongs par ma gyur pa/ /btsags bu 'debs pa'i las la bsngags/ /'jam la mnyen pas bcings nas ni | | nyin re'i kun spyod bshad par bstan/ /nyin par gnyid log rma g.ya' zhing*/ kha dmar nang skrang rnag 'khyim 'gyur/ /bud med dran nam reg pa'am/ /mthong bas khu ba 'byung gyur na/ /ma phrad na'ang 'khrig pa las | | byung ba'i skyon ni thob par 'gyur/ / skam sa 'i sha ni zos gyur na/ / rma ni myur du 'tsho ba yin/ /bsnad pa'i rma ni myur du 'tshem/ /sha chad dum bu 'phyang ba'ang glan/ /rma kha khrag ni med gyur na/ /de ni cung zad 'brud bya ste/ /rma 'byor byed pa khrag yin no/ /ran par bcings pas red mi 'gyur | | mdo'i gnas las le'u nyi shu dgu pa'o// //de nas thal sman dang me btsa'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ btsags dpyad mtshon dpyad zhes bya ba/ /mang po kun las thal sman mchog /sman dang thal sman mtshon dpyad kyis/ /ma grub pa'ang grub par byed/ / pags pa sha dang rtsa rgyus dang*/ /tshigs dang rus tshogs rnams la gdab/ khrag ma chod dang mig gi nad/ /de dag nyid kyi rtsa sreg go /ma tshos pags mdog mi sdug tsha/ /chu bur 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /bsreg nyes cha 'khums chu bur che/ /legs pa zug 'bri myur du 'tsho/ /snying po gsang ba lta bu yi/ /gnas 'di rdzogs par byas pa yin/ /'di don dka' ba mdor bshad kyis/ /rgya cher kun tu bstan pa yin/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i mdo'i gnas las le'u sum cu pa'o/ /mdo gnas bstan pa rdzogs so// //༈ de nas lus kyi rum du zhugs pa la sogs pa'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ khu khrag skyon med par sems can/ /rang las nyon mongs kyis bskul nas/

/'tshogs pas mngal du chags 'gyur te/ /rtsub shing las ni me 'byung mtshungs/ /sa bon bdag nyid 'byung ba che/ /phra mo'i sems kyi rjes 'gro dang*/ /ma yi kha zas dwangs ma las/ /rim gyis mngal du rnam par 'phel/ /ji ltar nyi ma'i zer gyi me/ /me shel dang ni 'phrad gyur pa'i/ /shing la 'gro bar mi snang ste/ /sems can mngal gnas de dang 'dra/ /rgyu yi rjes su 'gro bas na/ /'bras bu de dang skal mnyam nyid/ /sems cad skye gnas sna tshogs 'dzin/ /zangs ma la sogs bzhu dang mtshungs*/ /de bas khu ba mang ba las/ /phal cher skyes pa skye 'gyur la/ /zla mtshan mang las bud med de/ /de gnyis mnyam las ma ning 'gyur/ /bud med zla ba re re'i khrag /dwangs ma las byung zhag gsum 'dzag /lo ni bcu gnyis yan chad nas/ /lnga bcu'i bar 'dzag de nas chad/ /bud med nyam chung bzhin ras dang*/ /nu ma rked pa 'gul ba dang || mig dang dku g.yo skyes pa 'dod/ /zla mtshan ldan par shes pa bya// dper na nyi ma nub pa dang*/ /padma'i kha ni zum par 'gyur/ /de bzhin zla mtshan dus 'das pa'i/ /mngal ni khu ba len mi byed/ /zla ba gcig tu bsags pa'i khrag /rtsa chen gnyis las dus su ni/ /cung zad gnag cing dri bral ba/ /rlung gis mngal gyi sgo ru 'byin/ /zla mtshan zhag ni bcu gnyis dus/ /de las dang po'i zhag gsum dang*/ /bcu gcig pa smad tshes zung la/ /bur 'gyur gzhan du bu mor 'gyur/ /'phral du mngal chags mtshan ma ni/ /mngal du sa bon 'dzin pa dang*/ /'dod ngoms lci dang g.yo ba dang*/ khrag dang khu ba rjes 'dres dang*/ /snying 'phar ba dang snyom pa dang*/ / skom dang rmya dang ba spu ldang*/ /zla ba dang por mi gsal zhag/ bdun nas nur nur por sogs 'gyur/ /mngal gnas lte ba ma yi ni/ / snying gi rtsa dang 'brel pa'i phyir/ /de yis de ni 'phel 'gyur te/ /zhing gi yur pa dag dang mtshungs/ /nu zho g.yas pa sngar 'byung zhing*/ /g.yas logs la ni brten pa dang*/

/'dri tshig skyes pa'i ming can smra/ /dga' zhing skyes pa mthong ba dang*/ /dku ni g.yas pa mtho ba dang*/ /mngal yang kun tu zlum pa dag /bu skye gzhan du bu mor 'gyur/ /gang yang skyes pa 'phrad 'dod dang*/ /glu gar rol mor dga' ba dang*/ /dri dang phreng chags bu mo skye/ /deng ngam sang ni bu btsa'i rtags/ /snyom zhing dku dang mig lhod dub/ /smad du lci zhing yi ga 'chus/ /mchil ma dang ni gcin mang 'byung | | de nas mngal nas 'byung ba rtsom/ /mar dang bcas pa'i thug pa blud/ /shu ti nyungs dkar zi ra dang*/ /snum dang lan tshwar bcas pa ni// mas gtong sha ma myur du 'byin/ /btsas tshe bkres pas mar blud bya/ / mngal du 'phel dang btsas pa'i nad/ /gsher dang khrag 'dzag btsir ba yi || nad de gso dka' yin pa'i phyir/ /btsas rjes 'bad de rim gro bya// lus kyi gnas las le'u dang po'o// //rlung ni rnam par 'khrugs gyur pas/ /mngal gyi gnas skabs sna tshogs byed/ /de phyir de ni mkhas pa yis/ /gnas skabs dag ni bltas te dpyad/ /bud med mngal du rlung gis khrag bsgongs te/ /bu chags yin zhes mi mkhas pa dag zer/ /lus kyi gnas las le'u gnyis pa'o// //sgra dang reg bya gzugs ro dri//go rim bzhin du nam mkha' rlung*// me chu sa yi yon tan yin/ /yon tan re res phyi ma bskyed/ /de la mkha' las lus bu ga /rna ba sgra dang khong stong dang*/ /rlung las reg pa pags dbugs 'byin/ /me las mig dang gzugs 'ju nyid/ /chu las lce dang ro dang gsher/ /sa las sna dri rus pa yin/ /rtsa chen rtsa ba snying la gnas// de dag kun gyis lus kun khyab/ /dwangs ma'i bdag nyid mdangs su 'gyur | | de ni phra la kun dang 'brel/ /rtsa ba sbom zhing rtse rab phra/ /lo ma'i rtsa ltar gyes pa yin/ /gyes pa de las rtsa phran ni/ /bdun brgya dag tu gyur pa'o/ /lte bar rtsa chen nyi shu bzhi/ /'khor lo'i lte rtsibs bzhin du brten |

| des ni steng 'og thad ka ru/ /lus ni rjes su 'dzin pa yin/ / de la gnod pas nad skyed la/ /skyon med dag pas bde bar byed/ /me drod nyams na 'chi 'gyur zhing*/ /skyon med na ni yun ring 'tsho/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims snying rje bden/ /tshangs par spyod pa byas pa gzo/ /byams ldan bcud kyis len bsten pa/ /tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba'i sde'o/ / lus kyi gnas las le'u gsum pa'o// //gnad du phog na chung ngus kyang*/ /phal cher shin tu gnod pa yin// des na gnad la brten pa'i nad/ /rab tu 'bad pas gso bar bya/ / lus kyi gnas las le'u bzhi pa'o// //ji ltar 'bras bu me tog dang*/ /me yi du ba char gyi sprin/ /phyis 'byung mtshan ma yin pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'chi ltas las nges 'chi/ /tha mal pa'am nad pa yis/ /gang gi yon tan skyon rang bzhin/ / snga las gzhan du 'gyur snang ba/ /de ni gshin rje'i khyim du 'jug /tshe yi rig byed 'bras bu kun/ /tshe shes pa la gnas pa yin/ /de bas 'chi ltas rnam pa kun/ /sman pas 'bad de shes par bya/ /lus kyi gnas las le'u lnga pa' || || pho nya ya mtshan dge sbyong dang*/ /rigs mthun las ni 'grub par 'gyur

|| dman dang 'jigs rengs sngangs pa dang*/ /bkra mi shis sogs las mi 'grub/ /mthong dang thos dang nyams myong dang*/ /gsol ba btab dang brtag pa dang*/ /'byung bar 'gyur dang bag chags dang*/ /rmi lam rnam pa bdun du 'dod/ /rmi lam ngan dang bzang sogs dang*/ /nad pa'i g.yog 'khor la sogs pa/ /'di dag de nyid mthong ba yi/ /drang srong rnams kyis mtshan mar bshad/ /lus kyi gnas las le'u drug pa rdzogs so || || le'u dang po/ nad rnams kun gyi nad gzhi ni/ /nyes pa 'khrug par gyur pa ste/ /de ni gnod 'gyur sna tshogs pa/ /bsten pas ldang bar 'gyur bar bshad/ /de ltar so so'i nad ldang ba/ /nad kyi gnas su 'gro byed pas/ /rtsa sbubs rnams su phyin pa dang*/ /nad rnams lus la skyed par byed/ /le'u gnyis pa/ ma zhu'i gnas su gyur pa dang*/ lhan cig gnas pas rtsa sgo bkag /zhu ba'i gnas kyi me drod ni/ /phyi rol du ni 'byin par byed/ /de dang lhan cig mngon khyab nas/ /lus kun tsha bar byed pa yin/ /mgo na brgyal snyoms lus tsha rmongs bag 'gyur/ /gre ba kha skam mi dga' rug tshigs na/ /gnyid med mgo 'khor spu ldang skom dad che | kha glal tshig mang rlung mkhris 'dres pa'i rims/ /lus rims thog mar lus tsha byed/ /sems kyi dang por snying tsha zhing*/ /rlung dang bad kan cig car ni/ /'byung tshe grang ba'i rims su 'gyur/ /mkhris pa dang ldan tsha ba ste/ /'dres pas 'dres pa'i rims nad do/ /lus ni yang zhing rmya dang rmongs bag tsha ba med/ kha nang thor bu 'byung dang dbang po brtas shing bde | | yid ni sor gnas rngul sbrid bder 'byung yi ga 'byed/ /mgo bo g.ya' ba rims nad 'byang ba'i mtshan ma yin// //le'u gsum pa/ mkhris pa can gyi mkhris nad ni/ /gsher dang khrag rgyas nad du 'gyur// //le'u drug pa/ glang chen lcags kyu med pa ltar/ /rmongs pas mi bya ci yang med/ /sems 'gyur ra ro bag med pas/ /'di ni kha na ma tho'i gnas

| | gang du dran pa nyams 'gyur bas/ /de las mi dge thams cad 'byung | | gang la chags pa mi shes pa/ /de la mkhas pas ji ltar bsten// stobs dang dus dang yul dang goms pa dang*/ /rang bzhin grogs dang na tshod nad rnams ni/ /legs brtags de dang rjes mthun gang zhig 'thung*// de ni bdud rtsi 'thung dang mtshungs pa yin// //le'u bcu pa/ mal stan cho gar mi ldan pa/ /bsten na gcin snyi nad skyed byed/ khu ba gnas las 'phos nas skam/ /lugs bzhin mi 'byung rde'ur chags/ /gang du kha dog sna tshogs pa'i/ /gcin 'byung za khu'i nad ces bya// //le'u bcu gcig pa/ rlung ni rgyun lam 'gags pas 'khrugs/ / skrang zhing gzer ni skye ba'i rgyu/ /skran ni zla mtshan bye brag gis/ /bud med rnams la phal cher 'byung*// //le'u bcu gnyis pa/ nad kun me drod nyams las skye/ /lhag par dmu rdzing nad skyed cing*/ /ma zhu dri ma can gyi zas/ /dri ma sogs las skye bar 'gyur// //le'u bcu bzhi pa/ kha zas spyod lam mi 'phrod bsten/ / sngo na chad las byas nad bslangs nas/ /chu ser rtsa las gram nas ni/ /sha pags mi sdug mdze ru 'gyur/ /zas mngar 'o ma bu ram dang*/ /tsha dang 'bras gsar chan dang ni/ /lo ma'i 'dab ma la sogs dga'/ /mi gtsang bshang ba'i srin bu 'byung*// //le'u bco lnga pa/ rlung ni phan dang gnod byed la/ /'di ni sna tshogs rgyu gcig pu/ khyad par du ni lus kyi ni/ /nad dang nad med rgyur shes bya/ /de bas de ldang mi 'gyur bar/ /rtag tu 'bad pa nyid du gyis// le'u bcu drug pa/ skyid cing spyod lam 'khrugs pa las/ /'theng nad stobs 'jig rlung khrag 'dres/ /de ni phyug po'i rlung nad de/ /ming ni dreg tu rnam par bshad/ /nad gzhi'i gnas rdzogs so// //le'u dang po/ smyung bas nad ni nyams smad cing*/ /me drod bskyed dang khong yang 'gyur/ /bde zhing yi ga 'bye ba dang*/ /zas 'ju stobs dang mdangs skyed 'gyur/

/rlung gi rims la byi tsher ba/ /bca' sga sle tres gla sgang phan/ /mkhris rims gla sgang dug mo nyung*/ /pu shel par pa byi tsher phan || bad kan dug nyung ba sha ka /byi tsher gla sgang bca' sga phan/ /'dus pa'i rims la bya kri dang*/ /skyer pa gla sgang pa to la/ /'bras bu gsum dang pu shel tse/ /sle tres kaṇḍa ka ri phan/ /ma zhu'i rims la sman 'thungs na | | sbrul la 'o ma blud dang mtshungs/ /byin pa tshigs rus gzer 'gyur la | | rngul dbyung ba ni rab tu bsngags/ /bad kan bri nas rlung mkhris ni | | shas che'i rims la zhun mar sbyin/ /nad smin pa la bdud rtsi ste/ / gzhan du de ni dug dang mtshungs/ /rims ni zhi bar ma gyur na/ /sbyang 'os la ni sbyang bar bya/ /gang zhig rmongs pas ma smin pa'i/ /rims la nad 'byin sman gtong ba/ /de ni sbrul nag gnyid log la/ /lag pa'i rtse mos reg dang mtshungs/ /rang gi dpyad ni ji skad bshad/ /gtar ka la sogs dag gis gso/ /gdon byung 'byung po'i rims par bshad/ / gtor ma sngags la sogs pas gso/ /byi la'i rtug pa la sogs dang*/ / shu dag ru rta a ru ra/ /gu gul nyungs dkar spos la sogs/ /dud pas bdug pas rims kun sel/ /sman dang nor bu sngags dang bcas pa dang | | dam pa bla ma bram ze dkon mchog mchod/ /yid ni dga' bar byed pa'i yul bsten pas/ khyab 'jug gis byas ma rung rims kyang 'joms || || le'u gnyis pa/ tsan dan gla sgang pu shel tse/ /'bras yos muṅga pi pi ling*/ /shing mngar nye shing kha ra dang*/ /sbrang rtsir bcas pas khrag mkhris 'joms/ /gang phyir skyegs bu dbugs mi bde/ /rgyu sogs mtshungs pas de yi phyir/ /gso ba'ang gcig ste des nyen la/ /thog mar dugs kyis nye bar spyad// //le'u dgu pa/ 'khru ba phal cher ma zhu ba'i/ /gnas brten me drod nyams pa las/ /'byung bas de phyir rlung gyur la'ang*/ /dang po smyung ba byas pas phan/ /rang nyid 'khru ba de la ni/

/btang snyoms bzhag pa de nyid sman/ /ma zhu 'khru la dang por ni/ /gcod pa'i sman ni btang mi bya | | le'u bcu pa/ pho ba la ni brten pa'i nad/ /ma zhu ba ltar gso bar bya || || le'u bco lnga pa/ sbyor ba kun gyi rjes la ni/ /'o ma nye bar sbyar bya ste | | lus zungs thams cad brtan byed cing*/ /stobs skyed nad ni lhag lus sel// //le'u nyer gcig pa/ ma 'dres rlung la dang por ni/ /mar dang rkang dang tshil dang ni/ /til mar blud cing snum gyi ni/ /sbyor bas legs par gso bar bya/ /gso ba'i gnas rdzogs so// //le'u dang po/ skyug sman mchog ni po so cha/ /dur byid rtsa ba bkru sman mchog/ //le'u gsum pa/ skyug sman drag la bkru sman btang*/ /bkru sman drag la slon du gzhug/ //le'u gsum pa/ dran pa 'thor la rig byed tshig / gi nga bu glu dbyangs mnyan du gzhug /lde gu sbrang rtsi mar bcas pa/ /mas gtong khu ba 'phel bar byed// //le'u drug pa/ sa phyogs cha mnyam gtsang zhing bzang*/ /shing chen lha gnas dūrbar ldan/ /g.yas nas chu 'bab sa bcud ldan/ /sman skyes pa ni bsngags pa yin/ /dge spyod dad ldan gtsang byas pas/ /sman ni legs par gnas pa btu/ /gangs can 'bigs byed ri yis ni/ /sa gzhi phal cher khyab pa yin/ /de las dang po bsil zhing phan/ /'bigs byed sman ni me'i rang bzhin// //le'u gnyis (bzhi )pa/ / gla sgang sle tres ba spru ba/ /btsod dang dong ga pu shel tse/ /ba ru ra dang po so cha/ /chur bskol bzhi char lus pa dang*// 'o ma dang bsres slar yang bskol/ /chu zad 'o ma lus pa la/ /sbrang rtsi shing mngar rgyam tsha dang*/ /dug nyung dur byid pi pi ling*/ /skyer khaṇḍa bsres 'jam rtsi ni/ /sha drod lus stobs khu ba skyed/ /'o ma sbrang rtsi mar btab pa/ /mas gtong rlung 'joms kha dog skyed/ /cho ga grub pa'i gnas rdzogs so// //lus kyi yan lag ste dang po/ /byis pa btsas ma thag phru ma/ / bsal te rgyam tsha mar bcas bsku/

/sor bzhi'i 'og tu lte ba bcad/ /ru rta til mar dag gis bsku/ /rgyu skar lha'am nye du las/ /dras pa'i ming ni btags par bya/ /ma ma'i phang du spro bsrings la/ /dgun gyi dus su rna ba dbug | byis pa rtag tu mi zad par/ /ngu ba las ni nar shes bya/ /gang du 'dzin cing reg mi bzod/ /de na nad yod shes par bya/ /rlung la sogs pa'i nad gzhom phyir/ /tshe blo yid gzhungs sman mar sbyin/ /tshul min skrag par mi bya ste/ /skrag na gdon ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /bdug pa rnams kyis bdug pa'am/ / sngags da nga khrus kyis 'byung po bsal/ / byis pa gso ba'i yan lag ste nyi shu gnyis pa'o// //le'u bzhi pa/ shes dang spyod dang rang bzhin 'gyur/ /de la 'byung po'i gdon yod bshad/ /sbyin sreg sngags gtor mchod sbyin rnams/ / phyin ci log tu byed pa dang*/ /chos lugs nyams dang gtsang sbra med/ /de la gdon gyis glags skabs tshol/ /'byung po'i 'tshe ba mi 'dod pas/ / bzlas dang sbyin sreg gtor ma dang*/ /brtul zhugs tshul khrims mnyam 'jog dang*/ /sbyin shes brtse la sogs pas bsal/ /shing kun ba bla tsha ba gsum/ / gla rtsi sgog skya shu dag dang*/ /spang spos sle tres nyungs dkar sogs | | gdon 'joms sman ni gzhan dag dang*/ /bong bu khyi rta lug byi la | | pags pa mkhris pa brun la sogs/ /sbyor ba 'dis bdug smyo byed dang | | rjed byed bcas pa'i gdon rnams 'joms/ /phal cher bkru sman skyug sman dag /gtang bas gdon yang zhi ba ste/ /lus ni dag par byas gyur na/ /yid ni dran pa rnyed par 'gyur/ /gdon gso ba'i yan lag ste le'u gsum pa'o// //le'u bcu gsum pa/ mig nad rab rib sngon por 'gyur/ / sngon po ma bcos long bar 'gyur/ /de bas mig nad la rab rib/ /mi bzad myur du gso bar bya/ /rlung 'khrugs pas na chu rgyu ba'i/ /rtsar song nas ni mchi ma 'dzag /ling tog sogs pa phal cher ni/ /'bras gsum sbrang rtsi mar bcas phan//

//le'u bcu drug pa/ lcags kyi snod du zangs ma ba gcin brdar/ / mig bskus gzer ni 'joms par byed pa yin/ /zangs ma'i snod du nu zho dung brdar ba/ /bskus na skrangs dang mchi ma 'dzag pa 'joms/ /ldong ros skyer pa'i khaṇḍa zangs ma yin/ /phye mas rdzi ma skyed cing tshag pa sel/ / rkang pa gnyis kyi bar na rtsa sbom po/ /gnyis nas de yis mig ni kun tu khyab | | de bskus byug dang dril ba la sogs pa/ /rkang par byas na mig tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /nyi ma gzas zin me 'od glog la sogs/ /bltas pas mig nyams bsil sman sogs kyis bcos/ /mig bsrung ba la rtag tu ma 'bad na/ /mi la nor yod gyur kyang don med yin/ /rkang pa'i rim gro bya sgong zhun mar bsten/ /mi 'phrod spang zhing rab phra 'tsher mi blta/ / le'u bco brgyad pa/ rlung las gyur pa'i rna nad la/ /sha khu mar ni mtshan mo blud/ /sgra bcas 'on pa dag la ni/ /rlung gi gzer 'joms sman gtang bya// //le'u nyer gnyis/ sna nad kun las dang por ni/ /snum 'chos sna bshal dud pa rngub/ /btsod dang seng phrom shug pa'i chus/ /bkrus na kha yi dri nga sel/ /shing kun nag mtshur byi tang ka /ru rta'i phye mas so zug 'joms// //le'u nyer gsum pa/ du ba nyin mtshan gnyid yar ba/ /chang 'thung smra mang mgo nad skyed/ /mgo ni rtsa ba yan lag ni/ /yal gar drang srong rnams kyis bshad/ /de phyir rtsa ba la gnod pa'i/ /nad ni myur du gso bar bya/ /lus kyi stod gso ba'i yan lag ste nyi shu bzhi pa'o// //le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ rma ni lhan cig skyes glo bur/ /red dang ma red dbye bas gnyis/ /nad gzhis bskyed dang lhan cig skyes/ /phyi yi rgyus byung glo bur ba'i/ /nad dang 'dres pa red pa yin/ /de med dag pa ma red pa'o/ /rma red kha rgyas sra ba'am snyi/ /mdog 'gyur dri mnam tsha'am grang*/ /skyon med rma la rma 'byor pa'i/ /sman dang sha skyed gang yin bya

| | ji skad bshad bzhin ma grub na/ /de ni me yis bsregs la bcos// 'phral gyi rma ni rgya che la/ /sbrang dang mar bsku bsil bcos bya// //le'u sum cu pa/ rmen bu ma smin pa la ni/ /rang rang skrangs pa'i nad ltar gso/ /chag grugs dbye bas du mar 'gyur/ /de dag kun gyi gso ba ni/ /ji ltar 'tshams pa de bzhin du/ /bcing ba dag kyang legs par bya/ /cha byad kyis gso ba'i yan lag ste lnga pa'o// //le'u so lnga pa/ sngon ni lha dang lha ma yin/ /bdud rtsi 'dod pas bsrubs pa na/ /bdud rtsi'i sngon du skyes bu ni/ /'jigs gzugs mche ba can byung ste/ /de mthong 'gro ba sdug bsngal gyur/ /des na 'di ni dug ces bya// //le'u so drug pa/ 'bras gsum shing mngar nā ga puṣa/ /zangs rtsi pu shel utpal/ /shug pa sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba/ /skrang dang 'brum pa sbrul dug sel// //le'u so brgyad pa/ srin bu sdig pa mi zad dug /'bus zin sbrul gyis zin ltar gso/ /sbrang ma gdug pa'i dug kun la/ /zho dang mar ni blud par bya/ /gtar ka gdab cing sna sman dang*/ /mig sman gyi ni cho ga bya | khyim gyi dud pa skyer pa dang*/ /rgyam tshwa dang ni btsod dag gi /lde gus lte ba 'bur 'joms dang*/ /byi ba'i dug kun sel bar byed/ /mche ba can gyi dug gso ba'i yan lag ste drug pa'o// //le'u so dgu pa/ tshe ring dran dang yid gzhungs dang*/ /nad med gzhon dang lang tsho dang*/ /gzugs bzang mdog dang skad gsal dang*/ / lus dang dbang po'i stobs skyed cing*/ /tshig grub ro tsa mdangs ldan pa/ / bcud kyis len gyis 'thob par 'gyur// //snum bcos bya zhing gtar ka gdab/ /rnam pa kun tu sbyang byas gtong | | ma sbyangs pa yi lus la ni/ /bcud kyis len dang ro tsa yi/ / sbyor byas dri ma can gyi ni/ /gos kyi tshon ltar don med 'gyur/ /rtsa ba lnga dang ar skyur dag /chur bskol bcu cha lus pa la/ /shing tsha sug smel pi pi ling*/

/ga dur skyer pa a ru ra/ /shang ka puṣpa tsandan dang*/ /shing mngar ka ra byi tang ka /mar dang til mar sbrang rtsir sbyang*/ /cha snyoms bsten pa'i bcud len gyis/ /snyoms dang skra dkar gnyer ma spong*/ /tshe ring yid gzhungs stobs skyed 'gyur/ /gze ma 'bras bu skyed pa rtsa bar bcas | | grib skam byas nas btags shing sbangs pa yi/ khu ba 'o ma dang bcas bsten byas na/ /drod skyed mdangs ldan lo brgya thub par 'gyur// sgra gcan bdud rtsi brkus pa na/ / ske bcad pa las 'dzag gyur pa'i/ / bdud rtsi sa la lhung gyur pa/ /sgog skya nyid du gyur pa yin/ /lha min lus las byung bas na/ /de phyir bram zes de mi za/ /mngon sum( sngan du )bdud rtsi las byung bas/ /de ni bcud kyis len mchog yin/ /sos ka'i tsha bas gdungs brag las/ /rgya skyegs khu ba ltar 'dzag gang*/ /ba gcin dri bro gnag pa dang*/ /gu gul 'dra zhing gseg ma med/ /brag zhun de ni mchog yin te/ /nad ni kun la phan pa yin/ /'o ma dang ni lhan cig btang | | bcud len 'bras bu 'grub par 'gyur/ /gang zhig brag zhun gyis ni mngon sum du/ /ma bsal nad ni sa steng yod ma yin/ /brag zhun mar dang sbrang rtsi byi tang ka /'bras bu gsum dang lcags phye dngul chu bsten

| | rma bya lta bur mdangs ldan yid 'ong zhing*/ /yar ngo zla phyed rdzogs pa'i zla ba 'dra/ /bu ram sbrang rtsi tsha ba gsum/ /a ru ra bsten lo brgya 'tsho/ /gze ma sle tres skyu ru ra/ /sbrang rtsi mar bcas de bzhin no/ / bden par smra zhing khro ba med/ /dbang po bsdams shing bdag nyid thul// zhi zhing dam pa'i spyod la dga'/ /rtag tu bcud len yin zhes bya/ /rgas sra bar bya ba'i yan lag ste bdun pa'o// //le'u bzhi bcu pa/ gcig pu skyon ni med pa yi/ /tshangs par spyod la bdag yi rang*/ /lus ni zad pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /ro tsa'i cho ga brjod pa yin/ /de nas snum gyur sbyang bya zhing*/ /ni ru ha dang 'jam rtsi dang*/ / pi pi ling dang skyu ru ra'i/ khu ba sbrang rtsi mar bcas pa/ /zos rjes 'o ma 'thungs pa gang*/ /mi de brgyad cu lon na yang*/ /lang tshor gnas phyir 'dod spyod 'gyur/ /shing mngar mar dang sbrang rtsi dang*/ /ba yi 'o ma'ang de bzhin no//ra thug rlig pa 'o mar btsos/ /til mar dang ni bsres pa yi// ka ra bcas zos gang yin pa/ /bud med brgya la'ang spyod par nus/ /zho spris kha ra bcas zos pa/ /rgan po'ang gzhon nu bzhin du spyod/ /mngar snum nyams dga' brtas byed pa/ /'o ma bzhos ma thag 'thung na/ /lug bong lta bur spyod par nus/ /de dag thams cad ro tsar bshad/ / gla sgang parpa ta ni rims la phan/ / sko ma dad che la gyo mo chur gdus pa'i/ / thang phan chu so'i nad la brag zhun no/ /slon la 'bras yos gcin snyi kyu ru ra/ /rlung dang bad kan la ni a ru ra/ /mcher pa'i nad la pi ling mchog yin te/ /glo brdol ba la rgya skyegs khu ba bsngags/ khrag mkhris nad la ba sha ka yis phan/ /'khru ba'i nad la dug mo nyung phan zhing*/ /tsho ches pa la skyer khaṇḍa yang bsngags/ /srin bu'i nad ni byi tang ka yis 'joms || mig gi nad la 'bras bu gsum phan te/ /dreg la sle tres mdze la seng ldeng mchog /nad kun la ni brag zhun bsngags pa yin/

/pho ba'i nad la dar ba gsar pa bsngags/ /smyo byed sogs la mar rnying btang bya zhing | | mya ngan la ni chang ni blud pas phan/ /gnyid med 'o ma cham par zho dkrugs phan/ /rlung gi nad la sgog skya rab tu bsngags/ /yan lag rengs pa'i nad ni dugs kyis sel/ /mgo bo'i nad kun la ni sna sman bsngags | | brgyal la chu grang gcig snyi gze mas sel/ /rgas sra 'o ma zhun mar 'bras bu gsum/ /de ltar nad rnams la ni sman gyi mchog /yul dus ci rigs brtags te sbyar bar bya/ /rgyud phyi ma'i gnas ro tsa dang gso spyad kyi yan lag ste brgyad pa'o// //sman spyad gzhung lugs rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las/ /yan lag brgyad bsdus bdud rtsi'i tshogs thob gang*/ /de las don chen rtsol ba zhan pa rnams/ /dga' bar bya phyir rgyud 'di logs shig byas/ /'di ni tshe yi rig byed rgya mtsho yi/ /snying po las ni snying po blangs nas su/ / rnam par sbyar las dge ba gang thob pa/ /de yis 'gro bas bde chen nyid thob shog | yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ / 'dir mdzad byang mi gsal yang*/ dpal sa skya'i dpe mdzod du sa paṇa gyi bka' 'bum bris ma dpe rnying pod 'ga' bzhugs pa'i nang nas ( ḍa ) rtags can gyi stod kyi cha la bzhugs shing ldeb grangs nyer bdun bzhugs/ spyi'i ang grangs sum cu so gnyis nas lnga bcu nga brgyad bar yin pa/ 'di nyid snag shog dang yig gzugs tshang ma dpe tshan gzhan dang gcig gyur yin pa dang*/ pod de'i nang sa paṇa gyi gsung ma gtogs med pa sogs la brtags na/ thog mar bka' 'bum bsgrig dus nas bkod par the tshom med pas mdzad pa po sa skya paṇḍi ta yin nges so// // ༄༅/ /sa skya paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i pra khrid khra bo dang*/ zur rgyan nyams ky-i me long dang*/ gnyer ltag gnya' stong gzigs kyis bstan pa'i rin chen zung drug bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ kun la 'jug pa'i pra khrid khra bo zhes bya ba/

gzer bu chung nyi shu rtsa lnga'i zur rgyan dang bcas pa/ dmar byang thor bu khrigs kyi me long*/ dri ma dang bral ba'i mkhas pa chen po rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir rigs dang*/ blo dang*/ bag yod dang ldan pa'i skyes bu gang dang gang dag gis/ rang gi rgyud la yon tan gyi tshogs 'phel zhing | nyes skyon dri ma dag par 'dod pas/ rig pa lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'i don shes par bya ste/ de yang gzhi la gnas par bya ba'i rig pa bco brgyad/ lam du 'khyer ba'i rig pa bco brgyad/ 'bras bu 'byung ba'i rig pa bco brgyad do/ /dang po ni/ rang la gces pa drug gzhan la gces pa drugaganyis ka la gces pa drug go /dang po rang la gces pa drug ni/ gzhung tshugs ltar thub/ bkan na mkhrang*/ bstun na mnyen/ 'grogs na brling*/ byed na yang*/ bsgyur na lci ba'o/ /gzhan la gces pa drug ni/ sha tsha/ gnyen 'khur/ zur chung*/ yus la mi len/ brten na bde/ 'gras na gtum pa'o/ /gnyis ka la gces pa drug ni/ pho tshod che/ gnag la len/ rdzu khog che/ mthar phyin/ ngan gros khegs/ bzang gros bskul ba'o/ / gnyis pa lam du 'khyer ba'i rig pa bco brgyad ni/ legs kyang spang bar bya ba drug nyes kyang blang bar bya ba drug rang sar bzhag pa drug go / dang po drug ni ma bcol ba'i gnyer/ mi theg pa'i khur/ mi 'grub pa'i khas len/ tshul ma yin pa'i spyod pa/ dri mar gyur pa'i bya byed/ rang che bsgrub pa'i zhe bzhag go /nyes kyang blang bar bya ba drug ni/ bla ma'i gsung | bde gshegs kyi bka'/ mched grogs kyi mchid/ mkhas pa'i gtam/ sha tsha'i gros/ lugs la brten pa'i las so/ /rang sar bzhag pa drug ni/ gzhan gyi skyon mi gleng rang sar bzhag bcos kyang nyan du mi 'dod pa'i gros rang sar bzhag shes gsar mchog tu bkal ba'i gros rang sar bzhag khe nyen gzhan la thug pa'i gros rang sar bzhag sman pa che 'gran byed pa'i gros rang sar bzhag dus min rtsing spyod byed pa'i mi rang sar bzhag go

/gsum pa 'bras bu 'byung ba'i rig pa bco brgyad ni/ ma spangs na log pa'i 'bras bu 'byung ba drug spyad na bde ba'i 'bras bu 'byung ba drug tshul bstun na bde legs kyi 'bras bu 'byung ba drug go /dang po drug ni/ bsam pa ngan pa ma spangs na log pa'i 'bras bu 'byung*/ grogs ngan pa ma spangs na log pa'i 'bras bu 'byung*/ sbyor ba ngan pa ma bshol na log pa'i 'bras bu 'byung*/ gdug rtsub dang rtsing chos la dga' na log pa'i 'bras bu 'byung*/ yang dag pa'i don la the tshom za ba'am rgyab kyis phyogs na log pa'i 'bras bu 'byung*/ sdig pa'i grogs pos zin na log pa'i 'bras bu 'byung nges so/ /spyad na bde ba'i 'bras bu ('byung ba )drug ni/ bka' bzhin spyad na bde ba'i 'bras bu 'byung*/ gzhung bzhin bsgrubs na bde ba'i 'bras bu 'byung*/ g.yo sgyu dang bral na bde ba'i 'bras bu 'byung*/ tshul 'chos bskyur na bde ba'i 'bras bu 'byung*/ mngon zhen thongs na bde ba'i 'bras bu 'byung skad/ ('di'i nang nas gcig chad 'dug)tshul bstun na gnas skabs kyi bde legs 'byung ba drug ni/ mkhas pa dang tshul bstun na yon tan gyi rdul 'gos | btsun pa dang tshul bstun na bag med kyi dri ma 'dagamadzangs pa dang tshul bstun na legs nyes kyi 'phrag so la brgal/ drin can dang tshul bstun na phyis nas rang drin/ dad ldan dang tshul bstun na bsod nams kyi las sog blo ldan dang tshul bstun na rig pa'i sna kha skye'o// //༈ gzer bu chung nyi shu rtsa lnga'i zur rgyan ni/ thun mong gi gzer bcu | thun mong ma yin pa'i gzer bcu/ khyad par gyi gzer lnga'o/ /thun mong gi gzer bcu la/ rang mgo thon pa'i gzer lnga/ nyams par 'gyur ba'i gzer lnga'o/ /rang mgo thon pa'i gzer lnga ni/ sngar gyi mdza' bshes sun ma phyung pa/ rang gzhung la 'gyur ldog med pa/ ya rabs kyi thugs ma brad pa/ ma rabs ras su ma chad pa/ gnas skabs kyi gros la 'dor len shes pa'o/

/nyams par 'gyur ba'i gzer lnga ni/ rang gi che bzang 'ba' zhig bsgrub/ gzhan ras su bcad cing mgo gnon pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa/ gros mgo thabs la 'then pa/ gros gzhug rang 'dod du bsgrub pa/ tshul dang tshul ma yin pa mi shes pa'o/ /kye ho/ des na | rnam smin gyis ma gos na 'jigs kyi mchog rang bdud du rang ma babs na spyang po'i mchog chos tsam sems la rdzogs na grung po'i mchog yon tan rang la shar na gter gyi mchog 'grogs rgu'i thugs su byon na grogs kyi phul lo/ /kye ho/ nges par dgongs shig rigs kyi bu/ tshe 'di don 'dun dang phugs nas ma bral na rin po che'i gter la spyod kyang bde skyid yod re skan/ rang sems nga bdag gi mdud pa ma bral na/ sum cu rtsa gsum du skyes kyang bde skyid yod re skan/ rang la bla ma'i byin rlabs ma zhugs na bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzoms kyang bde legs yod re skan/ nges par dam tshig nyams na dga' ba'i tshal la spyod kyang bde skyid yod re skan/ kye ho/ tshe 'di rab tu mi brtan glog bzhin myur du las dbang 'gro | | bdag gi ming yang mi gnas de tshe 'byor pa'i 'tsho bas ci bgyir mchis | | bdag ni chu srin khar tshud thar pa'i rang stobs ma mchis ya ngar ltung*/ /de tshe 'dren pa'i lcags kyus snying la zin pas nyer 'tsho shog/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gzer bcu ni/ bsam pa thun mong ma yin pa lnga/ spyod pa thun mong ma yin pa lnga'o/ /dang po ni/ tshe 'di la blo mi gtod/ gros phugs bla ma dang dkon mchog mkhyen/ lus srog chos phyogs su bsngo| bskal pa 'khrugs kyang lam log pa la mi 'gro/ srid gsum g.yos kyang khu 'phrig mi skye ba'o/ /spyod pa thun mong ma yin pa lnga ni/ dge bar 'gyur na sdig kyang byed/ gzhan don du 'gyur na rang don kyang bsgrub| yon tan 'char na skyon la yang spyod/ skyon gyis gos na yon tan yang 'gegs so/ ( 'di'i nang nas gcig chad/

)khyad par gyi gnad gzer lnga ni/ legs ldeng pa'i gros la blo mi 'gyur/ byams ldeng pa'i grogs po sun mi dbyung*| bslu ldeng pa'i gros la blo mi gtod/ bde ldeng pa'i nyams len le lor mi 'jog gtsang ldeng pa'i rig pa 'khrul par mi bzhag go /kye des na/ rang dma' ma dbab/ rang gnya' ma bcag rang 'phung ma bsham| rang mgo ma bskor/ rang stab ma dbub/ spyir sman pa mkhas pa na dang mi na ba gnyis ka la phan/ yul mi tshod can dgra dang gnyen gnyis ka la gces/ gzhon nu sdug pa pho dang mo gnyis ka la mdzes/ de bzhin du chos pa rab kyis bdag gzhan gnyis ka la phan/ 'bring gis rang la phan la gzhan la mi gnod/ tha mas rang gzhan thams cad la gnod | de lta bas na/ bya ba gang ci bsgrub kyang rung ste/ bstan pa spyi la phan pa'am/ gang zag sgos la phan pa spyad par 'os kyi/ de lta ma yin pa'i bya ba/ spyad par bya ba ma yin zhing*/ sbrul dug can sa phyogs nas spong ba ltar bya'o/ /de'i phyir/ dmar byang thor bu khrigs kyi me long dgod par bya ste/ de yang gcig gsum gsum/ gnyis gsum drug gsum gsum dgu/ bzhi gsum bcu gnyis/ lnga gsum bco lnga/ drug gsum bco brgyad/ bdun gsum nyer gcig brgyad gsum nyer bzhi | dgu gsum nyer bdun/ bcu gsum sum cu tham pa ste/ sde bcu ya ba brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi'i (lnga'i ) gdams pa 'bul bas/ thugs la nye bar bzhag par zhu'i ang*// //༈ dang po gcig gsum gsum gyi gdams pa ni/ go chod na mi gcig gis chog blo gtad thub na grogs gcig gis chog rang rgyud grol na chos gcig gis chog go /gnyis pa/ gnyis gsum drug gi gdams pa ni/ dad pa dang shes rab/ dam tshig dang sdom pa/ ngo tsha dang khrel yod/ zung gsum ya ba drug po des rtag tu gnas par bya'o/ / gsum pa/ gsum gsum dgu'i gdams pa ni/ drang brtan bstun du btub pa'i bsam pa/ grung bde mthar phyin pa'i spyod pa/ dge legs lugs dang mthun pa'i mthun 'jug go

/bzhi pa/ bzhi gsum bcu gnyis kyi gdams pa ni/ skyid na skyid zur gzhan la mi gnod pa/ sdug na sdug yus gzhan la mi 'gel ba/ legs na legs gong brgal du ma shor ba | nyes na nyes shan mi la mi 'gel ba dang bzhi/ bden pa yus kyis ma khyer ba/ mdzangs pa 'gag gis ma bsgribs pa/ spyang po sgrin gyis ma bslad pa/ drung po 'thoms kyis ma bcad pa dang bzhis gros la dpyad long yod pa'o/ /rang gzhung la 'gyur mi tshol ba/ gzhan gzhung 'phrul gyis skyobs pa/ phan pa khyad du mi gsod pa/ gnod la ngan lan mi 'jal ba dang bzhis gros gnad du phog par 'gyur ba'o/ /lnga pa/ lnga gsum bco lnga'i gdams pa ni/ gzhan mgo 'dren pa la rang skyon gyis ma gos pa gces/ rang skyon 'don pa la bzang 'dod med pa gces/ bzang po drang las byung bas kha gting med pa gces/ drang po rang 'dod dang bral ba las byung bas mngon zhen thong ba gces/ mngon zhen bdag 'dzin las byung bas rang rgyud grol ba gces te lnga/ gnas skabs dran pas zin pa| mthar thug blo thag chod pa/ dus tshod 'phen len shes pa/ nang mgo phyir la mi 'don pa/ phyi skyon nang du mi sgrogs pa dang lnga/ bzang lan ngan gyis mi 'jal ba/ bden pa brdzun gyis mi gsub pa/ dge las sdig gis mi gsub pa/ gzhan gyi yon tan la skur ba mi 'debs pa/ rang gi yon tan rgyal mtshan du mi 'phyar ba dang lnga'o/ /drug pa/ drug gsum bco brgyad kyi gdams pa ni/ gzhan che phrag tu mi shong*/ rang che blo ru mi shong*/ yus che rdzu ru mi shong*/ gros che sgam la mi shong*/ gnyer che khur la mi shong | 'gag chen shes rig la mi shong na mi chen por mi 'gyur ba'i 'gag drug go /nyes kyang bcos su btub pa/ pham yang 'bab sa yod pa/ med kyang btsal du rnyed pa/ bsags pa byur du mi yong ba/ bsten pa dgra ru mi ldang ba/ phan 'dogs gnod par mi 'gyur ba dang drug med na 'phrus che bar mi 'gyur te/

'gag la ga ༵༷pa'i 'gag drug go /mi rgod dgra ru bltas na bltas pa rang gi dgra mi ldang ba/ blo rgod lag tu blangs pa rang la 'gyod pa mi len pa/ khyo stes ldang rgod gnyen dang mi mi go chod ngan mtha' la mi 'don bsdo ba/ khyi rgod btsan gyis ma khyer ba/ g.yag rgod mi rgod 'og tu mi gzhug pa sbra 'dabs mi bzhug pa/ rta rgod yon tan don med du mi 'don pa rong la mi bskul ba dang drug bco brgyad med na/ bag dang mi ldan pas phog thug 'byung ba'i gegs so/ /bdun pa/ bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig gi gdams pa ni/ mdzangs kyi ngag bsnyen/ mkhas la blo bsdur/ rang pham rang gis long*/ sha tsha dgra la yang ma btang*/ gtam brlang po pha la yang ma smra/ spyod pa brlang po khyi la yang ma byed/ mdun gros brling po 'dre la yang mi shom pa dang bdun ni/ phyis 'gyod par mi 'gyur ba'i gros bdun no | | gzhan mtshang 'dru la dga' na 'khor mtshang rang la gnod/ gros gsar byed la brtson na brtson bdud rang la 'bab/ gros ngan shom la dga' na/ shom mkhan rang btab 'bub/ zang zing nor la dga' na bar chad bdud kyis 'dzin/ khengs grags g.yeng bas brid na mi tshe stong par skyel

| yul gyi gnas la zhen na gzung 'dzin sgrog gis 'ching/ don med grogs la dga' na rang mgo rang gis 'tshog ste/ bdun po 'di dag ni mthar 'gyod par 'gyur ba'i gros bdun no/ /nges par ngo shes kyang nyan snying mi 'dod pa/ dman par skyon tshor yang bshol snying mi 'dod pa/ dug tu ngo shes kyang mi gnod du re/ sman du ngo shes kyang mi phan gyi dogs/ dgra ru ngo shes kyang 'bros ma nus/ chos su ngo shes kyang zur la lus/ chos min du ngo shes kyang brid yangs la lus/ bdun po 'di dag ni zlog thabs med pa'i gros nyes 'byung ba'i gnas bdun no/ /brgyad pa/ brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gdams ngag la/ g.yang 'byung ba'i rdzas brgyad | byur 'khor ba'i dus brgyad/ byur ma g.yang gi sa brgyad do/ / dang po g.yang 'byung ba'i rdzas brgyad ni/ go chod 'khor du bsten na g.yang 'byung*/ drag po bshes su bsten na g.yang 'byung*/ tshod can gros su bsten na g.yang 'byung*/ gnag can la phan btags na g.yang 'byung*/ shes rig can la blo gtad na g.yang 'byung*/ ya rabs rnams kyi thugs zin na g.yang 'byung*/ /bzang po spyod ngan gyis ma bslad na g.yang 'byung nges so/ /( 'di'i nang gcig chad/ )byur 'khor ba'i dus brgyad ni/ rang la rang gis thong (mthong )na byur 'khor/ mtshang can blo sna mang na byur 'khor/ dbul po tshong skyong mang na byur 'khor/ drag po tshod ma zin na byur 'khor | phyug po dos drag na byur 'khor/ mkhas pa rloms ches na byur 'khor | btsun po bzang 'dod ches na byur 'khor/ grung po grung snyems ches na byur 'khor (ro)/ /byur ma g.yang gi sa brgyad ni/ yul ngad can byur ma g.yang gi sa/ nor sdig can byur ma g.yang gi sa/ grogs mdzes ma byur ma g.yang gi sa/ pha tshan che na byur ma g.yang gi sa/ rang mgo 'tsho ma shes na byur ma g.yang gi sa/ yon tan skyong ma shes na byur ma g.yang gi sa | 'bangs sgo drag skyong ma shes na byur ma g.yang gi sa/

jo bo ngan pa bsten ma shes na byur ma g.yang gi sa'o/ /dgu pa/ dgu gsum nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi gdams pa ni/ mtshan nyid dgu/ dper brjod dgu / lung bstan dgu'o/ /dang po mtshan nyid dgu ni/ bzang po'i mtshan nyid gsum | ngan pa'i mtshan nyid gsum/ ti ma bcol gyi mtshan nyid gsum mo | | bzang po gsum ni/ shes la zur mi 'dod de kha bzang du ma shor ba | bzang lan la zur bslus mi byed de ngan du ma shor ba/ gang gis kyang sgo ma 'gags la tshor ngas mi byed pas kun tu bzang po'i bzang ngo*// ngan pa'i mtshan nyid gsum ni/ ngan bcos su mi btub pa khyi lud lta bu 'khon 'thab med par thabs kyis spang*/ ngan bcos su btub pa dri ma lta bu | sha la bcar la lam du gzhug ngan bzang po'i rgyur 'gro ba rta'i g.yag chags lta bu bstar nas brtul bas go chod du 'gyur ba'o/ /ti ma bcol gyi mtshan nyid gsum ni/ khyu rigs rang dga'i phyogs su gtong ba/ rigs brgyud rang bde'i rigs su srol ba/ yon tan gang dran gyi phyogs su slob pas te/ de dag ni dgag sgrub med par rang sar bzhag ste bsgrub pa'o/ /dper brjod dgu ni/ bzang po rab nor bu rin po che dang 'dra ste/ gang du gnas pa'i phyogs la phan/ bzang po 'bring tsan dan gyi dri dang 'dra ste/ gang dang 'grogs pa la yon tan 'go /bzang po tha ma sman pa mkhas pa dang 'dra ste/ mgu na phan 'dogs/ ma mgu na gnod mi skyel/ ngan pa rab khyi lud kyi phung po dang 'dra ste/ gang nye ba la dri ma dku | ngan pa 'bring lha srung dang 'dra ste/ res phan pa snyam byed la/ res gnod pa snyam byed/ ngan pa tha ma gser gyi g.ya' dang 'dra ste/ bcos na bzang por 'gyur la/ ma bcos na ngan thog tu ldang ba'o/ /ti ma bcol rab brid na skyed yong*/ 'bring la skyed byung yang mi brtan/ tha ma la brid na 'phar nas 'gro la/ bsdigs na yar nas 'gro'o | | lung bstan dgu ni/ rab kyi rab de rang gzhan thams cad la phan pas sangs rgyas kyi rgyu ru lung bstan/

'bring gzhan la mi gnod pas chos kyi rgyu ru lung bstan | tha ma legs nyes kyi shan phyed pas mi dpon du lung bstan/ 'bring gi rab kha lo bar lung bstan/ 'bring gi 'bring mngag gzhug par lung bstan/ 'bring gi tha ma mngag gzhug pa'i gnyer bskul bar lung bstan | tha ma'i rab bang chen par lung bstan/ 'bring las phran gyi dbang bskur la mngag tha ma sun ma phyung bar spang bar byas te/ rtsig rdo mkhal ma lta bu bor bar bya/ /grogs po dug sbrul lta bu rnam par spang || las mkhan srung ma lta bu bsten mi bya/ /mkhas par rig par gyis la spang blang bya'o/ /zhes pa ni tshigs su bcad pa'i rgyan no/ /tha ma bcu pa/ bcu pa gsum gyi gdams pa ni/ chos bzhin spyod pa'i rgyu bcu/ chos dang 'gal bar spyod pa'i rgyu bcu/ ti ma bcol du spyod pa'i rgyu bcu'o/ /dang po chos bzhin spyod pa'i rgyu bcu ni/ rgyu lnga/ tshul lnga'o/ /rgyu lnga ni/ chos 'byung ba'i rgyu dad pa che ba/ brtan pa'i rgyu 'gyur ldog chung ba/ yon tan 'gos pa'i rgyu bslab pa la nyan pa/ mthar phyin pa'i rgyu snying rus che ba/ khyad par 'phags pa'i rgyu rig pa rno ba'o/ /tshul lnga ni/ mkhas pa'i tshul mi 'dor ba/ dman pa'i tshul mi 'dzin pa/ bzang la che 'gran mi byed pa/ ngan pa roX tshod mi byed pa/ rgyud la gyong khengs med pa'o/ /chos dang 'gal bar spyod pa la yang*/ rgyu lnga dang*/ tshul lnga las/ rgyu lnga ni/ bsam pa yang zhing bsgyur sla ba/ mngon zhen che zhing nyon mongs rags pa/ the tshom che zhing blo mi thub pa/ 'dod yon bsten zhing gnyen po chung ba/ rang gis ro ma myong bar gzhan la ston pa la brtson pa'o/ /tshul lnga ni/ bzang tshul/ mkhas tshul/ sgom tshul/ rtogs tshul/ brtse tshul/ don las gzugs brnyan du ma shor bar bya'o/ /ti ma gcod du 'gyur ba'i rgyu ni mang (du )snang ste 'dir rgyas par ma bkod do/ /de rnams/ legs la legs pa'i tshul gyi blangs byas te/

/nyes la nyes pa'i tshul gyis spang bya ang*/ / 'di yis shes rab ldan pa'i sgron mar ni/ /'gyur byed de bas thugs la zhog cig kye/ kye/ stag la zhon/ go mtshon stor/ spyang khu zhon/ sman sgye phrag la khol la/ lung pa stong pa na yar bzhud la/ phyi la ldog pa'i bsam pa ma bcang ang*/ phyir mig ma lta zhig a ho/ -ithi// //༄༅/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*/ /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rnams la ni/ /rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngag bden pa'i tshig blo la mda' bzhin du 'jug par gyur cig bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa'i drin nam mkha' dang mnyam pa 'di yi drin las/ nyams su blangs pas khyer ba lags pas rtag tu ma spangs par nyams su long ang*/ rang gi sems nyid nor bu rin po che 'di yi yon tan da lta nyid du dngos su 'byin ma nus na 'bras bu yid smon du 'chor ba lags pas | blo mthar gyis thon par mdzod dang ang*/ dus dman zhig spyod pa rtsing pa'i dus 'di ru/ rang rgyud 'khrul phyir 'brang ba mi tshor ba'i nyen gda' bas/ dran pa'i lcags kyus zungs dang ang*/ go ba la gsal 'grib med pa snyam byed kyang*/ blo rkun bu'i dbang du shor ba mi tshor ba'i nyen gda' bas/ rig pa rang sar thon dang ang*/ sems kyi tshogs 'khrul ba'i 'dam du bying ba 'di rnams la/ ltos sa byang chub sems min pa mi bdog pas/ thugs rjes nges par skyobs dang ang*/ thog mar rang gi shes rgyud rengs na/ byin rlabs kyi bka' babs chad pa lags pas | rang rgyud kyi skyon la rtog dang ang*/ rang nyid 'khrul ba'i steng na gnas bzhin da rung ma 'khrul snyam byed cing*/ 'khrul pa rkun thabs su 'chor ba mi tshor ba'i nyen gda' bas/ rtag tu mdo rgyud bla ma bsten dang ang | da res dus 'di la las mjug ma rdzogs na/ cis kyang phan par mi 'gyur bas/ sems nyid 'gyur med du gtan la phob dang ang*/ lta ba'i gdeng gis zin pa snyam byed pa la/

blo bag med kyis 'dod yon rang rgyud par shor bar mi tshor ba'i nyen gda' bas/ gang snang ba'i thog tu rdo rus sprod dang ang*/ dgos med dang khrel med kyi blo 'di gnas skabs kyi snying rje la 'khris nas/ chags sdang rang rgyud par 'gro ba mi tshor ba'i nyen gda' bas/ blo 'khris med du skyong dang ang*/ tshe 'di'i chos dang 'brel ba'i gros thams cad bzhag pa rang gis 'grub pa las/ bskyang bzhin spyad na snam bu tsher gseb tu drud pa ltar/ sdug bsngal rang la 'go nyen gda' bas/ ci dga' rang du skyur dang ang*/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i tshe na/ rang gi blo skyon med du gnas par rang gis 'drongs par 'gyur ba las/ rtsol bas 'bad na ris su bcad pa'i phrin las kyis bdag 'ching bar 'gyur bas/ sems can rang bzhin gyis 'dul bar rigs par byos dang ang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ gdams ngag 'debs pa'i tshe/ rang gis nyams su myong zhing*/ nges par gyur par sbyar bar bya ba'i phyir bya yi/ de lta ma yin zhing tshad mas ma non pa'i sbyar bar gyur na/ sems cad chos kyis bslus par 'gyur te/ gal te sems can gcig bslus skyor du bcug par gyur na/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bla ma dang bcas pa de dag bslus par 'gyur bas na | tshad ma la sbyar ba la 'bad par bgyi'o ang*/ blang ba ma mos pas byang chub kyi sems 'di skye dka' la/ nyams pa sla bar gda' bas/ blo rkyen du mi 'chor bar/ gzhung tshugs par byang chub la gnas par byos dang ang*/ tshe 'di'i che bzang gi zla snyeg pa'i blo byung yang*/ nges par bdud kyis brlabs pa'i bsam pa dri ma can yin pas rang nyid dman pa'i tshul gyis nyams kyi zhun mthar la long ang*/ dga' snyam byed pa dang | bde ba dang legs par mthong ba'i tshe/ tshe 'di'i 'dun ma rgyud la shar nas/ de'i rjes su blo 'brang zhing 'dug na/ nges par 'khrul ba dang bcas pas/

dam tshig nyams pa lta bur blta bar bya'o ang*/ ༈ /kye chos zab sa na 'dre nyen gda'/ blangs na 'khrul nyen gda'o/ /mi chos kyis slu nyen gda'o/ /lha gnyan sa nas bdud 'bab nyen gda'o/ /jo bo bzang sa nasaX 'bab nyen gda' bas/ bag ldan du dgongs shig gal te bdag gis go chod par ma gyur na/ bstan pa rin po che 'di 'bral bar 'gyur ram mi 'gyur brtag dpyad thong*/ da res kyi bka' brgyud 'di dang 'dzol shor na/ phyis bskal par yang gsang sngags dang 'phrad dam mi 'phrad brtag dpyad thong*/ nya chu nang nas ma sod na/ shing kha nas mi sod de/ da res dus la bab ma bab brtag dpyad thong*/ yong ye chos med na cis kyang bslu zhing yid 'byung ba'i rgyur 'dug gam mi 'dug brtag dpyad thong*/ gang la blo gtad cing su la yid ches byas kyang mthar bslu brid kyi sdug bsngal du 'dug pa de 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid du 'dug gam mi 'dug brtag dpyad thong*/ de ltar bas na/ 'phags pa yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar bshad pa'i mdo las/ nye bar gdams te gsungs pa 'khor ba'i skyon gyis gzings pa nyes pa mtha' yas ldan pa'i khyim thab spangs nas rtag tu nor tshe 'di'i nor dang longs spyod la mi lta bas so/ / yon tan ldan pa 'i mi de bas de dag skyon de rig pa sems rab tu mi g.yeng bar dgon par dga' zhing sems mi rgod par dbang po dul/ gang zag de dag gang du'ang bud med rnams dang gnas dang dus thams cad du skyes pa rnams su 'dres mi byed/ bse ru lta bu ra gcig pur gnas shing nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog bsam pa dri med dag pa dri ma bral/ chos nyid de dag rnyed pa thob pa rnams kyi sa sems 'phar te dga' bar mi 'gyur ma thob pas kyang yid zhum med/ de rtag tu chos la sems pa'o/ /des na 'ad ོ da pa chung ste yo byad ngan ngon tsam la dga' zhing tshim rgyu (sgyu )dang mi chos kyi tshul 'chos spangs

te lhag par bsgrub pa'i/ de nyid rtag tu sems can don gyi phyir brtson 'grus rtsom pa'i yid dang ldan pa sbyin dang dul ba la yang sems gnas pa'o/ /sems can kyi don du 'gro na lus dang de bzhin srog la mi lta sdug pa'i rtsa lag bshes gnyen dang yo byad rnams spangs te ma chags pa'o// rkyen gyis bkrir mi btub pas bsam pa rdo rje lta bur rab tu ston dus rtag tu lus ngag gi bya ba ci yin thams cad byang chub la sbyor ro/ / chos kyi don du 'gro na lus ni dum bur gcad kyang sdug bsngal de dag la sems la g.yo ba med de chos la nges par sems pa'i bzod pa'o/ /'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad mkhyen nyid sems can gyi re ba bskang ba'i phyir sgyid lug med par brtson 'grus shin tu brtan (pa )'di rtsom mo/ /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yang klu'i rgyal po rnga sgra'i tshigs su bcad pa las/ phongs pa'i dus su mi rtag khengs/ /chog med nga rgyal gang yin spongs/ /'bras bu ngan po'i khro ba gang yin spongs*/ /phongs pa'i dus su mi lta'i grogs po gang yin spongs/ /byas gzo med pa'i gnyen 'dra gang yin spongs/ /'dod chags tshim pa med pa'i zas nor spongs | | 'chi bas mi bzad klu 'dra'i 'dzin pa spongs/ /dgra bo mtshon thogs lta bu'i sdug bsngal spongs/ /klu mo lta bu'i mi bzad chung ma spongs// mgo la me 'bar lta bu'i bu rnams spongs/ /'go ba'i nad bcas lta bu'i khyim rnams spongs/ /btung ba dug can lta bu'i 'dod pa thong*/ khyim gyi phyir ni rdzas gtong ste/ /grong gi don du khyim gtong ngo*/ /ljongs kyi phyir du grong khyer te/ /bdag gi don du sa gtang ngo/ /mi gang yan lag phyir ni nor gtong zhing*/ /srog gi don du yan lag gtang bar bya/ /nor dang yan lag rnams dang de bzhin srog /thams cad gtang gis 'dir ni chos gsungs so/ /zhes legs par bsnyad de gsungs pa'i don rig par
