bya'o | | des na bskal pa bzang po'i dus su/ bskal par dge ba spyad cing mnyam par bzhag pa bas/ bskal pa rtsod ldan gyi dus 'dir skad cig 'bad pa khyad par du bsod nams che bar gsungs pas/ rgyu mtshan des deng sang rtsod pa'i dus 'dir/ nyon mongs pa rags su song bas bstan pa'i gdams pa dar zhing zab tu song*/ gdug cing rtsub pa'i rkyen mang bas blo stobs dang ldan pa rnams nye ru song*/ bar du gcod pa'i rkyen mang bas rnal 'byor pa'i dngos grub myur du song bas/ deng sang gi dus su | bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa/ grub pa thob pa'i gang zag rnams padma'i lo 'dab rgyas pa bzhin/ phyogs thams cad nas shigs kyis byon pa'i dus 'dir/ rang gis rang la go cig ma 'khums na/ phyis rkyen ngan pa'i kha nas thar pa mchog tu dka' bas rab tu 'bad par zhu'o/ /kye/ legs par sbyar ba'i sman la nus yod kyang*/ /skyes bu (nad pa )za mkhan ma mchis dang*/ /ma yi nu zho yongs su rgyas gyur kyang*/ /bu chung rkan gyi stobs dang bral ba dang*/ /dpa' bo'i mtshon cha rno ngar ldan pa yang*/ / skyes bu'i stobs kyis 'phang par ma nus bzhin/ /brtse bar (bas )sbyar ba'i tshig don 'di dag kyang*/ khyod kyis chud zos ma gtong ang*/ /lha chos dang mi chos gnyis ka la 'jug pa'i pra khrid khra bo zur rgyan nyams kyi me long dang bcas pa/ rab tu gus pa'i slob ma mchog (gi )don du sbyar ba

| gsal ba'i sgron me 'dra ba rdzogs so// //༄༅/ /gnyer ltag gnya' ltong gzigs kyi man ngag rin po che zung drug gis mi rgyud bzang po khyad par du 'gyur ba ni/ bzang la drang dang brling la zab/ /dpa' la brtan dang mdzangs la gsal/ /mkhas la lcigs dang yangs la zhib/ /rin chen zung drug ldan pa yis/ /mi brgyud bzang por 'gyur ba yin/ /drin gzo stong gtam 'dzem na bzang*/ /rgyu med chad mar byed na drang*/ /sems dal byams sdang phyed na brling*/ / yongs mthun brtag dka' shes na zab/ /brtul phod dgra mi 'jigs na dpa' | |glo bu ra 'gyur ldog med na brtan/ /legs spyod nye drungaX skyong na mdzangs | | go bral bye brag phyed na gsal/ /skyon 'dor yon tan shes na mkhas | | mtha' ru legs nyes shes na lcigs/ /phyi nang kun dga' skyong na legs/ /so tshigs ma nor shes na zhib/ /mi rgyu bzang po khyad par 'gyur ba ni/ /dgos dgu byung ba'i rin chen zung drug yin/ /ya ru phyed na yon tan bcu gnyis tshang*/ /zung drug mi brgyud gcig la ldan gyur na/ / yid la bsams pa'i dgos rgu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de phyir de la mi rnams thams cad kyis/ /mchod cing bstod de gtsug phud bzhin du 'khur | | phyi nang kun gyi rag las sa ru 'gyur/ /sngar gyi stong grogs byas pa rnams/ /mi brjed drin gzo lan 'don cing*/ /da ltar kun mthun yongs la phan/ /phyis kyi rags 'jigs med gyur kyang*/ /chu gang mig thag ring por lta/ /yul khrims spyi khrims gzhung lugs la/ /ngo tsha khrel 'dzem shas che na/ /bzang po zhes su grags pa ste/ /kun gyi spyi la 'khur bar 'gyur/ /dgos don che yang gzhan mi bslu/ /rang la skyon byung mi 'chab la/ /spyod pa gang dang gang byed kyang*/ /rang sems grogs kyis ma khrel ba/ khrims dang lugs las mi gda' ('da' )yang*/ /rtag tu bsdur thug byed gyur na/ /drang po zhes su grags pa ste/ /kun bstod mi byed yid brtan 'gyur/

/lus ngag bya ba gang byed kyang*/ /brtag dpyad sngon la gtang gyur na/ /skyon dang yon tan legs phyed cing*/ /smra ba nyung la spyod pa g.yung*/ /zer la mi nyan spyod la rtog /phra ma mi 'dzud dbyen mi 'dzud// dam bcas mthar phyin tshod zin byed/ /byams pa kun la phan 'dogs cing | | sdang ba kun la sha gcod na/ /brling po zhes su grags pa ste/ / kun gyis rtsis 'jog sa ru zhu/ /des na g.yung la tshig 'jam pas/ /kun dang mthun pa'i yid 'phrog byed/ /ngan las 'phral du mi 'don la/ /smra nyung zhe bsams khar mi 'don/ /legs nyes bye brag phyed byas nas/ / gzhan gyis ma mthong ma rtogs par/ /thabs kyis 'dod pa sgrub par byed || gzhan la smod par mi byed na/ /gting zab zhes su grags pa ste/ / phun sum tshogs shing dbang 'thob 'gyur//ma nor don la rdzun phod cing*// dgos don bsgrub la 'jigs dang bral/ /dgra sdang 'dul la sreg mi 'dzem | | dpa' bo zhes byar grags pa yin/ /kun gyis chag 'jog sa ru 'gyur | | dgos tshe blo gros mi gtong zhing*/ /brtson 'grus brtsams pa mthar 'byin la/ /gsang thub chad pa btsan gyur na/ /brtan po zhes su grags pa ste/ /kun gyi yid brtan gnas su 'gyur/ /mkhas mdzangs bstod par phyed par bya/ /byams pas mthong zhing dma' skyong na/ / mdzangs po zhes su grags pa ste/ /smon zhing grags pa'i gnas su 'gyur// bzang ngan nye ring byams dang sdang*/ /bya dang mi bya dgos mi dgos/ /yin min bden brdzun la sogs la/ /myur du skyon med shes smra na/ /gsal po zhes su grags pa ste/ /ras su gcad cing gnas min bros par 'gyur// bya ba'i las ni thams cad la/ /bde ba dang bral sdug bsngal 'thob/ / rang nyid 'gyod la gzhan gyis 'phyas/ /de rnams bral ba'i thabs shes na || mkhas pa zhes su grags pa ste/ /kun gyi yid smon gnas su 'gyur/ / bya ba'i las ni thams cad la/ /de la phyi phyir yun ring rgya che bar/

/ legs pa'i rgyu la legs pa dang*/ /nyes pa'i rgyu dang nyes pa dag | du ma legs par shes gyur na/ /lcigs po zhes su grags pa ste/ /mi 'gyod kun gyi gros sar 'gyur/ /dpung ba zas nor gros rig pa/ /rang 'dod spangs nas gzhan skyabs te/ /tshig rtsub g.yo sgyu dang bral ba/ /drin gyis g.yogs par byed 'gyur ba/ /sbubs yangs zhes su grags pa ste/ / kun gyi dbang dang ldan par 'gyur/ /so nam dus lnga la brtson zhing*/ / nor gyi tshis tshigs mkhas gyur pa/ / skabs su so tshigs tshod zin byed/ / nad med tshe ring thabs mkhas na/ /zhib mo zhes su grags pa ste/ / dgos rgu kun gyi 'byung gnas yin/ /yon tan drug las bzlog 'gyur ba | | rang gi rgyud las 'byung 'gyur yang*/ /bcos pa dka' yang gdam ngag 'di/ /rgyun du sus bsten de bzhin 'gyur/ /de bas kun tu nan tan gyis | | 'di skad bstan pa'i gdams ngag la/ /yid kyis brtags te goms byas na/ /rin chen zung drug ldan par nges/ /gnyer ltag gnya' stong gzigs kyi man ngag rin po che zung drug ces bya ba rdzogs so/ / sa skya paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i legs bshad/ /-ithi/ sdeb sbyor zhus dag zur bzhag nas/ /dkyus kyi zhus dag gcig dag bdog /slar/ yig thob nor ba ci nus bcos/ / brda rnying sor bzhag chad la mchan/ /bkod de zhu dag rags tsam bgyis/ /dpe gzhan rnyed na bsdur bcos bya// // ༄༅/ /skyes bu'i rnam 'byed bshad pa gzhon nu'i mgul rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ skyes bu'i rnam 'byed bshad pa gzhon nu'i mgul rgyan zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la skyabs song bslu ba med/ /thar med srid pa'i gzeb nas 'dren/ /skye med dam pa'i don la sbyor/ /thun mong ma yin skyabs la 'dud/ /'byor med btsun pa blo gros can/ /shākya'i rjes 'brangs brtul zhugs 'dzin/

/kun dga'i mig can kho bo yis/ /skyes bu'i rnam 'byed bshad par bya/ /kun la snyoms pa dam pa ste/ /rang don sgrub pa phal pa yin/ /mkhas pa'i bya ba dgag sgrub ste/ /shes bzhin spong ba don med yin/ /yul 'khor skyong ba chen po ste/ /bu smad 'tshog pa tha shal yin/ /tshig don mthun pa drang po ste/ /gzhan rgyud len pa g.yo can yin | | bzang la lan yod bzang po ste/ /drin gzo med na ngan pa yin/ / rtog dpyod ldan pa spyang po ste/ /ldom col smra ba glen pa yin/ khong du sbed pa zab mo ste/ kha ru 'byin pa klad med yin/ /legs nyes shong ba yangs mo ste/ /rang nyid 'ching ba dog mo yin/ /phyis 'byung dpyod pa zhib mo ste || rtog dpyod med na ba glang yin/ /shes rig ldan pa blon po ste/ /rje la 'khu ba 'gong po yin/ /gsang gros thub pa grogs po ste/ /gzhan la 'chad na zang thal yin/ /'khor 'dabs skyong ba rje bo ste/ /rtag tu 'tshe na dgra bo yin/ /rje la bsam pa 'khor yin te/ /sems ngan 'chang na gzhom rgyu yin/ /gsog 'jog shes pa gnyer pa ste/ /zhib tshags med na grwa pa yin/ /blo gsal ngag nyung nye gnas te/ /phra ma 'jug na gtor shing yin | | bu khyo bkur ba chung ma ste/ /grogs gzhan bsten pa 'dre mo yin// skyes bu'i rnam 'byed bshad pa gzhon nu'i mgul rgyan las/ mdor bsdus pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de dag smras pa sdom gyi tshig /da ni de kun rgyas par bshad/ / bslu med rgyu 'bras gtsor bzhag nas/ /bya ba gang byed de dang bstun/ / thabs la mkhas shing kun la snyoms/ /de dag skyes bu dam pa yin/ /rtag tu rang gi don la 'bad/ /rtsol sgrub drag pos ha thang chad/ /dgra la zhe sdang gnyen la chags/ /de dag skyes bu phal pa yin/ /chos dang chos min 'jug ldog yul/ /sgrub dang dgag pa rim pa bzhin/ /rjes 'jug blo ldan de la sbyor/ /de dag skyes bu mkhas pa yin/ /blang dor shes shing khyad du gsod/

/rnyed pa don gnyer kha gsag mkhan/ /cung zad 'khon na mthu yis sdigs/ /de dag skyes bu khyi nag yin/ /rang bzhin brling la shes rgya che || nyi ma lta bur kun la snyoms/ /nye ring med par 'khor 'dabs skyong*// de dag skyes bu chen po yin/ /rtag tu 'khon dang 'thab zla tshol/ /grong mtha' bskor zhing 'o dod 'debs/ /nyes med bu smad rgyun du brdung*/ /de dag skyes bu tha shal yin/ /smras pa'i tshig dang bsam pa'i don/ /sa bon dang ni myu gu bzhin/ /bslu ba med par rjes su 'brang*/ /de dag skyes bu drang po yin/ /drang po mi smra 'dzum gyis bsu/ /smra na ngag 'jam phigs par smra/ /rtag tu gzhan gyi nyams drod len/ /de dag skyes bu g.yo can yin | | byas pa shin tu drin du gzo/ /pha ma la gus rang bzhin drang*/ / gzhan la mi gtser rang tshugs thub/ /de dag skyes bu bzang po yin/ / phan btags lan du gnod pa bskyel/ /byas pa chud gson dman la sdang | | rang bzhin ngan pa phag lta bu/ /de dag skyes bu ngan pa yin/ /gang gis tshig dang spyod lam las/ /pha rol sems kyi rnam 'gyur ro/ /bzang ngan bya ba khong du chud/ /de dag skyes bu spyang po yin/ /legs nyes bya ba mi shes bzhin/ /mang po'i mdun sar cal col smra/ /gzhan gyis kha 'dru 'phya ba'i gnas/ /de dag skyes bu ldom col yin/ /( dpe la lar gtom chol zer ba snang*/ )legs nyes bya ba gang brtsam yang*/ /ma grub bar du khar mi 'byin | | grub kyang zur ngom mi byed pa/ /de dag skyes bu zab mo yin/ / bya ba gang dang gang rtsom yang*/ /bsgrub kyi sta gon yul na med/ /gang dang 'phrad pa de la smra/ /de dag skyes bu yang mo yin/ /ha cang phan la ha cang gnod || gang dang gang gi ci mchiXs pa/ /mi brjed sems kyi gru na 'chang*// de dag skyes bu yangs mo yin/ /legs nyes bya ba phra mo yang*/ /blo ngor mi shong kun la 'dri/ /dal bar mi sdod sngags su bgrangs/

/de dag skyes bu dog mo yin/ /gang zhig bya ba rtsom pa na/ /phyis 'byung skyon dang yon tan rtsi | | legs par gtan la phab nas 'jug /de dag skyes bu zhib po yin | | legs nyes bya ba blos mi 'byed/ /bcol yang mi shes 'du shes blun || rgyu mtshan med par rtul por 'jug /de dag skyes bu ba glang yin// dran pa gsal zhing thabs la mkhas/ /rje la snying nye ngang gis brling*/ / rang bzhin drang po mda' lta bu/ /blon por 'os pa'i skyes bu yin/ /gros kyi gtso bo zur la 'jog /rang gi 'dod pa phugs su rdzong*/ /do gal che na rje la 'khu/ /'gong po lta bu'i skyes bu yin/ /gzhung bzang brtan la phyi thag ring*/ /gsang gros mi smra bslu sems med/ /dgos dus zas nor lhug par gtong*/ /grogs por 'os pa'i skyes bu yin/ /bdag cag de dang mdza' 'o zhes/ /gang dang phebs par smra ba'i gtam/ /bzung bcad med par khrom du 'chad/ /de dag bug ba zang thal yin/ /'khor 'dabs cung zad nyes na yang*/ /ngag tu mi 'don khog tu skyems/ /bzang ngam ngan rung bdag gi zhes/ /byams pas skyong ba rje bo yin/ /cung zad tsam la chad pas gcod/ /mi snyan tshig gi char pa 'bebs/ /phan med gnod pa 'ba' zhig byed/ /rje ngan 'khor gyi dgra bo yin/ /blo dang nus pa mi 'khu zhing || 'byor dang rang don mthong tshol med/ /sgo gsum bya ba thams cad kyis | | rje la bsam pa 'khor yin no/ /bza' dang bgo bas legs bskyangs kyang*/ /rtag tu 'khang zhing rgyun du rku/ /rje la mi sems bsam ngan 'chang*/ /'khor ngan de dag gzhom rgyu yin/ /ya rabs dam pa'i 'jug ngogs mthong*/ /zhib tig che la bag dang ldan/ /so nam brtson zhing 'khor skyong mkhas/ /gsog 'jog shes pa gnyer pa ste/ /bya ba mi mkhas spyod pa rtsing*/ /shes rig mi gsal chang la dga'/ /sang gi bya ba gnangs su lus/ /zhib tshags med pa grwa pa yin/ /bag yod sos dal spyod lam mdzes/ /sgyu med sems brtan rje la bsam/

/yig rtsis la sogs rig byed mkhas/ /blo gsang ngag nyung nye gnas te/ /yig rtsis mi shes ngang gis blun/ /phyi nang mi shes smra ba mang*/ /rje yi drung du shab shib 'chad | | de 'dra 'khor gyi gtor shing yin/ khog yangs bag yod 'du shes grung*/ /gnyen dang nye du'i sems 'dzin shes/ /so nam brtson zhing bkal thags mkhas/ /bu khyo bkur ba chung ma ste/ /so nam mi brtson za la dga'/ /shes med gdong la byi dor rem/ /rtag tu khyo min grogs gzhan 'tshol/ /de kun 'dre mo mngon sum yin/ /skyes bu'i rnam 'byed bshad pa gzhon nu'i mgul rgyan las/ rgyas par bshad pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de ltar bshad pa de dag la/ /blo gros ldan pa'i skyes bu yis/ / bar ma rnams ni btang snyoms bzhag /bzang ngan gnyis la blang dor bya// blo gros gsal zhing thabs la mkhas/ /gzhan la gzhan phan 'od zer 'gyed || nyi ma lta bu'i skyes bu de/ /btang snyoms mi bzhag dang du blang*/ / zol spyod sprin gyis ma bsgribs shing*/ /drang brtan gnyis kyi ri bong 'dzin || zla ba lta bu'i skyes bu de/ /btang snyoms mi bzhag dang du blang*/ / dbyen dang phra mas mi 'gul zhing*/ /ngo bstod rlung gis mi bskyod pa/ / lhun po lta bu'i skyes bu de/ /btang snyoms mi bzhag dang du blang*/ /gzhan gyis rang bzhin gting dpag dka'/ /blo dang rig pa'i rlabs dang ldan// rgya mtsho lta bu'i skyes bu de/ /btang snyoms mi bzhag dang du blang*/ /phan 'dod 'bras bu'i khur dang ldan/ /tsha gdung sel ba'i bsil grib can/ / ljon shing lta bu'i skyes bu de/ /btang snyoms mi bzhag dang du blang*/ /nyes spyod 'joms pa'i mche sder can/ /bag yod g.yu yi ral pa 'dzin/ / seng ge lta bu'i skyes bu de/ /btang snyoms mi bzhag dang du blang*/ /bslab gsum gser gyi drwa bas g.yogs/ /yon tan nor bu'i mgul rgyan can// glang po lta bu'i skyes bu de/ /btang snyoms mi bzhag dang du blang*/

/nang du shes rig dran pa gsal/ /phyi na blang dor ri mo bkra/ /stag mo lta bu'i skyes bu de/ /btang snyoms mi bzhag dang du blang*/ /skyes bu'i rnam 'byed bshad pa gzhon nu'i mgul rgyan las/ blang bya'i skyes bu bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //gang dang cung zad 'khon pa na/ /mi smra sems kyi dkyil du bzhag/ skabs su bab na rdul du rlog /dug sbrul lta bu'i skyes bu spang*/ /rang bzhin mi bzang rtsub 'gyur che/ /rtag tu gnod sems 'ba' zhig 'chang*// ngan gyi gtong sa phyi nang med/ /btsan dug lta bu'i skyes bu spang*/ /snyan par smra zhing zhi dul che/ /spyod pa bzang po'i tshul bzung nas/ /dus la bab na rtsub 'gyur ston/ /byi la lta bu'i skyes bu spang*/ /phyi nang mi shes kun la rgol/ /bza' btung tsam gyis 'brid par sla/ /gtsang btsog med pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin/ khyi rgan lta bu'i skyes bu spang*/ /'khos med rtag tu rgyu 'grul mang*/ /snying med gzhan la nyams drod skyel/ /klad med kha zas rtag tu 'tshol/ /wa skyes lta bu'i skyes bu spang*/ /tshod chung drod med phyi thag thung*/ /rang mtshang ngan pa gzhan la bsku/ /mdog ngan ston pa'i skad ngan can/ khwa ta lta bu'i skyes bu spang*/ /gzhan gyis mi brtsi rang gis brtsi

| | 'byor med gos sogs 'phyor la dga'/ khang kha bskor zhing glu chung len/ khyim bya lta bu'i skyes bu spang*/ /rtag tu dman pa'i las spyod cing | | rgyu mtshan med par 'o dod 'debs/ /bag med spyod pa'i rtol col can/ /bong bu lta bu'i skyes bu spang*/ /las su sdig spyod gzhan la rku || sems ngan spyod ngan rang bzhin ngan/ /rnam thar ngan pa gzhan la bsgo | | rims nad lta bu'i skyes bu spang*/ /don du bza' btung 'ba' zhig gnyer/ /gang la brten pa de la gnod/ /spyod pa mi gzob 'gro la dga' | khyi shig lta bu'i skyes bu spang*/ /skyis bu'i rnam 'byed bshad pa gzhon nu'i mgul rgyan las/ spang bya'i skyes bu bshad pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o || || de ltar skyes bu'i rnam 'byed dang*/ /de la blang dor bshad mod kyang || blo gros ldan pas shes mod kyi/ /blun po rnams kyis de ltar min// mig sogs skyon dang bral ba yis/ /gzugs rnams dbye ba so sor 'byed | | don la ji ltar gnas pa bzhin/ /nang du de yi rnam pa 'char/ / mig sogs skyon dang bcas pa dang*/ /phyi rol yul la log par 'jug /zla ba gcig la gnyis 'dzin bzhin/ /rnam pa phyin ci log tu 'char/ / gang gis de der 'jog pa yi/ /rgyu mtshan mthong na mkhas pa 'jug /ljon shing yal ga chur lhung bas/ /blun po cal gyi rjes su 'brangs/ / mkhas pa mkhas pa la dga' ste/ /blun po blun po nyid la dga'/ /padma yid 'ong nyi mas skyong*/ /zla ba'i zer gyis ku mud 'byed/ /mi gtsang dri la srin bu 'khor/ /rul ba'i dri la sha sbrang 'khor/ /kye ma sa phyogs ma dag par | | shin tu skye bo ma dag dga'/ /yan lag brgyad ldan chu bo spong*/ / bshes su khyi yi chu ngan len/ /blo rmongs gzu bor mi gnas shing*/ /sdug gsog byas pa'i 'byor pa can/ /legs nyes dpyod pa'i shes med po/ / deng sang blun po'i kun spyod mtshar/ /nor gyis nor 'tshol tshong pa la/

/ g.yo sgyu che zhes smod par snang*/ /brdzun gyis nor 'tshol zog po la/ /ngo mtshar che zhes gtsug na mchod/ /drang por smras na 'khyog por 'dzin/ / g.yon can bla ma rin chen lo/ /rtog dpyod ldan pa'i skyes bu yis/ /yon tan mchog dang ldan pa len/ /yid 'ong padma'i rdzing bu la/ /'dab chags ngang pa ngang gis 'phyo/ /shes rig med pa'i blun po rnams/ /g.yo sgyu'i tshul ltar chos la dad/ /'bad de btsal yang khyi rgan gyis/ /lham krad las gzhan ci zhig rnyed/ /blo ldan mkhas pas gzhan la phan/ /bsil drod sman gyis tsha grang sel/ /blo dman skye bos gzhan la gnod/ /sdong dum skam po 'tshig pa'i rgyu/ /kye ma 'dzam gling byang phyogs 'dir/ /spang bya 'ga' yang ma spangs shing*/ /rtogs bya 'ga' yang ma rtogs pas/ / kun mkhyen thob pa'i dus mi snang*/ /ya mtshan che mod thub pa'i bka'/ / dri med 'bad pas legs rtog la/ /rgyu 'bras gnyis la yid ches pa'i/ / mkhas pas bka' bzhin nyams su longs/ /snyigs dus skye bo mi srun pa// yin lugs smras na 'khon 'dzin skye/ /btang snyoms bzhag na bstan la gnod | | des na 'di la ji ltar bgyi/ /kyi hud deng sang thub pa'i bstan// nub kyi ri mgor lhung ba yi/ /'od zer stong ldan nyi ma bzhin/ /ring por mi thogs nub par 'gyur/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'di/ /smag rum mun pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de bas blo ldan mkhas pa'i tshogs/ /yud tsam bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i khur 'dzin pas | khe rnyed 'du 'dzi'i rtsol ba dor/ /gsung rab 'o ma'i mtsho bsrubs la | | thos bsam mar gyi snying po longs/ rang don sgrub pa'i blo dor la/ / gzhan phan nyi ma'i 'od zer phye/ /shes bzhin dran pa'i gos gyon la/ / rin chen bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zungs/ /'di skad smras pa'i btsun pa ngas | khyad par gsum ldan bla ma bsten/ /byed pa gnyis ldan gsung rab mnyan | | blang dor tshul la blo mig 'byed/

/skyes bu'i rnam 'byed bshad pa gzhon nu'i mgul rgyan las/ mkhas rmongs ky-i khyad par dang*/ mkhas pa cung zad bskul ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// // bdag gis 'di skad smras pa'i gtam/ /'ga' yi rna bar lhung ba ni/ /bzhin ras padma'i nags tshal dag /zla ba'i 'od kyis phog pa 'dra || drang por smras pa'i ngag gi mda'/ /ma 'da' ched du brgyab pa 'dra// gang la phog pa de yi mtshang*/ /rang nor bzhin du ngos len byas/ /mkhas pa'i blo gros gter chen las/ /skyes bu'i rnam 'byed bshad pa gang*/ /blo gsal kun dga'i ming can gyis/ /gzur gnas drang po'i bsam pas sbyar || de ltar gzhon nu'i mgul rgyan mchoXg /mchoXg 'di legs bshad snang ba'i dpaXl/ /dpaXl ldan rgyal ba'i gsung rab kuXn/ /kuXn nas rgya cher rgyas gyur cig / sho lo ka 'di dpe la lar mi snang*/ de las byung ba'i dge ba dang | | gzhan yang dge ba ma lus pa/ /'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i blos | | bla med byang chub chen por bsngo/ /skyes bu'i rnam 'byed bshad pa gzhon nu'i mgul rgyan zhes bya ba/ shākya'i dge slong rigs pa smra ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba rdzogs so// // dpe lnga la bsdur nas zhus// // ༄༅/ /chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par 'byaid pa'i bstan bcos legs bshad nyi ma'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ dharmā a dharmā bi bhe da shāst+ra nā ma/ bod skad du/ chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos | bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ kha ba can du mkhas pa'i rgyu skar du ma'i dpung ni nyer lhags shing*/ /legs bshad skar mda'i 'od zer blo ngan mun pa'i khrod na rab mdzes pas (kyang )/ / shes bya'i mkha' la mkhyen pa'i 'od zer bye ba du ma dang ldan zhing*/ /rta bdun tsha zer can 'od padmo'i tshal 'byed bdag blo kho na'i khur/

/mdo rgyud don la mkhyen pa'i lus rgyas shing*/ /sgra tshad mche sder du mas rab mdzes pa'i/ /legs bshad seng ge'i nga ro du ma yis/ /wa tshogs log pa'i klad 'gems cung zhig brtsam// //deng sang gangs ri'i khrod 'di ru/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa la dor nas | | blun po rang dga'i cho ga dang*/ /lta spyod 'khrul ba du ma byung*/ /sgra tshad mi shes mkhas pa dang*/ /thos pa med pa'i sgom chen dang*/ /thad klog mi shes lo tsā dang*/ /sdom pa med pa'i btsun pa dang*/ /sems ma bskyed pa'i byang sems dang*/ /sbrelaX nas phul ba'i sems bskyed dang*/ /dge slong ma yi chig rdzogs dang*/ /bsnyen gnas lha sgom cho ga dang*/ /rtag par lta ba'i phyag chen dang*/ /chad par lta ba'i rdzogs chen dang*/ /chos kyi dbyings la bzang ngan dang*/ /yod par 'dzin pa'i dug med dang*/ / brje ba'i sems bskyed 'gog pa dang*/ /sburaX ru nag gu'i nub tshang dang*// sbal 'jog ngur smrig gon pa dang*/ /rtog pa kha bskyil sangs rgyas dang*/ / sems ngo 'phrod pa'i bdag 'dzin dang*/ /byar med po yi bu smad dang*/ / ngo tsha med na zhig po dang*/ /gdon gyis bzung na grub thob dang*/ kha drag yod na mkhan po dang*/ /nor gyis 'byor na slob dpon dang*/ /'khrug dpon byed na dge bshes dang*/ /bslu bar nus na bzang po dang*/ /g.yo sgyu shes na btsun po dang*/ /bslaXb col smra na shes rab dang*/ /bsdus chang byed na tshogs 'khor dang*/ /rab tu gnas pa mdo lugs dang*/ /mtshan mo dbang bskur byas pa yi/ /nangs par seng ge'i srog sdom dang*/ /nam mkha' mi bslu la sogs pa/ /mu cor du ma'i tshogs 'di dag /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog gcod yin/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la thod brgal du byas pa'i rab tu byed pa ste dang po'o// //bdag 'dzin sgong rgya ma zhig par/ /stong nyid rlabs kyis ma gcod cig /rtag chad mtha' la 'chor bar nges/ /da dung rgyu 'bras drod la brten/

/thos pa'i mig dang mi ldan par/ /sgom pa'i lam du ma 'jug cig | bying rgod g.yang la 'chor bar nges/ /da dung thos bsam cha la brten || yon tan gshog ru ma rgyas par/ /spyod pa'i 'phur ba ma snga zhig/'dod yon rlung gis 'khyer bar nges/ /da dung ting 'dzin cha la brten/ / mkhyen pa'i nu zho mi ldan par/ /'khor bsdud 'dod 'jo ma byed cig /mdzo sbrel g.yang la 'chor bar nges//da dung mkhas pa'i shing thog myongs// gzhi med pa la khyad par gyi chos 'gog pa'i rab tu byed pa ste gnyis pa'o || || mkhas pa zer ba mang mod kyi/ /mdo rgyud lhums su zhugs ma zhugs || sgra tshad 'phrang la bshar na gsal/ /tshig don ldan na mkhas pa yin | | mkhas pa ming gis bslus par mchi'o/ /sems ldan yod na bsam mno gyis/ /btsun po zer ba mang mod kyi/ /sdom gsum rgyan gyis mdzes ma mdzes/ /sde snod mgul du btags na gsal/ /bsrung sdom yod na btsun po yin/ /btsun po ming gis bslus par mchi'o/ /sems ldan yod na bsam mno gyis/ /bzang po zer ba mang mod kyi/ /bdag bde gzhan la gtong mi gtong*/ /skyid sdug sgang la bltas na gsal/ / brje bar nus na bzang po yin/ /bzang po ming gis bslus par mchi'o/ / sems ldan yod na bsam mno gyis/ /rtogs ldan zer ba mang mod kyi/ / sems nyid ma bu mjal ma mjal/ /bde sdug bre ru blugs na gsal/ / chags sdang grol na rtogs ldan yin/ /rtogs ldan ming gis bslus par mchi'o | | sems ldan yod na bsam mno gyis/ /'khrul zhig zer ba mang mod kyi/ /zhe 'dod sgrog thag grol ma grol/ /blo dman btson rar bcug na gsal/ /mthun 'jug med na 'khrul zhig yin/ /'khrul zhig ming gis bslus par mchi'o/ /sems ldan yod na bsam mno gyis/ /grub thob zer ba mang mod kyi/ /lhan skyes khyu mchog rgyas ma rgyas/ /'dod yon nags la bskyangs na gsal/ /bde gsal 'char na grub thob yin/

/ grub thob ming gis bslus par mchi'o/ /sems ldan yod na bsam mno gyis | | dbang bskur zer ba mang mod kyi/ /sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs ma thebs | | rgyud sde'i me long phyis na gsal/ /dbang chu zhogs na thebs pa yin | | dbang bskur ming gis bslus par mchi'o/ /sems ldan yod na bsam mno gyis/ /mtshan don brtag pa ste rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o/ / mtho ris skas la 'dzeg pa dang*/ /ngan song g.yang la bskyur ba gnyis | | chos mdzad lam la gol sa yod/ /gol sa gcod pa'i gdams ngag dgos/ khas blangs dam du bcas pa yi/ /tshul khrims yid bzhin nor bu 'di/ /srung sdom byed pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ /g.yo sgyu'i spyod pa sna tshogs kyis/ kha gsag gsog 'jog ngag 'jam dang*/ /gdong la zhogs khrus byin len sogs/ /rang gzhan bslu ba'i tshul 'chos gnyis/ /mtho ris gnad kyi gol sa yin/ /lam nor ba srid do chos mdzad kun/ /rang dang bla mas ma bslus na/ /gzhan gyis bslus pa rdzun po yin/ /'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa gcod pa dang*/ /thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod pa gnyis/ /chos mdzad lam la gol sa yod/ /gol sa gcod pa'i gdams ngag dgos// zab yangs rgya che mdo sde'i don/ /'chad nyan sgrub pa snying po'i don/ / sems nyid ma bu 'phrod pa dang*/ /gsung rab 'o ma'i mtsho spangs te/ / byar med smig rgyu'i phung po la/ /rtsol ba ci yang med pa gnyis/ /dgra bcom gnad kyi gol sa yin/ /lam nor ba srid do chos mdzad kun// rang dang bla mas ma bslus na/ /gzhan gyis bslus pa rdzun po yin/ /kun mkhyen ye shes bsgrub pa dang*/ /mnar med me yis bsreg pa gnyis// chos mdzad lam la gol sa yod/ /gol sa gcod pa'i gdams ngag dgos | | zab yangs mdo sde'i nam mkha' la/ /sems nyid 'byung bzhi'i rnam 'gyur gyis/ /smon 'jug sprin phung nyer bsdus te/ /gzhan don char rgyun 'beb pa dang*/ /mdo rgyud lhums su ma zhugs par/ /byas lo yin lo 'dug lo yi/

/blo dman mthun 'jug sna tshogs kyis/ /phrin las mi sems 'dzin pa gnyis/ /byang sems gnad kyi gol sa yin/ /lam nor ba srid do chos mdzad kun/ /rang dang bla mas ma bslus na/ / gzhan gyis bslus pa rdzun po yin/ /gzhan don rdzong la slebs pa dang*/ / chos brgyad mkhar spe brtsigs pa gnyis/ /chos mdzad lam gyi gol sa yin | | go sa gcod pa'i gdamangs ngag dgos/ /ye shes brgyud pa'i dbang chu dang*/ /rlung sems gnad kyi gdamangs ngag dang*/ /bla ma'i dad gus gsum ldan gyis/ /mtshan ldan phyag rgya bsten pa dang*/ /go rgya log pa'i rlung sems dang*/ /chos brgyad dad gus la sogs kyis/ /nyon mongs phyag rgya bsten pa gnyis/ /gsang sngags gnad kyi gol sa yin/ / lam nor ba srid do chos mdzad kun/ /rang dang bla mas ma bslus na/ / gzhan gyis bslus pa rdzun po yin/ /gol sa gcod pa'i man ngag 'di/ / mdo rgyud gsal ba'i me long yin/ /gol sa gcod pa'i rab tu byed pa ste bzhi pa'o// //gdul bya gang la gang gis 'dul//phrin las de dang de ldan pa'i// slob dpon kun mkhyen cha 'dzin pa/ /rang gi srog pas gces so ang*/ / cung zad mchod pa tsam gyis kyang*/ /dgos 'dod ma lus nyer 'byung ba'i// slob dpon yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /rang gi srog pas gces so ang*/ / 'chad na blo yi mig 'byed la/ /rtsod na rgol ba'i klad 'gems shing*/ / rtsom na bstan pa'i srol btod pa'i/ /slob dpon rang gi srog pas gces | | thos bsam sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan la/ /bslab gsum nor bu dang ldan pas/ /nyes spyod rims nad kun sel ba'i/ /rgyal mtshan 'dra ba srog pas gces/ /rtsal rdzogs sgra tshad mche sder gyis/ /log lta glang po'i dpung 'joms pa'i/ /seng ge 'dra ba srog pas gces/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i chu bo la/ /ngang pa bzhin du don gnyer ba'i/ /slob ma rin chen gser bas dkon/ /'dod yon lan tshwa'i mtsho spangs nas/ /bslab gsum me tog dri bcud la/

/bung ba bzhin du don gnyer ba'i/ /slob ma rin chen gser bas dkon/ /bla ma'i bya ba gang la yang*/ /sdug bsngal mgo la me 'bar bzod/ /mi ldog khyab 'jug dang 'dra ba'i/ /slob ma rin chen gser bas dkon/ /cung zad thos par gyur pa la/ /ston pa'i 'du shes dang ldan zhing*/ /dad gus chu bo'i rgyun 'dra ba'i/ /slob ma rin chen gser bas dkon/ /chos brgyad smig rgyu la dor nas/ /dam chos 'o ma'i rgyun dag la/ be'u bzhin du don gnyer ba'i/ /slob ma rin chen gser bas dkon/ /nye 'brel kho thag bcad nas su/ /gcig pur nyams su len pa la/ /ri dwags dman ma dang 'dra ba'i/ /slob ma rin chen gser bas dkon/ /pha yul btson ra spangs nas su/ /phyogs med bla ma 'tshol ba la/ /mdzo mo bu stor 'dra ba yi/ /slob ma rin chen gser bas dkon/ /mkhas btsun char bzhin brten pa la/ /rgya mtsho bzhin du mi ngoms pa'i/ / ( 'di'i nang tshigs rkang gcig chad pa 'dra ) slob ma rin chen gser bas dkon// //cung zad zas kyis kha brten nas/ /nor gyi srog rtsa gcod pa yi/ / slob dpon ngan pa nya pa 'dra/ /de ni myur du spangs na legs/ /bdag 'dzin sgong rgya ma zhig par/ /thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod pa yi/ /slob dpon ngan pa dug sbrul 'dra/ /de ma thag tu spangs na legs/ /sgra dang tshad ma mi shes par/ /dgag dang sgrub par byed pa yi/ /slob dpon long ba'i mdzub ris 'dra/ /de ni myur du spangs na legs/ /sdom pa gsum gyi bcud med par/ /gzhan la tshig gi sdom pa 'bogs/ /slob dpon gcer bu dor tshong 'dra/ /de ni myur du spangs na legs/ /yon tan med par nga rgyal che/ /rtag tu gzhan la smod par byed/ /slob dpon ngan pa khyi mgo 'dra

| | de ni myur du spangs na legs/ /gang zhig bsten par gyur pa na/ / nyon mongs sred pa 'phel 'gyur ba'i/ /slob dpon lan tshwa'i chu dang 'dra// de ni myur du spangs na legs// //gang zhig gnas par gyur pa na/ /de nyid 'phung bar byed pa yi/ / slob ma ngan pa 'bu dang 'dra/ /de ma thag tu dor ba legs/ /zhen par gyur na rang nyid dang*/ /gzhan yang 'phung bar byed pa yi/ /slob ma ngan pa dug me 'dra/ /de ma thag tu dor ba legs/ /grogs dang nor med tshe ma phyid | | dam pa'i lha chos byed do lo/ /dman pa'i spyod pa ma dor ba'i/ / slob ma ngan pa khyi rkun 'dra/ /de ma thag tu dor ba legs/ /zas mthong tsa na ngo tsha shor/ /nor mthong tsa na khrel las bud/ /slob ma ngan pa bya phag 'dra | | de ma thag tu dor ba legs/ /nyams chung tsa na chos byed lo/ /cung zad 'byor na kun la gnod/ /slob ma ngan pa dug tsher 'dra/ /de ma thag tu dor ba legs/ /bzar med chos pa'i khyur zhugs nas/ /dad rdzas gsog 'jog byed pa de/ /cung zad 'byor na khyim so 'dzin/ /de ma thag tu dor ba legs/ /yar gyi mkhan po slob dpon nas/ /mar gyi gnas po pho mo'i nor/ /phral nas lam gyi chang ma gso/ /slob ma ngan pa khe bogs mkhan | | de ma thag tu dor ba legs/ /dpon slob kyi 'brel brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste lnga pa'o// //bla ma slob dpon la smad nas/ /rang gi che ba sgrub pa de/ /mgo bo bcad nas mjug ma'i rgyan/ /smyon pa min pa su zhig byed/ /gsar bu dga' ba'i ngor byas te/ /rgyun gyi grogs la gnod pa de/ /gsus pa phug nas khyi yi zas/ /smyon pa min pa su zhig byed/ /tshe 'di kho na la bltas nas | | gtan kyi ngan song sdug bsngal bsgrub/ /don snying bton nas kha yi zas//smyon pa min pa su zhig byed/ /mdo dang rgyud sde shes bzhin du/ / mi bsgrub bab col sna tshogs byed/ /'tshig par shes kyang me la mchongs// smyon pa min pa su zhig byed/

/zab mo'i snod du byas nas su/ /gsang ngo zer gyin gzhan la smra/ /tshor gyis dogs nas 'o dod 'bod/ /dug sbrul bzung nas ske yi rgyan/ /smyon pa min pa su zhig byed/ /nor ldan skye bos mkhas pa ru/ /go phyir rang bzo'i cho ga byed/ /pags pa bshus nas nyi mar bsro/ /smyon pa min pa su zhig byed/ /nor ldan skye bos mkhas pa ru// go phyir theg pa che la smod/ /sraug rtsa bton nas pha rol 'ching*/ /smyon pa min pa su zhig byed/ /smyon pa kho na'i chos brtag pa ste rab tu byed pa drug pa'o || || ya rabs bstod na zhu ba'i rtags/ /ma rabs bstod na 'khol ba'i rtags/ /dgra la bstod na bslu ba'i rtags/ /gnyen la bstod na re ba'i rtags/ /bu la bstod na len pa ste/ /bu mo bstod na shug pa'i rtags | | rta la bstod na 'tshong ba ste/ khyi la bstod na 'dogs pa'i rtags || me la bstod na 'khrug pa ste/ /chu la bstod na 'thung pa'i rtags// sa la bstod na rko ba ste/ /rlung la bstod na chung ba'i rtags/ /mtshal la bstod na 'thag pa ste/ /shing thog bstod na 'thog pa'i rtags/ /rtsa ba bstod na 'don pa ste/ /rtse mo bstod na gcod pa'i rtags/ /des na bstod pa skyon 'byung zhing*/ /smod pa'ang yon tan yod pa ste/ /yon tan can ni mi bstod cing*/ /skyon can mtha' dag bstod par byed/ /sgo phugs 'phrin yang mi 'phrod pas/ /rgya bod lo tsā byed pa la/ /smod pa blun po'i chos lugs yin//de la rgyu mtshan yod dam ci/ /yi ge ka gcig mi shes pas// po sti byung bshad byed pa la/ /smod pa blun po'i chos lugs yin/ /de la rgyu mtshan yod dam ci/ /tshul khrims 'chal pa gzhan dag gis/ /sdom gsum me tog ldan pa la/ /smod pa blun po'i chos lugs yin/ /de la rgyu mtshan yod dam ci/ /rang sems rlung gis khyer ba yis/ /dben gnas ting 'dzin bsgom pa la/ /smod pa blun po'i chos lugs yin/

/de la rgyu mtshan yod dam ci/ /rtag tu gzhan la rku ba yis/ /pha rol sbyin pa gtong ba la/ /smod pa blun po'i chos lugs yin/ /de la rgyu mtshan yod dam ci// rang gi bu smad mi sos pas/ /kun rje rgyal khams skyong ba la/ /smod pa blun po'i chos lugs yin/ /de la rgyu mtshan yod dam ci/ khrel 'das grogs kyis bor ba yis/ /g.yed po sum chun len pa la/ /smod pa blun po'i chos lugs yin/ /de la rgyu mtshan yod dam ci/ /rtag tu gla khur 'khur ba yis/ /bzang po zhon khrid byed pa la/ /smod pa blun po'i chos lugs yin/ /de la rgyu mtshan yod dam ci/ /mgron khang ra phug g.yar ba yis | | mkhar la ba gam 'dogs pa la/ /smod pa blun po'i chos lugs yin | | de la rgyu mtshan yod dam ci/ /nyeg mo khyo ma rnyed pa yis/ / mdzangs ma chas su 'jug pa la/ /smod pa blun po'i chos lugs yin/ / de la rgyu mtshan yod dam ci/ /mgul pa shig gis brgyan pa yis/ / mtshar mo gser g.yus brgyan pa la/ /smod pa blun po'i chos lugs yin// de la rgyu mtshan yod dam ci/ /ra slog shig can gyon pa yis/ /bzang po dar gyis brgyan pa la/ /smod pa blun po'i chos lugs yin/ /de la rgyu mtshan yod dam ci/ khyi spu rlung gis khyer ba yis/ /g.yang mo khri lug 'bal ba la/ /smod pa blun po'i chos lugs yin/ /de la rgyu mtshan yod dam ci/ /kun la smod pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/ /nyon cig 'di 'dra skabs su bab | | tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs/ / sngar byas dge ba'i rnam smin gyis/ /kun la ma smod dge ba sgrubs/ /rgyu mthun 'bras bu 'grub par 'gyur/ /bstod smad kyi tshig la chags sdang rang grol du gtong ba'i rab tu byed pa ste bdun pa'o// //chos dang chos min 'byed pa yi//blo gsal nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis// deng sang dus kyi kha ba can/ /ma lus gsal bar byed par shog /chos dang chos min rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos legs bshad nyi ma'i snying po zhes bya ba/

mkhyen brtse nus pa la 'gran zla dang bral ba/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas sbyar ba 'di re zhig rdzogs so// //maṅga laṃ/ 'di ma dpe tshang min gnyis rnyed pa bsdur kyang dag tshang zhig ma byung zhing*/ ma dag pa mngon gsal can rnams bcos| don go rgyu med pa la sgor rtaXgs re byas yod pas/ slad nas ma dpe 'byor na bsdur mdzod cig/ // ༄༅/ /sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs so/ / sdom gsum rang mchan 'khrul med bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs bstan pa'i gsung rab seng ge'i sgra/ /lta ngan ri dwags mtha' dag skrag par mdzad/ / sangs rgyas dgongs pa ji bzhin legs sgrub pa/ /mtshungs med bla ma de la bdag cag dad/ /skyon med yon tan kun gyi mdzod mnga' ba/ /'gro ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /dad ldan sangs rgyas gsung bzhin bsgrub 'dod pa/ /de la sdom gsum dbye ba bdag gis bshad/ / mkhas rnams dga' ba'i sdeb sbyor ni/ /blun po rnams kyis go dka' bas | | tshig gi sbyor ba spangs nas kyang*/ /kun gyis go bar bya phyir bshad || bdag ni sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /mi phyed pa yi dad pa yod/ / 'on kyang sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /'khrul bar spyod la bdag ma dad/ / so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed dang | | gsang sngags kyi ni dbang bskur dang*/ /de dag gi ni cho ga dang*// so so'i bslab par bya ba dang*/ /sems bskyed pa yi gnad rnams dang*/ / stong nyid snying rje'i snying po dang*/ /rim pa gnyis kyi gsang tshig gsang sngags dang 'brel ba 'di dag mdo tsam zhig bstan la rgyas par gzhan tu bstan yod/ dang*/ /ye shes phyag rgya chen po dang*/ /phyi dang nang gi rten 'brel dang*/ /sa dang lam gyi rnam gzhag gi /rnam par dbye ba bshad kyis nyon/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la/

/nyan thos theg chen lugs gnyis yod/ /nyan thos rnams kyi skyabs 'gro nas/ /dge slong gi ni sdom pa'i bar/ /ji srid 'tsho yi bar du yin | | shi ba'i tshe na sdom pa gtong*/ /sdom pa rnams kyi 'bras bu ni/ /tshe 'phos nas ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa rnams// shi 'phos nas kyang rjes su 'brang*/ /de dag gi ni rgyu mtshan yang*/ /nyan thos sdom pa rnam rig min/ /lus ngag lasaX ni skye bar 'dod/ /sdom pa gzugs can yin pa'i phyir/ /shi ba'i tshe na sdom pa gtong*/ /'di ni chos mngon mdzod las kyang*/ /bslab pa phul dang shi 'phos dang*/ / pho mo'i/ mtshan lan/ gnyis dag ni byung ba dang*/ / log lta skyes pa/ rtsa ba chad dang bsnyen gnas nam langs pa dang sdom pa gtong*/ mtshan 'das las/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa gtong*/ /zhes gsungs nyan thos kyi so sor thar pa 'di la tshad ma yin/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ni/ /sems lasaX skye phyir gzugs can min/ / des na ji srid sems ma nyams/ /de yi bar du sdom pa yod/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad kyi/ /dgongs pa yang ni 'di nyid yin/ kha cig ji srid 'tsho ba'i sgra//lus dang sems la dgongs zhes zer//de 'dra sangs rgyas dgongs pa min//mkhas pa'i gzhung las de ma bshad/ /de lta yin na nyan thos dang*/ /theg chen sdom pa khyad med 'gyur/ /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /skyabs 'gro gnyis su dbyer mi rung*/ ste nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa gnyis ka ji srid sangs ma rgyas pa'i bar du len pa'i phyir ro// sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga dang*/ /de yi bslab bya'ang gcig tu 'gyur/ /shi yang dge slong mi 'dor na/ /bslab pa phul ba la sogs pa/ /sdom pa gtong rgyu mtshan gnyis su gyur pa dang log lta skyes pa la sogs pa/ gzhan gyis kyang*/ /sdom pa gtong ba mi srid 'gyur/ /de la kha cig 'di skad du/ /sems bskyed kyis ni ma zin pa'i/

/sdom pa gal te gtong na yang*/ /byang chub sems kyis zin pa yi | | sdom pa gtong ba mi srid lo/ /'o na sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i// dge slong la sogs sdom pa rnams/ /bslab pa phul dang shi 'phos dang*// rtsa ba chad pa la sogs pa/ /gtong rgyu kun gyis mi gtong 'gyur/ /de lta yin na dge slong gi /sdom pa phul yang bsrung dgos 'gyur/ /ma bsrungs dge slong nyams par 'gyur/ /shi 'phos nas kyang dge slong 'gyur/ /gal te de ni lhar skyes na/ /lha yi dgai slong srid par 'gyur/ /mir skyes na yang byis pa la/ /blang mi dgos par dge slong 'gyur/ /de la ltung ba byung gyur na/ /dge slong sdom pa nyams par 'gyur/ /nyams nas 'chab sems skyes pa la/ /slar yang blang du med par 'dul ba lung las/ gsungs/ / lha dang byis pa'i dge slong ni/ /'dul ba'i sde snod rnams las bkag / sems bskyed ldan pa'i bsnyen gnas kyang*/ /nangs par phan chad yod pa'i phyir/ /rtag tu bsnyen gnas bsrung dgos 'gyur/ / de lta min na bsnyen gnas sdom pa ni yod srung ni mi bsrungs pas| nyams par 'gyur/ /nangs par nam langs nas/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa/ gtong na ni/ /sdom pa dge slong dge tshul yang shi na sdom pa gtong bar rigs pa mtshungs la rgyun du 'byung ba 'gal/ /des na so sor thar pa yi/ /sdom pa shi yang yod do zhes/ /smra ba'i skyes bu de la ni || nyan thos dang theg chen gnyis kyi sde snod kyi rnam par/ dbye ba/ med par zad//bye brag smra ba'i bsnyen gnas kyang*/ /dge slong las len gang zag ni/ / gli nga gsum gyi skyes pa bud med las/ / 'gro ba rigs drug gzhan la sdom pa bkag | mdo sde pa rnams dud 'gro ri bong la/ sogs pa/ / 'gro ba rigs drug gzhan la'ang skye bar bshad/ /blang ba'i yul yang dge bsnyen sogs// gang yang rung las blang bar gnas 'jog gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ gsungs/ /nyan thos rnams kyi cho ga yang*/

/skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul gyis 'bogs/ / don yod zhags pa'i rtog pa las/ /bsnyen gnas rang gis blang ba yi/ / cho ga sems bskyed 'dra bar gsungs/ /des na cho ga khyad par yod/ /la la bsnyen gnas bsrungs pa yi/ /nangs par bsnyen gnas 'bul dgos zer | | bsnyen gnas mtshan mo 'das pa na/ /gtong phyir 'di la 'bul mi dgos/ /mdo sde pa yi lugs bzhin du/ mdo sde pa yan chad lan gcig slob dpon las blangs nas phyis nam 'dod dus na bsrung bas chog ces zer te/ spyod 'jug las/ spong ba'i sems ni thob pa las/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin par bshad/ /ces pa ltar ro/ / ji ltar 'dod tshe len na yang*/ /nangs par phan chad bsrung ba yi/ /bsam pa med phyir sdom pa gtong*/ /de yi phyir na 'bul mi dgos/ /la la bsnyen gnas 'chol ba thos/ /'di 'dra gang na'ang bshad pa med/ kha cig bsnyen gnas bsrungs pa'i tshe/ /nya dang gnam stong tshes brgyad la/ / lha bsgom tha dad ma byas na/ /bsnyen gnas bsrung du mi 'dod zer/ / 'di yang re zhig brtag par bya/ /bsnyen gnas so sor tharapa'i lugs/ / gtso cher nyan thos gzhung lugs yin/ /yi dam lha yi bsgom bzlas ni/ / gsang sngags pa yi gdams ngag yin/ /nyan thos gzhung las bshad pa med | | des na lha bsgom ma byas kyang*/ /bsnyen gnas nyams par 'gyur ba med/ /'on kyang gsang sngags lugs byed na/ /yi dam bsgom pa bsod nams che/ /theg pa chen po las byung ba'i/ /so sor thar pa bshad kyis nyon//byang chub sems dpa' nyid la yang*/ /so sor thar pa 'bogs pa yin/ /cho ga 'ga' zhig yod mod kyi//de yi cho ga phal cher nub/ /gso sbyong rang gis blang ba sogs/ /cho ga'i lag len 'ga' zhig yod/ /rgyal sras byams pa 'jam dbyangs sogs/ /bdag nyid chen po 'ga' zhig gis | | mkhan po mdzad nas 'gro mang la/ /bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad do zhes/ /tshig 'bru tsam zhig dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdo las/ gsungs mod kyi/

/'on kyang de yi cho ga ni/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis 'bogs pa/ / mdo las gsungs pa ngas ma mthong*/ /'di 'dra sngon gyi cho ga ste/ /'phags pa rnams kyi spyod yul yin/ byams pa la sogs pa dbu skra ring po rgyan dang bcas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa ni 'phags pa rnams kyi spyod yul yin gyi// so so skye bos byar mi rung*/ / des na da lta'i cho ga ni/ /bsam pa sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i/ /cho ga nyan thos lugs bzhin gyis/ /so sor thar pa rigs brgyad po/ /byang sems so sor thar par 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /so sor thar pa'i bslab bya yi/ khyad par cung zad bshad kyis nyon/ /'di la sdig to mi dge'i phyogs/ /phal cher nyan thos lugs bzhin bsrung*// 'dod pas dben pa'i ltung ba 'ga'/ /byang chub sems dpa'i lugs bzhin bsrung*/ /'jig rten ma dad gyur pa'i cha/ /gnyis ka mthun rnams 'bad pas bsrung*/ /'jig rten 'jug pa'i rgyur 'gyur na/ /theg chen so sor thar las gnang*/ /dper na nyan thos dge slong ni/ /gser dngul len pa thub pas bkag /byang chub sems dpa'i dge slong la/ /gzhan don 'gyur na ltung ba med/ /nyan thos sems can don yin yang*// 'dod chen po la ltung ba 'byung*/ /theg chen gzhan gyi don yin na// 'dod chen ltung ba med ces

byang chub sems dpa'i sa las/ gsungs | | so sor thar pa lugs gnyis po/ /de 'dra'i rnam dbye shes par bya/ /theg chen so sor thar yin yang*/ /dge slong la sogs sdom pa yi/ /ldog pa shi ba'i tshe na gtong*/ /byang chub sems kyi ldog pa dang*/ /de yi 'bras bu shi yang 'byung | | de nas las dang rnam smin gyi/ /rnam par dbye ba bshad kyis nyon | | las la dge sdig lung ma bstan/ /yin zhes rgyal bas mdo las gsungs | | dge ba legs par spyad pa ste/ /rnam smin bde ba skyed pa yin | | sdig pa nyes par spyod pa ste/ /rnam smin sdug bsngal skyed par byed || btang snyoms gnyis ka ma yin pas/ /rnam par smin pa'ang gnyis ka min/ /'di dag byas pa'i las yin pas/ /'dus byas yin par shes par bya/ /chos kyi dbyings ni 'dus ma byas/ /yin pa'i phyir na las ma yin | pas/ / des na dge ba/ dang sdig pa 'i nang du 'du ba/ min/ /las la thub pas rnam gnyis gsungs/ /sems pa dang ni bsam pa'o/ /sems pa yid kyi las yin te/ /bsam pa de ni lus ngag gi'o/ /chos kyi dbyings ni gnyis ka min/ /de phyir dge sdig las las grol/ /gzhan yang las la rnam bzhi gsungs/ /las dkar rnam smin dkar ba dang*/ /las gnag rnam smin gnag pa dang*/ /las dkar rnam smin gnag pa dang*// las gnag rnam smin dkar ba'o/ /bsam pa dag pa'i sbyin pa sogs/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug / gnyis ka dkar bas mkhas pas bya/ /bza' ba'i don du gsod pa sogs mi dge ba bcu/ / gnyis ka gnag pas mkhas pas spang*// sems can mang po bskyab pa'i/ phyir gcig gsod sogs/ /las gnag rnam smin dkar na bya/ / dgra gsod pa'i/ phyir sbyin pa gtong ba dang lha mchod pa/ la sogs | | las dkar rnam smin gnag pa spang*/ /gzhan yang las la rnam gnyis gsungs/ /'phen byed las dang rdzogs byed las/ /de dag dbye na mu bzhi yod/ /'phen byed dge bas 'phangs pa la/ /rdzogs byed kyang ni dge ba dang*/ /'phen byed sdig pas 'phangs pa la/

/rdzogs byed kyang ni sdig pa dang*/ /'phen byed dge la rdzogs byed sdig /'phen byed sdig la rdzogs byed dge /de dag dper brjod mdor bsdus pa/ /bshad par bya yis yid la zung*/ /mtho ris gsum po 'grub pa ni/ /dge ba'i las kyis 'phen pa yin/ /de dag bde ba 'byung ba ni/ /rdzogs byed dge bas 'phangs pa yin/ /ngan song gsum du skye ba ni/ /'phen byed sdig pa yin par gsung*/ /de yi sdug bsngal bye brag kun/ /rdzogs byed las ni sdig pa yin/ /mtho ris dge bas 'phangs mod kyi/ /de yi nad dang gnod pa kun | | rdzogs byed sdig pa yin par gsungs/ /ngan 'gro'i 'phen byed sdig yin yang*/ /de yi lus sems bde ba yis/ /gnas skabs dge bas 'phangs par mngon pa dang mdo sde du ma las/ gsungs/ /gzhan yang gcig tu dkar ba dang*//gcig tu gnag dang 'dren ma'i las//rnam pa gsum du thub pas gsungs//gcig tu dkar bas bde ba bskyed//gcig tu gnag pas sdug bsngal bskyed/ /'dren ma'i las kyis bde ba dang*/ /sdug bsngal 'dren ma bskyed par mngon pa dang mdo sde las/ gsungs/ /'di 'dra'i las dang rnam smin gyi/ /rnam par dbye ba shes gyur na/ /da gzod las kyi rgyu 'bras la/ /shin tu mkhas pa nyid du 'gyur/ /mu stegs grangs can pa 'i gzhung las/ dge dang sdig pa ji snyed dang*// 'khor ba dang ni grol ba yang*/ /gtso bo'i nang na gdod nas yod/ /'on kyang thabs kyis gsal bar 'byin/ /zhes bya ba dang*/ 'o ma'i dus na zho gang dang*/ /zho yi dus na mar gang zhes/ /drag po len gyis bshad pa ste/ /'bigs byed gnas pa'ang de skad smra/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa mang du bshad do/ / rnams ni/ /gshis la dge sdig yod ces zer/ /rgyu la 'bras bu gnas par 'dod/ /bod kyang la la de rjes 'brang bod kha cig rgyu yi dus na 'bras bu yod/ /las 'phro can gyis rtogs par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i lung 'dren pa du ma yod de mdo rgyud sangs rgyas pa'i bstan bcos khungs ma thams cad la gang nas kyang bshad pa med/

mu stegs kyi lugs la mos pa'i bod kyis rang bzor sbyar ba yin yid brtan med/phal po che'i rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi/ bsngo ba 'i le'u/ las || 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod/ /byas dang byed 'gyur byed pa zhes// gsungs pa'i dgongs pa 'chad pa la/ kha cig grangs can lugs bzhin du || yod pa'i dge ba zhes bya ba/ /rang byung du ni grub par 'dod/ /de la bde gshegs snying po zer//grangs can lugs 'di mi 'thad pas/ /lung dang rigs pas dgag par bya/ /bde gshegs snying po zhes bya ba/ /chos dbyings 'gyur med nyid la gsungs/ /de skad du yang rgyud bla las/ sems ni rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur med gsungs | rgyud bla ma nyid las/ nyes pa glo bur dang ldan pa/ /yon tan rang bzhin dang ldan phyir||ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes gsungs so// mdo las de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /snying po 'gyur med yin zhes bshad | | bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni/ skyes pa'am/ 'gag pa'am/ 'chi ba'am/ 'chi 'pho ba dang*/ skye ba ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni/ 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid kyi yul las 'das pa ste/ rtag pa/ brtan pa/ zhi ba/ g.yung drung ngo*/ /zhes bya ba dang*/ shā ri'i bu don dam pa zhes bya ba ni/ sems can gyi khams kyi tshig bla dwags so/ /shā ri'i bu sems can gyi khams zhes bya ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i tshig bla dwags so/ /shwa ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po zhes bya ba 'di ni/ chos kyi sku'i tshig bla dwags so/ / zhes gsungs so/ / klu sgrub kyis kyang dbu ma las | | de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin gang*/ /de ni 'gro ba'i rang bzhin yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin med/ /'gro ba 'di yi rang bzhin med/ /ces gsungs pa yang de nyid yin/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa las/

/chos kyi dbyings ni dus gsum dang/ khams gsum dang ni dge sdig las/ /rnam par grol ba yin zhes gsungs/ / brgyad stong pa las/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de ni/ 'das pa yang ma yin/ ma 'ongs pa yang ma yin/ da ltar byung ba yang ma yin/ gang 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba ma yin pa gang yin pa de ni dus gsum las rnam par grol ba'o//gang dus gsum las rnam par grol ba de ni yongs su bsngo bar bya bar mi nus shing*/ de ni dmigs pa dang*/ mthong ba dang*/ rtogs pa dang*/ rnam par shes pa ma yin no//zhes gsungs so/ /'bum dang*/ nyi khri las kyang rgyas par gsungs so| | des na chos kyi dbyings la ni/ /bsngo ba med ces 'bum las chos kyi dbyings la yongs su bsngo ba med do zhes/ rgyal bas bshad | | yang dag sbyor ba'i rgyud las kyang*/ /de yi sdig dang bsod nams kyi/ /cha gnyis rnam par rtog pa ste/ /mkhas pas 'di gnyis rnam par spang*/ /zhes gsungs de bzhin gsang 'dus la/ /sogs pa'i rgyud sde kun las gsungs// 'phags pa klu sgrub nyid kyis kyang*/ /gtam bya rin chen phreng ba las/ gnas med chos kyis skrag gyur pa/ /skye bo gnas la mngon dga' zhing*/ /yod dang med las ma 'das pa/ /mi mkhas rnams ni 'phung bar 'gyur/ /'jigs min gnas 'jigs de dag ni// 'phung la gzhan yang 'phung bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po 'phung ba de dag gis/ /ci nas mi 'phung de ltar gyis| |rgyal po khyod ni mi 'phung bar/ /bgyi slad 'jig rten 'das pa'i lugs/ /gnyis la mi gnas yang dag pa/ /rnam dag lung gi dbang gis bshad/ / sdig dang bsod nams bya ba 'das | | zab mo bkrol ba'i don dang ldan/ /mu stegs gzhan dang rang nyid kyi'ang*/ /gnas min skrag pas ma myangs pa/ /zhes gsungs gzhan yang de nyid las/ /shes pas yod dang med zhi'i phyir/ /sdig dang bsod nams las 'das pa/ /de yis bde 'gro ngan 'gro las/ /de ni thar pa dam par bzhed/

/ces gsungs 'di yang chos kyi dbyings/ /dge sdig med pa'i lung yin no/ kha cig bde gshegs snying po'i sgra/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying por 'dod/ /'di ni bde gshegs snying po'i khams/ /sbyong byed yin gyi khams dngos min/ /de skad du yang rnam 'grel las/ /sgrub byed thugs rje goms pa las/ /zhes gsungs bslab btus nyid las kyang*// stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /bskyed pas bsod nams dag par 'gyur | | zhes gsungs de bzhin mdo sde dang*/ /rgyud kun las kyang de skad gsungs/ /mngon pa'i gzhung las nyan thos rnams/ /ngo bo nyid kyi dge ba zhes/ /bshad pa dad pa la sogs pa/ /bcu gcig kho na yin zhes gsung | | don dam dge ba zhes bshad pa/ /de bzhin nyid la gsungs pa yin | | don dam sdig pa 'khor ba kun/ /nam mkha' dang*/ so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa/ gnyis/ /don dam lung ma bstan zhes bshad/ /de bzhin nyid la dge ba zhes/ /bshad pa'i dgongs pa 'di ltar yin/ / dper na nad dang bral ba ni/ /lus bde mya ngan med pa la/ /sems bde zhes ni 'jig rten zer/ /'di dag sdug bsngal med pa las/ /gzhan pa'i bde ba med mod kyi/ /'on kyang sdug bsngal med tsam la/ /bde ba yin zhes kun la grags/ /de bzhin chos kyi dbyings la yang*/ /sdig pa med pa tsam zhig las/ /lhag pa'i dge ba med mod kyi/ /dge ba yin zhes btags par zad/ /gzhan yang mngon pa'i gzhung rnams las/ / zas kyis 'grangs pa dang 'khrig pa'i rjes/ la sogs pa/ la/ /'dod chags dang*| bral bar gsungs mod kyi/ /'on kyang gtan nas bral ba yi/ / 'dod chags dang*/ bral ba mtshan nyid pa/ ma yin no/ /de bzhin chos kyi dbyings la yang*/ /dge ba yin zhes gsungs gyur kyang*/ /'bras bu bde ba bskyed pa yi/ / dge ba bcu la sogs pa dge ba dngos ni ma yin no/ /ci nas chos dbyings dge ba nyid/ /yin na ha cang thal 'gyur te/ /chos kyi dbyings las ma gtogs pa'i/

/chos gzhan med phyir mdo sde rgyan las/ chos kyi dbyings las ma gtogs pa'i/ /gang phyir chos med de yi phyir/ /zhes gsungs so/ / sdig pa dang | | lung ma bstan yang dge bar 'gyur/ /de lta yin na sems can kun | | ngan 'gror 'gro ba mi srid do/ / de'i sdig pa'ang chos kyi dbyings yin la/ chos kyi dbyings dge ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ / la la byams dang snying rje sogs/ / gshis kyi dge ba yin zhes zer/ /'di yang de ltar nges pa med/ /mi mkhas pa yi byams snying rje/ nye du la byams pas dkon mchog gi dkor 'phrogs nas gso ba dang*/ gzhan gyi rlung nad gso ba'i phyir srog chags bsad nas sha ster ba la sogs pa// ngan song rgyu ru thub pas gsungs/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i snying rje la/ / dgongs nas dge bar gsungs pa yin/ /des na 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang zhes bya ba'i don bshad na/ 'gro ba thams cad kyis/ /byas pa'i dge ba la dgongs nas/ /'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod/ pa dang*/ / ces bya'i tshig gis gsungs pa yin/ /gal te chos kyi dbyings yin na/ /ji snyed ces bya'i sgra mi 'thad/ /yod ces bya ba'i sgra yang 'gal/ /de yi rgyu mtshan 'di ltar yin | | ji snyed ces bya mang po'i sgra/ /chos kyi dbyings la mang nyung med/ / de ni spros bral yin phyir ro/ /chos dbyings yod pa'ang ma yin te/ /yod tsam mi rtag gis khyab par/ /chos kyi grags pas legs par gsungs/ rnam 'grel las/ 'jig pa yod tsam 'brel ba can/ /nyid phyir sgra ni mi rtag nyid/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs so/ / klu sgrub kyis kyang dbu ma las/ /gal te mya ngan 'das dngos na/ /mya ngan 'das pa 'dus byas 'gyur/ /dngos po 'dus byas ma yin pa/ /'ga' yang gang na'ang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs gzhan yang de nyid las/ /gang dag rang bzhin gzhan dngos dang*/ / dngos dang dngos med nyid lta ba/ /de dag sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /de nyid mthong ba ma yin no/

/zhes gsungs gzhan yang de nyid las/ / bcom ldan dngos dang dngos med pa/ /mkhyen pas kātyā ya na yi/ / gdams ngag las ni yod pa dang*/ /med pa gnyis ka dgag par mdzad// ces gsungs gzhan yang de nyid las/ /yod ces bya ba rtag par 'dzin// med ces bya ba chad par lta/ /de phyir yod dang med pa la/ /mkhas pas gnas par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa yang chos kyi dbyings/ /yod med gnyis ka min pa'i lung*/ /des na sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /gus par byed na chos kyi dbyings/ /yod med gnyis kar ma zungs shig mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ mya ngan 'das pa'i chos la chos med de/ /gang phyir de nyid nam yang yod mi 'gyur| |rtog can dag gis yod dang med ces bstan/ /de ltar brtags pas sdug bsngal zhi mi 'gyur| |zhes bya ba dang*/ yod dang med ces bya ba mtha' yin te/ /gtsang dang mi gtsang 'di yang mtha' yin no/ /de ltar mtha' gnyis rnam par spang bya ste/ /mkhas pas dbus la'ang gnas par yong mi bya/ /zhes bya ba dang*/ yod dang med ces bya ba rtsod pa ste/ /gtsang dang mi gtsang 'di yang rtsod pa yin/ /rtsod par gyur pas sdug bsngal zhi mi 'gyur/ /rtsod pa med par gyur na sdug bsngal 'gag |ces gsungs so// rigs pas kyang ni 'di 'grub ste/ /yod tsam don byed nus phyir ro/ /chos kyi dbyings la bya byed med/ ཾ《zha》ta bya byed med ces pa| mang nyung med ces pa/ hor par la snang / ཾ /de ni spros bral yin phyir ro/ / gzhan yang yod pa'i dge ba ni/ /chos nyid yin na 'gro kun gyi/ /dge ba zhes bya smos ci dgos/ /bems po dang ni dngos med dang*/ /'phags pa'i chos nyid cis mi bsngo/ ste de dag kyang chos kyi dbyings yin la/ /chos kyi dbyings thams cad bsngo rgyu yin phyir ro/ /des na gzhung de'i dgongs pa ni/ / legs par bshad kyis 'di ltar zungs/ /'gro ba kun gyis byas pa yi/ / dge ba ji snyed yod pa zhes/ /bya ba'i sgra ni spyir bstan yin/

/byas dang byed 'gyur byed pa zhes/ /dus gsum dbye ba dmigs bsal yin/ / yang na gzhan gyis byas pa yi/ /dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan rang nyid kyis/ /byas dang byed 'gyur byed pa zhes/ /bshad kyang mdo dang 'gal ba med/ /yang na mdor bstan rgyas bshad do/ /dper na 'gro ba kun gyi sdig /ji snyed yod pa byas pa dang*/ /byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa rnams/ /rgyal ba'i mdun du bshags par shog /ces bya'i tshig dang mtshungs pa yin/ /'di la'ang dus gsum las gzhan pa'i/ /yod pa'i sdig pa gang yang med/ /de bzhin dus gsum las gzhan pa'i/ / yod pa'i dge ba srid ma yin/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan nyid las kyang*/ /yod pa zhes bya bsgrub par gsungs/ / rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba nyid las/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten kun na gang yod pa'i/ /dge ba de dag yang dag bsgrubs pas na/ /'gro ba kun la phan dang bde sems kyis/ /ye shes mkhas pa de yis yongs su bsngo/ /zhes gsungs so/

/ chos dbyings dge bar byas nas ni/ /de la bsngo ba'i rgyur byed pa/ /bsngo bas 'gyur na 'dus byas 'gyur/ /mi 'gyur bsngo ba don med yin/ /mdo sde rnams las chos kyi dbyings/ /'gyur ba med ces rgyal bas gsungs/ / rtsa ba'i shes rab nyid las kyang*/ /rang bzhin rgyu dang rkyen las ni/ / 'byung bar rigs pa ma yin no/ /rgyu dang rkyen las byung ba yi/ /rang bzhin byas pa can du 'gyur/ /rang bzhin byas pa can zhes byar/ /ji lta bur na rung bar 'gyur/ /rang bzhin dag ni bcos min dang*/ /gzhan la ltos pa med pa yin/ /zhes gsungs gzhan yang de nyid las/ /gal te rang bzhin gyis yod na/ /de ni med nyid mi 'gyur ro/ /rang bzhin gzhan du 'gyur ba ni/ /nam yang 'thad pa ma yin no/ /de la sogs pa'i lung rigs rnams/ /chos dbyings dge ba min par gsungs/ /gal te chos nyid de bzhin nyid/ /bsngo bya'i dge ba ma yin mod/ /byang chub sems dpa'i blo sbyong la/ /bsngos kyang nyes pa med snyam na/ /ma yin 'di la nyes pa yod/ /dmigs pa'i 'du shes yod pa'i phyir/ /bsngo ba dug dang bcas par 'gyur/ /'di 'dra'i bsngo ba byas gyur na/ /sbal pa rma can gcig dong du zhugs na sbal pa thams cad 'chi ba/ ji bzhin du/ /bsngo ba la dmigs pa'i dug gcig zhugs na dge ba/ thams cad 'jig par 'gyur/ / bar gsungs/ chos nyid spros bral ngang nas ni/ /dge ba ji snyed byas pa rnams/ /'grub bam gal te mi 'grub kyang*/ /'gro ba'i don du bsngo byed na/ /byang chub sems dpa'i blo sbyong yin/ /chos nyid bsngo rgyud byed na ni/ /blo sbyong du yang mi rung ngo*/ /de yi rgyu mtshan 'di ltar yin/ /chos dbyings spros dang bral ba la || dge bar byed na dmigs par 'gyur/ te/ dge sdig lung ma bstan gsum ga las yin la/ las blo yul du 'gyur zhing*/ blo'i yul du byas na dmigs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// dmigs dang bcas pa'i 'du shes kyis/

/bsngo ba dug dang bcas par gsungs/ /dper na dug dang bcas pa yi/ kha zas bzang po za ba ltar/ / dkar po'i chos la dmigs pa yang*/ /de dang 'dra bar rgyal bas gsungs | | sdud pa las/ gal te mtshan mar byed na de ni bsngo ma yin/ /ci ste mtshan ma med na byang chub bsngo ba yin/ /ji ltar dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas bzang za ba/ dkar po'i chos la dmigs pa'ang de 'drar rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'bum las kyang*/ dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i 'du shes can la yongs su bsngo ba med do/ /zhes gsungs so// mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan las kyang*/ /yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can/ /de yi byed pa mchog yin no/ /de ni dmigs med rnam pa can/ /phyin ci ma log mtshan nyid do/ /zhes gsungs mdo rgyud thams cad mthun/ par dmigs pa yod na bsngo ba thams cad phyin ci log tu gsungs so// ཾ《zha》ta dmigs pa'i 'du shes can rnams ni//dug dang bcas pa'i bsngo bar gsungs// ཾ gang dag dmigs pa med pa yi//chos kyi dbyings la'ang yod pa yi/ /dge ba yin zhes dmigs byed pa/ / de yis chos can gzhan dag la/ /dmigs par 'gyur ba lta ci smos/ / byi bas dbyug pa'ang zos gyur na/ /snum khur zos pa smos ci dgos/ / gzhan yang chos nyid de bzhin nyid/ /bsngo ba'i yul du byed pa dang*/ / chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa zhes/ /zer ba gong 'og 'gal ba yin/ / des na legs par soms la smros/ /la la bde gshegs snying po'i sgra/ / chos kyi dbyings la mi zer bar/ /sems can kho na'i khams la 'dod/ / sems can khams de brtag par bya/ khams de dngos po'am dngos med dam || gnyis ka min par spros bral yin/ /rnam pa gsum las gzhan mi srid || dngos po yin na bems po dang*/ /rig pa gnyis su kha tshon chod/ / bems po sems can khams nyid du/ /'dod pa mu stegs bye brag pa 'ga' yi lugs/ /yin gyi sangs rgyas pa la med/ /rig pa yin na rnam shes kyi//

tshogs brgyad nyid las 'da' ba med/ /tshogs brgyad 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir/ /bde gshegs snying por mi 'thad de/ /mdo las bde gshegs snying po ni/ /'dus ma byas su gsungs phyir ro/ /'ga' las zag med sems rgyud ces/ /gsungs pa kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi/ / gsal cha nyid la dgongs pa yin/ /de ni ma bsgribs lung ma bstan/ / yin phyir dge ba'i tha snyad med/ /'on te zag med sems rgyud ces/ / tshogs brgyad las gzhan yod na ni/ /de tshe rnam shes tshogs dgur 'gyur | | des na tshogs brgyad las gzhan pa'i/ /zag med sems rgyud mi 'thad do/ /dngos med yin na don byed med/ /de la dge sdig 'thad ma yin/ /gal te sems can khams dngos dang*/ /dngos med gnyis ka ma yin par/ /spros bral yin na sngar bshad pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings las 'da' ba med/ /de lta yin na chos kyi dbyings/ /dge sdig med par bshad zin to/ /gal te bems po'i chos kyi dbyings/ /bde gshegs snying po ma yin yang*/ /sems can rnams kyi chos kyi dbyings*/ /bde gshegs snying po yin snyam na/ /ma yin chos kyi dbyings la ni/ /dbye ba med par rgyal bas 'bum las mang du/ gsungs/ /rigs pas kyang ni 'di 'grub bo/ /des na de bzhin gshegs pa yin/ /snying po spros bral yin pa'i phyir/ /sems can rnams la sangs rgyas dang*/ /'khor ba gnyis ka 'byung ba 'thad/ /'phags pa klu sgrub skyob nyid kyis/ /gang la stong pa nyid rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung ba yin//gang la stong nyid mi rung ba/ / de la thams cad rung ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa yang don 'di yin/ / theg pa chen po rgyud bla mar/ /bde gshegs khams kyi sgrub byed ni/ /gal te bde gshegs khams med na/ /sdug la skyo bar mi 'gyur zhing*/ /mya ngan 'das la 'dod pa dang*/ /don gnyer smon pa'ang med par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa yang 'di nyid de/ /nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga/ /sdug bsngal yin zhing mya ngan las/

/'das pa bde ba yin pas na/ /sems ni rang gnas snyeg pa'i phyir/ /me yi sgrub byed tsha ba ltar/ / bya tshang du snyegachu thur du 'bab| sems mthar stong pa nyid la dga' ba chos nyid yin pas/ bde gshegs khams kyi sgrub byed 'thad/ /'di don rgyas par brgyad stong pa'i/ /chos 'phags kyi ni le'ur ltos/ /'on kyang dpal phreng seng ge'i sgra dang gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal po la sogs pa/ mdo sde 'ga' zhig dang*/ /theg pa chen po rgyud bla mar/ /gos ngan nang na rin chen ltar/ /sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi/ /snying po yod par gsungs pa ni/ /dgongs pa yin par shes par bya/ /de yi dgongs gzhi stong nyid yin/ /dgos pa skyon lnga spang phyir gsungs/ spṛn nyon mongs/dang rmi lam las kyi lam/sgyu bzhin rnam smin gyi phung po/de dang der/ /shes bya thams cad rnam kun stong pa zhes/ /gsungs nas rgyal rnams yang 'dir sems can la/ /sangs rgyas snying po yod ces ci ste gsungs/ /sems zhum sems can dman la brnyas pa dang*/ /yang dag min 'dzin yang dag chos la skur/ /bdag chags lhag pa'i skyon lnga gang dag la/ /yod pa de dag de spong don du gsungs/ / dngos la gnod byed tshad ma ni/ /de 'dra'i sangs rgyas khams yod na/ /mu stegs bdag dang mtshungs pa dang*/ /bden pa'i dngos por 'gyur phyir dang*/ /nges pa'i don gyi mdo sde dang*/ /rnam pa kun tu 'gal phyir ro/ /'di don de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /snying po'i le'u'i mdo sder ltos/ / blo gros chen po/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni stong pa nyid dang*/ yang dag pa'i mtha' dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa dang*/ ma skyes pa dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang*/ smon pa med pa la sogs pa'i tshig gi don rnams la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying por bstan par byas nas/ byis pa rnams bdag med pas 'jigs par 'gyur ba'i gnas rnam par spang ba'i don du de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i sgo bstan pas rnam par mi rtog pa'i gnas snang ba med pa'i spyod yul ston te zhes bya ba dang*/

blo gros chen po de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis mu stegs byed bdag tu zhen pa rnams drang ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i sgo bstan pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ston te zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs so// slob dpon zla ba grags pas kyang*/ / dbu ma la ni 'jug pa las/ /bde gshegs snying po drang don du/ / gsungs pa de yang shes par gyis/ /'ga' zhig bsngo ba byed pa 'i tshe na ril ba spyi blugs kyis/ chu/ /sbreng ba'i lag len byed pa yod/ ces grags/ /'di ni mu stegs rig byed pa'i/ /lugs yin sangs rgyas pa la med/ / skyes rabs las thams cad sgrol gyis glang po che byin pa na bram ze la chu sbrengs pa de'ang mu stegs kyi bram ze yin/ des na gang dang gang byed pa//sangs rgyas gsung bzhin gus pas sgrubs// bsngo ba de yang mdor bsdu na/ /gnas dang gnas ma yin pa gnyis/ / gnas kyi bsngo ba 'grub par gsungs/ /gnas min bsngos kyang 'grub mi 'gyur/ /'di dag gnyis ka mdo las gsungs/ mdo gang las gsungs na// 'jam dpal sangs rgyas kyi/ zhing gi bkod pa/ las ni/ /chos rnams thams cad rkyen bzhin te/ /'dun pa'i rtsa la rab tu gnas/ /gang gis smon lam ci btab pa/ /de 'dra'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa/ 'di ni gnas kyi bsngo ba/ la dgongs/ / dkon mchog brtsegs par bu mo dri med byin gyis zhus pa'i mdor/ /chos rnams chos nyid bsngo ba yis/ /mi 'gyur gal te 'gyur na ni/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas gcig nyid kyi/ /bsngo ba deng sang cis mi 'grub/ /ces gsungs 'di ni gnas min gyi/ /bsngo ba nyid la dgongs pa yin/ / dri med byin gyis zhus pa las/ rigs kyi bu/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid ni smon lam gyi dbang gis bsgyur bar mi nus so/ /gal te nus par gyur na sems can thams cad mya ngan las bzla'o zhes de bzhin gshegs pa re re'i dgongs pa de smon lam gyi dbang gis ji ltar mi 'grub ste/

rnam grangs des na smon lam gyi dbang gis bsgyur bar mi nus par rig par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so// des na bsngo rgyu'i dge ba dang*/ /bshags par bya ba'i sdig pa yang*/ /byas pa'i dge sdig yin mod kyi/ /ma byas pa la dge sdig med/ /de yi rnam gzhag bshad kyis nyon/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /des bskyaid las ni mi dge ba/ /ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med/ /des bskyed las ni dge ba zhes/ / gtam bya rin chen phreng ba las gsungs pa'i dgongs pa shes nas ni/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyad par bya | | nyan thos dge ba phal cher yang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdig par 'gyur | | byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba yang*/ /nyan thos sdig tu 'gyur bar gsungs/ /bskal pa du mar dge spyad kyang*/ /nyan thos sa ru sems bskyed na/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdig pa lci/ /de ni nyan thos dge chen yin | | sdud pa las/ gal te bskal pa bye bar dge ba'i las lam bcu/ /spyod kyang rang rgyal dgra bcom nyid la 'dod skyed na/ /de tshe tshul khrims skyon byung tshul khrims nyams pa yin//sems skyed de ni phas pham las kyang shin tu lci/ /zhes gsungs so// 'dod pa'i yon tan lngar spyod kyang*/ /thabs mkhas byang chub sems ldan na/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi dge chen yin/ /nyan thos rnams kyi sdig par gsungs/ / sdud pa las/ gal te byang chub sems dpa' 'dod yon lnga spyod kyang*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun skyabs song ste/ /sangs rgyas 'grub bya snyam du kun mkhyen yid byed na/ /mkhas pa tshul khrims pha rol phyin gnas rig par bya/ /zhes gsungs so// gzhan gyi don gyi sems brtan pa'i// pham pa bzhi po spyad na yang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba ste/ /nyan thos rnams kyi sdig par gsungs/ /'khor ba'i 'gro la chags pa ni/ / gzhan don yin yang nyan thos kyi/ /sdig yin de nyid rgyal sras kyi/ / dge ba yin par shes par bya/

/ 'di dag gi don dkon mchog brtsegs par ltos/ dkar nag zang thal zhes bya ba'i/ /chos skad 'di 'dra rgya gar na med bod du thos/ ngo mtshar che bar grag /de dag gis ni drang don la/ /nges pa'i don du 'khrul par zad/ /ded dpon snying rje chen po yis/ /tshong pa g.yon can bsad pa yin/ /las kyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /seng ldeng tshal pa zug pa dang*/ / bram ze'i khye'u bla mas dge sbyong mgo reg la byang chub lta ga la yod ces smras pa'i rnam smin gyis lo drug dka' ba spyad pa dang*/ / bram ze'i slob dpon du gyur pa na| sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyi nyan thos la/ 'di tsho rta chas rul ba bsnyod rgyu zhes smras pa'i rnam smin gyis rta chas rul ba gsol ba dang*/ /bram ze'i bu mos skur ba dang || rig byed kyi zhar chos su gyur pa na slob dpon gyi 'khor phye ste bshad pas dge 'dun dbyen gyi rgyu la sogs/ /thub pa'i sku tshe snga ma yi/ /las ngan smin par 'dul ba lung las/ gsungs pa ni/ /des 'dul ba yi skye bo la/ /dgongs pa'i dbang gis gsungs pa ni drang don yin gyi nges don ma yin/ ste/ /thabs de'i rgyu mtshan gsang chen la mkhas pa'i mdo sder ltos/ /de ni nges don mdo sdai yin || 'dul ba lung nyan thos kyi gzhung*/ drang ba'i don yin pa de/ la yid ma rton/ / gal te rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /las ngan smin pa bden na ni/ / tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa don med cing*/ /dgra bcom dang yang 'dra bar 'gyur | | sku gsum rnam gzhag byar mi rung*/ /de yi 'thad pa bshad kyis nyon | | tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /stug po bkod par sangs rgyas pa'i/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nyid yin/ /de yi sprul pa'i sku nyid ni//zas gtsang sras su 'khrungs pa yi/ /shākya seng ge 'di yin no// 'di ni gdul bya smin pa'i phyir/ /gshegs dang bzhugs dang mnal ba dang | | mu ge'i grong du gshegs pa dang*/

/lhung bzed stong par byon pa dang | | bsod snyoms mang du rnyed pa dang*/ /dgra dang nye du'i 'brel ba dang | | rad rod can du gzims pa dang*/ /res 'ga' bsnyung bar gshegs pa dang*/ /gzhan gyis skur ba sna tshogs dang*/ /res 'ga' snyan pa'i ba dan dang*/ /bde dang dges par spyod pa sogs/ /rnam pa sna tshogs ston pa ni/ /sprul pa yin gyi rang rgyud min/ /gal te sangs rgyas dngos la ni/ /las ngan smin par 'dod na yang*/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nyid la/ / seng ldeng gi tshal pa zug pa la sogs pa smin par rigs kyi sprul pa'i sku/ /shākya thub pa la sogs la/ 'dzugs par mi rigs/ / smin par 'dod pa mun sprul yin/ /dper na sgyu ma'i mkhan po la/ /las ngan 'byung gi des sprul pa'i/ /sgyu ma la ni mi 'byung bzhin/ /des na dgongs pa shes dgos so/ /'di yi lung dang rigs pa rnams/ /dbyig gnyen gyi rnam bshad rig pa/ dang ni legs ldan

'byed kyi rtog ge 'bar ba/ sogs/ /mkhas pa'i gzhung rgyas pa'i bstan bcos/ bzhin shes par gyis/ /ye bkag ye gnang zhes bya ba'ang | | sangs rgyas bstan dang mthun ma yin/ /nyan thos dang ni theg chen gyi/ /gnang bkag thams cad gcig tu nges pa/ med/ /des na la lar gnang ba ni/ /la la'i bkag pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de yi 'thad pa ji ltar yin | | rnam dag lung bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /nyan thos rtsa ba'i sde bzhi la/ /'dul ba mi 'dra rnam bzhi yod/ / skad kyang legs sbyar thams cad yod smra'o/ /gnas brtan pa'i rang bzhin gyi skad/ dang*/ / phal chen pa'i zur bcag pa dang mang pos bkur ba'i sha za'i skad/ /rnam pa bzhi ru gnas pa yin | | de las gyes pa bcod brgyad la/ /'dul ba'i dbye ba'ang bco brgyad yod/ /dang por sdom pa len pa dang*/ /bar du bsrung dang phyir bcos dang*/ /so sor thar pa 'don pa dang*/ /tha mar sdom pa gtong ba'i tshul | | sde pa thams cad mi mtshungs pas/ /gcig gis bkag pa gcig la gnang*/ /gal te sde pa gcig bden gyi/ /de las gzhan pa brdzun snyam na/ /rgyal po kri kri'i rmi lam na ras yug gcig las bzhi/de las bco brgyad du gshags pa/ ltar/ /sde pa thams cad bden par gsungs/ /'di don rgyas par sde pa ni/ /tha dad bklag pa'i 'khor lo dang*/ /'dul ba 'od ldan la sogs spyod 'jug ltos/ /sde pa kun gyi bslab pa yang*/ /shes na gcig tu 'gyur zhe na/ /shes kyang phal cher tha dad yin/ /dper na thams cad yod smra ba'i/ /mdo sde legs sbyar skad du yod/ /gnas brtan pa dag legs sbyar gyi/ /mdo sde bton na rkang pa re la nyes byas re tshigs bcad gcig bton na| ltung ba rdzogs pa/ ra byed/ /thams cad yod smra rang nyid kyi/ /gsol bzhi'i cho gas sdom pa skye/ /de yi cho ga bzhin byas na/ /sde pa gzhan gyi dge slong 'jig /thams cad yod smra smin ma'i spu/ /bzhar na ltung yin sde pa phal chen pa la sogs pa/

'ga'/ /ma bzhar na ni ltung bar 'dod/ / phal chen pa la sogs pa/ la la bu ram phyi dro 'gog kha cig thams cad yod smra/ ltung ba med ces zer/ / thams cad yod smra sogs/ la la byin len lag pa bkan/ /la la de las gzhan du lag pa steng 'og byed/ / phal chen pa la sogs pa/ 'ga' zhig lhung bzed byin len byed/ / thams cad yod smra/ la la lhung bzed byin len 'gog/ thams cad yod smra sogs kha cig mir chags bsad pa la/ /pham pa gnas brtan pa la sogs pa la la pham pa med/ / mang pos bkur ba/ la la'i so sor thar pa la/ / gling gzhi'i tshigs bcad gcig las med/ / thams cad yod smra'i/ la la'i ring thung gnas brtan pa la sogs pa de las/ gzhan du yod/ /mdor na pham pa bzhi po nas | | brtsams te bslab par bya ba kun/ /sde pa thams cad mi mthun pas || gang gi bkag la gang gi gnang*/ /dper na bu ram phyi dro'i zas/ / ye gnang yin na sde pa gzhan/ /ltung ba dag dang bcas par 'gyur/ /ye bkag yin na thams cad/ yod smra yi/ /dge slong ltung ba can du 'gyur/ / byin len ma byas za ba yi/ /ltung ba mi skya la 'byung na/ /mi skya'ang dge slong nyid 'gyur bas/ /mi skyas byin len byas na yang*/ /dge slong gis ni dge slong la/ /byin len byas pa ji bzhin du/ /bza' bar rung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin kun la sbyar bar gyis/ kha cig rab tu byung ba la/ / ltung ba ji snyed 'byung ba de/ khyim pa nas ni dmyal ba'i bar/ /dud 'gro la sogs thams cad la/ / chos gos med pa dang*/ dbyar gnas/ dgag dbye/ rung chu la sogs pa/ ltung ba mtshungs par 'byung zhes zer/ /'di ni sangs rgyas dgongs pa min/ /ci phyir zhe na ltung ba de/ /bcas pa phan chad 'byung mod kyi | | ma bcas pa la ltung med phyir/ /des na thub pas 'dul ba lung las/ las dang po pa la*/ / nyes pa byas kyang ltung ba/ med do zhes/ gsungs/ /de lta min par thams cad la/ /gal te ltung ba kun 'byung na/ /'gro kun ltung ba dang bcas pas/

/thar pa thob pa lta ci smos/ /mtho ris kyang ni 'byung re skan/ / gzhan yang nyan thos dang theg chen gnang bkag mi gcig ste nyan thos rnam gsum dag pa'i sha /bza' rung gal te mi za na/ /lhas byin gyi ni brtul zhugs su/ 'gyur/ / te/ 'o ma sha dang lan tshwa dang*/ /gos dang dgon par gnas pa'o| |zhes lnga'i gcig sha mi za ba'o/ / theg pa che las sha rnams bkag / lang kar gshegs pa las/glang po'i rtsal dang sprin chen dang*/ /mya ngan 'das dang sor phreng dang*/ /laṅkar gshegs pa'i mdo las kyang*/ /ngas ni sha rnams rnam par smad/ /ces gsungs so/ / zos na ngan 'gro'i rgyu ru gsungs/ / nye ba 'khor gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nye ba 'khor nyan thos kyi gzhi'ang gzhan/ bsam pa'ang gzhan/ sbyor ba'ang gzhan yin la byang chub sems dpa'i gzhi'ang gzhan/ bsam pa'ang gzhan/ sbyor ba yang gzhan yin no/ /zhes gsungs so// de bzhin pha rol phyin pa byang sems la laṅkar gshegs par sha bkag pa/nyan thos la gnang dang*/ /gsang sngags kyi ni ltung ba la/ / gnang bkag 'ga' zhig tha dad yod/ /de 'dra'i 'gal ba ltag sprod la// ye bkag ye gnang ji ltar brtsi/ /des na ye bkag ye gnang gi /rnam gzhag phyogs gcig byar mi rung*/ /dper na padma'i so nam la/ /rtag tu 'dam dang ljan ljin dgos/ /shu dag sogs kyis bskor na skye/ /me tog gzhan la de mi dgos/ /chu las skye la skam sa dgra/ / skam sar skye la rlon pa dgra/ /grang sar dro ba'i rdzas mi smin/ /dro sar bsil ba 'thad ma yin | | des na bya ba gang ci'ang rung*/ /rang rang lugs bzhin byas na 'grub | | de las bzlog pa'i lugs byas na/ /mi 'grub grub kyang bzang po dka'/ /de bzhin gnang bkag thams cad kyang*/ /rang rang lugs bzhin byas na 'grub/ /gal te sdom pa ma blangs na/ /ltung ba'i tha snyad mi thob kyang*/ /rab tu byung la bcas pa yi/ /sdig pa khyim pa la yang 'byung*// de lta min par rab byung la/

/ched du byas nas sdig bsgo na/ /thub pas rab tu byung ba la/ /snying nad byas par 'gyur zhes zer/ /'di 'dra'i rigs pa gzu lums yin/ /'o na zhing yod rnams la yang*/ /ser ba la sogs 'byung 'gyur gyi/ /zhing med rnams la mi 'byung bas/ /zhing bzang byin pa'ang snying nad 'gyur/ /des na zhing la dgra yod kyang*/ /lo thog 'byung ba'i phan yon yod/ /de bzhin rab tu byung ba la/ /ltung ba srid mod phan yon che/ /dper na sprang po ser ba sogs/ /mi 'jigs mod kyi lo thog med/ /de bzhin khyim pa rnams la yang*/ /ltung ba med mod dge mi 'byung | | des na mdo dang bstan bcos las/ /rang bzhin kha na ma tho srog gcod pa sogs/ dang*/ /bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba/ / chos gos med pa la sogs/ rnam pa gnyis su sdus te gsungs*/ /rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba/ /sems can kun la sdig par 'gyur/ /bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba/ /bcas pa phyin chad ltung bar 'gyur/ /de lta min par ma bcas kyang*/ / ci nas sdig par 'gyur na ni/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga la sogs pa/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnams dang*/ /nye ba'i sras brgyad 'jam dpal dang*/ spyan ras gzigs/ la sogs pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' phal cher yang*/ /dbu skra ring zhing rgyan dang bcas/ kha dog sna tshogs na bza' can/ /phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'dzin pa rnams/ /ye bkag pa la spyod pa'i phyir/ /gshis kyi mi dge can du 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pa/ /ti lo nā ro la sogs pa/ / dge slong brtul zhugs bor ba yi/ /grub thob rnams kyang sdig can 'gyur | | tsandan gtsug na rin po ches zhus pa'i mdo las/ lhas bltas zhes bya'i 'jig rten gyi| spos kyi ngad ldan pa'i/ /dge slong ji snyed thams cad kyang*/ /rgyan dang bcas shing gos dkar ba/ /de dag kyang ni sdig can 'gyur/ /gshis kyi mi dge spyod phyir ro/ /dge bsnyen dge tshul sdom brtson la'ang*/ /sdig med srid par mi 'gyur te/

/de dag la yang da ge slong gi /ltung ba thams cad 'byung phyir ro/ /'di 'dra gang dag su zer ba/ /de yis rang gi rtsa ba dang | | brgyud pa'i bla mar gang gyur pa/ khyim pa'am ni dge bsnyen nam || rnal 'byor pa ru gang bzhugs pa/ /de dag thams cad smad pa ste// gshis kyi mi dge mdzad phyir dang*/ /ltung ba thams cad spyod phyir ro/ / des na mdo las brtul zhugs la/ /dge sdig gnyis ka med par gsungs | | zhing gi grab bzhin tshul khrims la/ /gus pa'i rgyu ru gsungs par zad/ / 'dul ba la bstod pa las/ ra ba mtshams kyi 'obs dang 'dra ba yi||zag pa kun gyi chu lon 'dul ba yin// zhes gsungs so// des na 'dod pas dben pa rab tu byung ba la bcas pa/ dang*/ /sdig to mi dge'i chos kyis ni/ /dben pa khyim pa dang rab tu byung ba gnyis ka la bkag pa zhes bya rnam gnyis gsungs/ /thub pa'i dgongs pa ji bzhin zungs/ /bu mo gser mchog 'od dpal gyis// blo gros chen po 'jam dpal la/ /rab tu 'byung bar zhus pa'i tshe/ /lus kyi rab byung bu mo lus rab tu byung ba rab tu byung ba ma yin gyi sems rab tu byung ba rab tu byung ba yin no/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs so/ / bkag nas kyang*/ /sems kyi rab byung thob par mdzad/ /gal te gshis la dge yod na/ /lus la ngur smrig cis mi bskon/ / te sdom pa med kyang gzugs btsun re ci yi phyir mi byed/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdo sde las/ /dad rdzas za ba'i nyes mthong nas | | dge slong lnga brgyas chos gos lhung bzed dang bcas pa/ sdom pa phul/ /de la thub pas sdom pa bsrung mi nus na phul ba nyid/ legs so/ / zhes gsungs/ / nas| 'phags pa byams pa'i bstan pa la/ /'dus pa 'khor dang por de la dgra bcom pa thob par/ lung bstan/ /des na sdom pa dge ba yin/ /cha lugs tsam la dge ba med/ /sdom pa med pa'i cha lugs kun/ /mdo dang bstan bcos rnams las bkag

/gshis la dge ba yod na ni/ /sdom pa med kyang rab byung gi /cha lugs tsam re cis mi gzung*/ /'di 'dra'i chos lugs bstan pa min/ /de la kha cig 'di skad du/ /gal te gshis la dge ba dang*/ /sdig pa gnyis ka med pa la/ /thub pas bcas pa la ltung ba yod/ ma bcas pa la ltung ba med ces/ ltung ba 'cha' na ni/ / mu stegs kyi dbang phyug ltar bde sdug kun gyi byed pa po/ /sangs rgyas yin par 'gyur ce na/ /'di yi lan la rnam gnyis las/ /mgo bsgre'i lan ni 'di ltar yin/ /gshis bcas pa la mi ltos par la ngo bo nyid kyis/ dge sdig yod na ni/ khyed kyang mu stegs chad lta na ra ེ/ 'byung lnga nyi ma zla ba dang*/ kha ba dang ni mngar ba sogs/ /dge dang sdig pa thams cad kyang*||sus kyang ma byas ngo bos grub ces so/ / 'ga' zhig ltar/ /ngo bo nyid rgyur smra bar 'gyur/ /gnyis pa dngos po'i lan la ni/ /gshis la dge ba/ dang sdig pa| med kyang*/ /bde sdug rang gi las kyis byas pa yin/ / gyi gshis la yod par mi 'dod/ las lus ngag gi kyi byed po rtsa ba sems nyid yin/ /sems ni dge dang mi dge ba'i/ /stobs kyis las la bzang ngan 'byung*/ / las bzang ngan de las bde sdug 'byung*/ /rang gis bsgrub par ma nus pa'i// de dag las bzang ba blang ngan pa dor bar byed pa yi/ /thabs ni sdom pa'i tshul khrims yin/ /brtul skra bregs chos gos la sogs pa'i zhugs tshul khrims bsrung ba'i thabs/ / tshul khrims bsrung ba de la gang la gang dgos pa'i/ / mtha' dag gi bslab pa 'cha' ba'i byed pa po/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin | 'on kyang theg pa chen po'i bslab pa phran tshegs 'ga' zhig sa chen po la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpas kyang 'cha' ba mdo sde rgyan las gsungs/ / des na gang zag gi bsam pa'i khyad par gyis/ / sde pa tha dad la gnyen po'i bye brag gis bcas pa mi 'dra ba du ma zhing mi 'dra ba la so nam mi 'dra ba bzhin

yod/ /de yi thabs su brtul zhugs dang*/ /'dul ba'i bcas pa mi 'dra ba/ /mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin/ des na bde dang sdug bsngal gyi/ /byed po sangs rgyas ma yin yang | | bslab pa 'cha' dang 'dul ba lung las/ bcom ldan 'das bslab pa 'cha' bar bzhed nas zhes bya ba dang*/ nyes pa byung yang ma bcas/ byung nas bcas/ ma byung yang bcas pa dang*/ bcas pa'i rjes su bcas pa la sogs pa rgyas par lung du ltos/ sngags sbyor ba'i/ / byed po sangs rgyas yin par gsungs/ / rnam 'grel las/ 'ga' yis brda byas nyid yin na/ /sngags rnams 'bras bu sgrub byed yin/ /ci ste dngos po'i nus yin na/ khyad par med ces gzhan la'ang 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba dang*/ 'bras bu 'dod pas sngags rnams ni/ /byas dang skyes bus byas brjod bya/ /skyes bu nus med sgrub byed ni//'di nyid kyis ni bsal ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rig byed pa na re/ tshig rnams log pa nyid kyi rgyu//nyes rnams skyes bu la brten phyir| |skyes bus ma byas bden don can/ /zhes ni la la brjod par byed//tshig rnams bden pa nyid kyi rgyu//yon tan skyes bu la brten phyir//skyes bus ma byas log pa'i don//cis min zhes ni la la brjod//ces rnam 'grel las gsungs so// sbu gu can dang gong ba can/ /rta la zhon pa la sogs dang*/ /lag nya sngar dge slong gis byin len ma byas pa'i zas la reg na phyis dge slong gis bzar mi rung ba/ dang ni bla gab nye 'khor dang bcas pa'i nang du bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa dang lhan cig tu nyal du mi rung ba nub tshangs sogs/ /'dul ba'i spyod pa ma yin pa/ /byas pa kun la gnong pa yi/ /tshul gyis bshags pa legs par bya/ /de dag ltung ba med do zhes/ / khyad du bsad nas smra na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod pa yin/ /rab tu byung ba 'bab pa dang*/ /phan tshun rtsod par byed pa dang*/ /dam chos nyo tshong byed pa dang*/
