/dge sbyong phyi dro za ba dang*/ /chang 'thung ba la sogs pa dang*/ /chos gos lhung bzed med pa sogs/ /chos dang 'gal ba'i spyod pa kun/ /ltung ba med ces sgrogs pa dang*/ /bla ma'i zhabs tog yin pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas bstan la phan pa sogs/ /smra na bstan pa spyi la gnod/ / 'di dag la nyes pa chen po dag yod kyang rang gis bsgrub par ma nus zhes pa'am/ / skye ba snga ma'i las ngan yin pas bya dgos pa byung zhes smra na ni/ /rang la gnod kyi bstan la min/ / de gnod tshabs chung*/ gal te skye ba snga ma yi/ /las ngan smin pa'i shugs nyid las/ / chos dang 'gal ba'i spyod pa kun/ /dbang med bya dgos byung na yang*/ / 'di ni chos min 'dul ba min/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'ang min no zhes// mnong ba'i tshul gyis legs par bshags/ / pa byed dgos/ chos dang 'gal ba la yang*/ 'di dag chos dang mi 'gal zhing*/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa yin no zhes | | smra na sangs rgyas bstan la gnod/ /des na bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pas/ /sangs rgyas bstan la ma phan yang*/ /rnam pa kun tu gnod mi bya/ /mdo bskul la sogs bya ba kun/ /'dul ba'i gzhung dang mthun par gyis/ /mdo bskul ring mo zhes bya ba/ /

'di 'dra rgya gar na med bod kyi'ang sde snod 'dzin pa rnams la med/ gzung rgyu mang bas dka' la chos nas ma bshad pas na nor ba byed pa mthong*/ /mdo rgyud kun las 'di ma gsungs/ /'di 'dra'i rigs kyi chos 'phel na/ /bstan pa'i rtsa ba nub zer ba yin/ par 'gyur/ / sangs rgyas gsungs pa'i cho ga kun/ /sla bar gyur kyang mi byed la/ / sangs rgyas kyis ni ma gsungs na/ /dka' yang 'bad nas byed pa mtshar || zhes pa bsting tshig ste bstan pa dkrugs pa'i zhe 'dod yod pas byas pa srid pa yin/ sangs rgyas gsung dang mi mthun yang*/ /'di 'dra ba byas pa la skyon can du cang 'gyur ram snyam nas nor ba la| bden par 'dod na ni/ /lag len phyin ci log las chog spyi bor bzhag pas dge slong du song zer ba dang*/ gtor ma spyi bor bzhag pas dbang bskur thob zer ba dang*/ dge 'dun gyi don du phyugs bsad na bsod nams su 'gro zer ba dang*/ rang re gang dran pa'i lag len byas nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yin zhes smra ba/ gzhan yang || 'khrul zhes brjod par mi nus te/ /lung dang 'gal ba'i chos yin par/ / mdo bskul ring mo dang las chog spyi bor bzhag pa'i dge slong la sogs lung nas ma bshad pa'i rang bzor yin par/ thams cad mtshungs pa la/ /'ga' zhig bden la 'ga' zhig ni/ /brdzun pa yin zhes dpyad mi rung*/ / ste bden na'ang thams cad bden/ brdzun na'ang thams cad brdzun du 'gro/ mu stegs la sogs chos log kyang*/ / srog bcad pas mtho ris thob pa dang*/ ba lang gi chu dang lci ba zos pas lus ngag 'dag pa dang*/ dka' thub spyad pas sdig pa 'dag par 'dod pa dag sun dbyung bar ni mi nus te/ /lung rigs med par mtshungs pa la/ /bden brdzun dbye ba nus ma yin/ /la la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /gsung rab tshig don zab mo ston pa'i mdo rgyud/ dang*/ /grub thob rnams dang mkhas rnams kyi | | shin tu legs par bshad bstan/

pa'i chos/ / rnams la/ tshig gi na ya yin pas na/ /dgos pa med pas dor zhes zer/ /tshig kyang bsgrig legs mi shes na/ /don bzang smos kyang ci dgos pa'i/ /blun po rnams kyi rang dga'i tshig /mkhas rnams bzhad gad bskyed pa yi/ /'brel med sna tshogs bris pa la/ /bstan bcos yin zhes nyan bshad byed// blun po dga' ba bskyed nus kyi//mkhas rnams dga' ba bskyed mi nus//dus dang blo gros gron du 'gyur//kye ma sangs rgyas bstan pa na//'di ltar gyur pa da gzod go /des na sangs rgyas gsung rab dri med/dang*/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi bstan bcos kyi//tshig don la ni byin rlabs yod//'di 'dra nyan bshad byed pa la//thos pa zhes ni brjod pa yin//de don dpyod pa bsam pa yin/ /nan tan gyis ni de bsgrub pa/ /bsgom pa yin par shes par bya/ /thos bsam bsgom gsum de ltar gyis/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin//so sor thar pa'i sdom pa'i skabs te dang po'o// //sems bskyed la ni nyan thos dang*/ /theg pa chen po'i lugs gnyis yod/ /nyan thos rnams la sems bskyed gsum/ /dgra bcom du sems bskyed/ rang rgyal du sems bskyed/ sangs rgyas su sems bskyed/ so/ /nyan thos kyi| bstan pa rnal ma lo stong nas/ nub pas na/ / deng sang de yi cho ga spyod pa nyung*// theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed la/ /dbu ma sems tsam rnam pa gnyis/ / de gnyis lta ba tha dad pas/ /cho ga yang ni tha dad yin/ /ltung ba dang ni phyir bcos dang*/ /bslab par bya ba'ang so sor yod/ / 'di gnyis kyi khyad par rgyas pa kho bos byas pa'i sems bskyed kyi cho gar ltos/ sems tsam pa yi sems bskyed 'di | | bod na byed pa mang mod kyi/ /de ni su yang rung ba yi/ /gang zag so sor thar pa'i sdom pa med pa'i mi skya dang*/ sdom pa yod kyang byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod mi shes pa dang*/ shes kyang byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa nyams 'og tu ma chud pa/

rnams la byar mi rung*/ /la la skye bo 'ga' zhig gi /rmi lam na khrom la 'jug pa sems bskyed byed pa rmi ba'i rmi lam/ gyi ni rjes su 'brangs nas/ /sems can kun la sems tsam pa'i 'jug pa/ sems bskyed byed/ / de/ rmi lam chos dang mthun na sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs yin pa la 'di chos dang mi mthun pa'i rmi lam yin pas/ bdud kyi min na rung | | mdo las bdud sdig can sangs rgyas kyi cha byad du byas nas chos log pa ston par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas so// byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang ni/ /mar me mdzad jo bo rje/ kyis bkag phyir dang*/ /cho ga las kyang rigs kyi bu khyod byang chub sems dpa' yin nam zhes bya ba la sogs pas byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod mi shes pa la 'jug pa'i sems bskyed bkag pa/ gsal ba'i phyir/ / ro/ lugs de sangs rgyas bstan pa min/ kha cig blun po sdig pa can/ /yin yang der 'tshogs thams cad ni/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa can/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod la/ /mkhas pa sha stag yin no zhes zer lo/ / med par mthong bzhin du yod ces brdzun zer 'di 'dra'i tshig la'ang bden 'dzin yod/ /sems yod rnams kyis 'di la dpyod/ /gal te 'di 'dra'i tshig bden na/ /de las mi bden gzhan ci yod/ / 'o na me bsil ba yin/ chu sreg pa yin/ sems cad thams cad sangs rgyas yin pas sems bskyed bya mi dgos zhes gang phyin ci log thams cad smras na sus khegs| des na chos kyi rjes 'brangs pa'i/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis lugs 'di spongs/ /dbu ma'i lugs kyi sems bskyed 'di/ /sems can kun gyis legs thob na/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gyur zhes/ /mdo dang bstan bcos rnams las gsungs/ /de yang sdong po bkod pa dang*/ / bskal bzang nam mkha'i snying po dang*/ /dkon brtsegs rgyal po gdams pa yi/ /mdo sde la sogs rnams su ltos/ /'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad dang*/

/rgyal sras zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i/ /bstan bcos la sogs rnams las gsungs/ / 'di dag gi lung bsdus pa sems bskyed kyi lung sbyor na yod pas de ltar ltos/ ji ltar 'bras kyi sa bon ni/ /grang ba'i yul du mi skye ba/ /de bzhin sems tsam pa yi yang*/ /sems bskyed sdig can la mi skye/ /ji ltar nas kyi sa bon ni/ /grang dro gang du'ang skye ba ltar/ /de bzhin dbu ma'i sems bskyed kyang*/ /sdig pa yod med kun la skye/ /gal te mdo las sems can thams cad la sems bskyed bya bar/ bshad pa yi/ /gzhung de sems tsam pa yi yang*/ /sems bskyed kyi/ lung du ci 'gal zhes/ /snyam na de ni 'khrul pa yin/ /rgyal ba phan bzhed nyin gcig gi /srog gcod sdom pa blangs pa la/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed mdzad/ / bskal pa bzang po las/ rgyal ba phan bzhed grong dpon gyur pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams 'od de la| |nyin gcig srog gcod sdom pa phul nas kyang*/ /dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do| |zhes gsungs so/ / de ni so sor thar pa min/ /de la sogs pa'i 'thad pa rnams/ /dbu ma'i lugs la 'thad mod kyi/ /sems tsam pa yi lugs la min/ /des na sems tsam pa yi lugs/ /gal te sems bskyed de 'dod na/ /thog mar so sor thar pa longs*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod slobs/ /dad cing bsgrub par nus gyur na/ /phyi nas sems bskyed sdom pa longs/ /ci ste sems cad thams cad la/ /sangs rgyas sa bon 'jog 'dod na/ /cho ga 'khrul pa med pa yi/ /dbu ma pa yi gzhung bzhin gyis | | don dam sems bskyed ces bya ba/ /bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis skye mod kyi/ /cho ga'i sgo nas 'di mi skye/ / byang chub sems 'grel las/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i stobs kyis bskyed par bya ste zhes gsungs la/ mdo sde rgyan la sogs pa mtha' dag las kyang don de nyid gsungs so//

gal te cho gas don dam sems bskyed/ skye na skyon ci yod snyam na/ ni/ / cho ga dgos na brda las byung ba'i sems bskyed du/ 'gyur | | la/ 'di ni don dam chos nyid kyis/ /thob pa zhes bya'i sems bskyed yin/ /'di la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi/ /cho ga rgyal bas gsungs pa med/ /mkhas pa thams cad 'di mi mdzad/ /mdzad kyang cho gar mi 'gyur ro/ /des na 'di 'dra'i rigs can kun/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan yin/ /dper na chu lud sa bon sogs/ /so nam zhing pas byar nus kyi/ /myu gu sdong bu snye ma sogs/ /zhing las 'byung gi mi las min/ /de bzhin kun rdzob byang chub sems/ /cho ga'i sgo nas bskyed nus kyi/ /don dam byang chub sems dang ni/ /zag pa med pa'i sdom pa dang*/ /bsam gtan gyi ni sdom pa sogs/ /ngang gis skye yi cho gas min/ /'di dag 'thad pa dang bcas pa/ /mdo dang bstan bcos kun las 'byung*/ /don dam sems bskyed bya'o zhes/ /gal te brgya la gsungs srid kyang*/ / spang skong las don dam pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed bya bar gsungs so zer na'ang spang skong bod ma yin gyi rgya gar ba ma yin pas paṇḍi ta rnams gtsigs su mi byed/ gal te gtsigs su byed dgos na yang*/ dam bca' yin gyi cho ga min/ /dper na sbyin pa gtong bar bya/ /tshul khrims dam pa bsrung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas yon tan bsgrub par bya/ /de la sogs pa gsungs pa so so thar pa las/ brtsam par bya zhing dbyung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug par bya/ /'dam bu'i khyim na glang chen bzhin||'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa la'ang cho ga mi dgos/ kun/ /dam bca'i tshig tsam nyid yin gyi/ /cho ga'i sgo nas bskyed pa min/ / spang skong yang de dang 'dra/ yin na ha cang thal 'gyur zhing*/ /cho ga yang ni thug med 'gyur// kye ma 'jig rten blun po 'di/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa 'i so sor thar pa'i lag len dang*/

byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya dang gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur dang rim gnyis la sogs pa cho ga dgos nges pa/ kun bor nas/ /ma gsungs pa mdo bskul ring mo dang*/ sems tsam pa'i sems bskyed la sdig bshags byed pa dang*/ don dam sems bskyed dang*/ phag mo'i dbang bskur la sogs pa gang sangs rgyas kyis ma gsungs pa/ nan gyis 'tshang ba ni// 'di 'dra cir 'gyur brtag dgos so//de ltar sems tsam dbu ma gnyis// rnam gzhag tha dad yod mod kyi/ /'on kyang theg chen kun mthun par/ / ltung ba'i rnam gzhag mu bzhi gsungs/ /ltung med ltung dang ltung ba yi/ / gzugs brnyan ltung ba med pa yi/ /gzugs brnyan zhes bya rnam pa bzhi/ / bsam pa dag pa'i sbyin pa sogs/ /rnam pa kun tu ltung ba med/ /bsam pa ngan pa'i srog gcod sogs/ /rnam pa kun tu ltung bar 'gyur/ /dge ba'i sems kyis bsad pa sogs/ /ltung ba'i gzugs brnyan yin zhes gsungs | | gzhan la gnod na brdzun min yang*/ /ltung ba med pa'i gzugs brnyan yin/ /mdor na sems kyi 'phen pa las/ /gzhan pa'i dge sdig yod ma yin/ /'phags pa lha yis bzhi brgya par/ /bsam pas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /dge ba'am yang na mi dge ba/ /thams cad dge ba nyid 'gyur te/ /gang phyir sems de gtso ba'i phyir/ /zhes gsungs mdo rgyud gzhan las kyang*/ /dge sdig rnam gzhag de ltar gsungs | | byang chub sems kyi bslab pa la/ /bdag gzhan mnyam brje gnyis su gsungs/ kha cig brje ba'i byang chub sems/ /bsgom du mi rung zhes su smra/ / sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin/ /bdag gi bde bas de kun bder gyur cig /ces bya ba la sogs pa'i smon lam gdab tu mi rung zer ba yod/ de yi rgyu mtshan 'di skad lo/ /bdag bde gzhan la byin nas ni/ /gzhan sdug bdag gis blangs gyur na/ /smon lam mtha' ni btsan pa'i phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /des na 'di 'dra'i byang chub sems/

/ bsgom pa de dag thabs mi mkhas/ /nor pa chen po'i chos yin lo/ /de don 'di ltar bsam par bya/ /bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub sems/ / dge ba yin nam sdig yin brtag /gal te dge ba yin na ni/ /de las sdug bsngal 'byung ba 'gal/ /sdig pa yin na chags sdang rmongs pa/ dug gsum gyis | | bskyed pa'i las su thal bar 'gyur/ /brje ba dug gsum ma yin pas | | de las sdug bsngal ga la 'byung*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i blo sbyong ba'i/ /smon lam 'ga' zhig mtha' mi btsan/ /gal te btsan na mdza' bo'i bu/ / yis sems can thams cad kyi klad nad thams cad bdag la smin la/ sems can thams cad klad nad med par gyur cig ces smon lam btab pas de klad nad las grol nas lhar skyes mthar sangs rgyas/ gal te smon lam gyi mtha' btsan na/ rgyun du klad nad chen por 'gyur/ dgos pa las ma gyur pa bzhin no/ / dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*/ /bdag gzhan brje ba bsgom pa'i phyir/ /rgyun du sdug bsngal thob par 'gyur/ /brjes pa'i sems can de dag kun/ / sdug bsngal 'byung ba srid mi 'gyur/ /des na 'di 'dra'i gsang tshig ni/ / bdud kyi yin pa mi shes so/ /thabs la bslu ba'i bdud kyis thabs phyin ci log bstan nas sems can rnams 'khor ba las mi thar bar byed pa/ yod ces/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'ang dran par bya/ /bdag gzhan brje ba sangs rgyas kyi// bstan pa'i snying po yin par gsungs*/ /'phags pa klu sgrub skyob nyid kyis || rin chen phreng bar 'di skad gsungs/ /bdag la de dag sdig smin cing | | bdag dge ma lus der smin shog /ji srid sems cad 'ga' zhig kyang*/ /gang du ma grol de srid du/ /de phyir bla na med pa yi/ /byang chub thob kyang gnas gyur cig /de skad brjod pa'i bsod nams 'di// gal te de ni gzugs can 'gyur/ /gaṅgā'i bye ma snyed kyi ni/ /'jig rten khams su shong mi 'gyur/ / 'di klu sgrub khyod rang gi rang bzo ma yin nam zhe na ma yin te/

'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs/ / gsungs kyang drang don yin no zhe na gtan tshigs kyang ni 'di la snang*/ / ba'i phyir nges don yin no// de la sogs pa legs par gsungs/ / rdo rje rtse mo las/ sems can sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /bdag 'tshang rgya bar ma gyur cig/ces gsungs pa dang yang 'gal bar 'gyur ro/ / spyod 'jug las kyang 'di skad du/ /bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag /yang dag brje bar ma byas na/ /sangs rgyas nyid du mi 'grub cing*/ /'khor ba na yang bde ba med/ /de skad gsungs pa legs par zungs/ / gzhan yang*/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gang ci'ang rung*/ /de kun bdag la smin gyur cig/byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba yis||'gro ba bde la spyod par shog /ces gsungs so/ / mdo dang bstan bcos gzhan las kyang*/ /chos kyi snying por 'di gsungs so/ /des na bdag gzhan brje ba shes/ /de ni myur du rdzogs 'tshang rgya/ /de yi bar du'ang 'jig rten gyi//phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar gsungs//byang chub sems kyi gnad 'chugs na//chos gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya*//stong nyid nyan thos rnams kyang bsgaum/ /de yi 'bras bu 'gog pa thob/ /so sor thar pa'i mdo

las/ so so thar pa bton pa las//bsod nams grub pa gang yod pa/ /des ni 'jig rten ma lus pa//thub dbang go 'phang thob par shog /ces gsungs pa/ bzhin du/ /bsngo ba nyan thos rnams kyang byed/ /'dul ba lung gi kā tyā na'i gdams ngag las stong nyid la sogs pa dbu ma dang khyad med par gsungs/ la sogs pa las brgya pa dang gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa/ ru/ /stong pa nyid dang skye med dang*/ /mkha' dang lag mthil mnyam pa sogs/ /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs pa'ang gsungs | | 'dul ba lung gi thams cad sgrol gyi skyes rabs las bdag gis bram ze 'dod pa la//dga' bas shing rta 'di btang bas//dngos po thams cad btang nas ni/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog / ces pa/ de la/ sogs pa bsngo ba mang du gsungs//'on kyang thabs la mkhas pa yi/khyad par 'ga' zhig ma gsungs pas/ / phar phyin gyi lugs kyi bskal pa grangs med pa gsum pha rol du phyin pa drug la tshogs gsog mi nus/ gsang sngags kyi lugs kyi dbang dang rim gnyis la 'jug mi nus pas stong nyid rtogs kyang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub mi nus//de phyir thabs mkhas shes rab nyid//sangs rgyas rgyu yi gtso bo yin/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pa mi shes par/ /chos ltar bcos pas blun po 'ga'/ /ngo mtshar bskyed kyi mkhas pa rnams/ khrel bar 'gyur ba 'di 'dra yod/ / chang dang dug dang mtshon cha dang*/ /gzhan gyi longs spyod ster ba dang*/ / gsod sar phyugs ma ster ba dang*/ /mchog gi nor ni mchog min la/ / ster rab tu byung ba'i nor khyim pa la ster ba lta bu/ sogs mdo las bkag pas na/ / ma dag pa yi sbyin pa yin/ /nyan thos kyi ni sdom pa la/ /theg pa chen por 'chos pa so so thar pa'i sdom pa ji srid 'tsho'i bar du len pa la/ ji srid sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du len dgos zer ba/ dang*/ /de bzhin theg chen nyan thos su/ /chos pa theg chen gyi sdom pa sems la skye ba la nyan thos kyi lugs rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs yin zer ba/

tshul khrims ma dag pa/ /rang nyid tshul khrims bsrungs na yang || tshul khrims la ni mchog 'dzin cing*/ /gzhan la khyad gsod byed pa ni/ /ma dag pa yi tshul khrims yin/ /dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma la || gnod cing bstan pa 'jig pa la/ khros na ldog par nus bzhin du// bzod pa bsgoms na ma dag pa'o/ /log pa'i chos la dga' ba dang*/ / thos bsam bsgom gsum nor ba la/ /brtson 'grus chen po byed pa sogs | ma dag pa yi brtson 'grus yin/ /mi mkhas stong nyid bsgom pa dang | | gnad 'chugs pa yi thabs lam sogs/ /rnam rtog chos rje sa paṇa gsung rab kha skong pod dang po/ mel po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 160PAGE 161
